answer_d: Shin akwai tsayawar aiki a samuwar da amfani da abubuwan da ke aiki da kayayyakin da aka samar?

question: Malam ya yi shiri don yin aiki kan manufar nuna bambancin pH a cikin tsaka-tsaki mai sarrafawa a cikin aji a siffar zane. Saboda haka, malamin ya nemi ɗaliban shekarar ƙarshe su zana lankwasa titireti (titration curve) na wani acid mai rauni tare da wani gishiri mai ƙarfi, wanda aka samar da ma’aunin yawa (concentrations) da girman (volumes) duka abubuwan biyu. Yayin da aikin ke ci gaba, malamin ya lura cewa yawancin ɗalibai sun sami damar gina lankwasar har zuwa inda aka daidaita (equivalence point) ne kawai, saboda suna samun ƙimar pH mara kyau bayan wannan matakin. Waɗanne daga cikin ayyukan gyarawa na gaba zai bai wa malamin damar sake jagorantar ɗaliban don kammala ginin lankwasa titireti?
answer_a: Kai ɗaliban zuwa dakin gwaje-gwaje don su iya gano maki daidaitawa ta hanyar gwaji
answer_b: Ku bayyana musu, ta amfani da ma'aunin pH, cewa an gina shi bisa darajoji masu kyau na maida hankali na acid ko na alkali
answer_c: yi musu bayani, tare da misali, yadda ake gano adadin ma'adanai masu yawa (excess moles) na kowace sinadari a wurare daban-daban yayin aikin titration
answer_d: Yi amfani da software inda ɗalibi ya shigar da adadin tushe da aka ƙara, kuma tsarin ya tanadi digogi don zana lanƙwasar

question: A cikin aji dangane da maudu'in daidaituwar sinadarai, wani malamin sakandare yana aiki a kan manufar koyo ta Bayyana matsayin daidaito da haduwar sinadarai ke kaiwa. A lokacin aikin, malamin ya lura da rudewar ɗalibai game da wannan tambayar da suka yi: Shin abubuwan da ke haduwa da abubuwan da aka samu suna kaiwa ga matsayin daidaito ne daban-daban? Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ne zai bai wa malamin damar maida hankalin tsarin koyarwa da koyo ga ɗalibai?
answer_a: Kwaikwayi ci gaban reaksi har sai an samar da rabin kayayyaki
answer_b: Samo halayen manya-manya da ƙanana na wani tsarin sinadarai har sai ya kai ga daidaituwa
answer_c: Gudanar da hanyar gwaji da ke nuna tasirin abubuwan da ke kawo canji ga matsayin daidaituwa a tsarin sinadarai
answer_d: Gudanar da wata hanyar gwaji wacce za ta ba da damar hasashen ma'aunin tarin a daidaito na nau'o'in da ke shiga, bisa ga ma'aunin tarin su na farko

question: Malamar makaranta tana aiki da ajin makarantar sakandare na shekara ta uku a kan maudu'in Kimiyyar Zafin Halitta (Thermochemistry). Don sa ɗaliban su yi nazarin yadda zafi ke gudana a cikin tsarin sinadarai, ta gudanar da wani gwaji mai amfani ta amfani da gilashin da ke ɗauke da ƙanƙara da wani mai ɗauke da ruwan zafi, a lokacin ranar kaka inda zafin jiki ya kai kusan 20°C. Wata ƙungiyar ɗalibai ta yi hasashe cewa, a tsawon lokacin gwajin (minti 60), ƙanƙarar ba za ta narke ba kuma ruwan zafin ba zai yi sanyi ba. Wace tambaya malamar za ta iya yi don sa ɗaliban su sake yin la'akari da hasashensu daga wannan ƙwarewar mai amfani?
answer_a: Yaya zafi yake shafar tsarin kafa?
answer_b: Yaya daidaiton zafin jiki yake da alaƙa da tsarin da aka kafa?
answer_c: Me yasa muke yawan magana game da abubuwa masu zafi da sanyi, a wannan yanayin, game da gilashi mai sanyi da gilashi mai zafi?
answer_d: Mene ne banbanci tsakanin yanayin zafin wurin da yanayin zafin abubuwan da ke cikin gilasan?

question: Wasu rukuni na ɗaliban ajin uku na sakandare suna shirya rahoton dakin gwaje-gwaje game da gwajin mai taken "Abubuwan da ke Shafar Saurin Mu'amala." Waɗanne abubuwa na ilimi na baya ne suka kamata su koya don bayyana sakamakon da aka samu?
answer_a: Ƙa'idar gudu
answer_b: Ka'idar Karo
answer_c: Bayyana ma'aunin daidaito
answer_d: Abubuwan da ke shafar saurin aiwatarwa

question: Wani malami, a lokacin da ake koyar da darasin Haɗin Sinadarai (Chemical Bonding), ya bukaci ɗalibansa da su bi matakai-matakai don kammala aikin da ke gaba: Rubuta cikakkun tsare-tsaren na lantarki (electronic configurations) na atomin da ke cikin ƙwayoyin ruwa da na amoniya. Zana tsare-tsaren Lewis (Lewis structures) da suka dace da kowace ƙwaya. Gina samfuran ƙwayoyin biyu da laka da ashirin (matchsticks) bisa ga siffar ƙwayar su. Samar da kamanceceniya da bambance-bambance tsakanin siffofin ƙwayoyin guda biyu. Wane ne daga cikin abubuwan koyo masu zuwa za a iya tantance su da aikin da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Yi hasashen ɗauri na kwayar halitta bisa ga yanayin lantarki na atom ɗinta
answer_b: Wakilta rabon electrons a cikin molecules ta amfani da Lewis structures
answer_c: Bincika rabon atam da ke cikin kwayoyin halitta bisa ga ka'idar turewar nau'in lantarki na harsashin sinadarai (VSEPR)
answer_d: Gano ma'adanarwa da ba-ma'adanarwa na electrons a cikin kwayar halitta bisa tsarin kwayoyin electrons na atoms masu hada ta

question:
Malamar babbar makarantar sakandare tana da burin ɗalibanta su gano abubuwan da ke shiga ciki wajen tantance rabin rayuwar wani sinadarin rediyoaktif.
Wace aiki ce za ta ba wa ɗaliban dama su cimma burin da aka saita?
answer_a: Nuna raguwar wani sinadari mai aikin rediyo a jere
answer_b: Kafce ka'ida game da ruɓewar nukiliyar wani sinadari mai aiki da rediyo
answer_c: Shirya bayanan daga teburin yawan adadin abubuwan da ke lalacewa masu auna lokaci da yawa
answer_d: Kwaikwayi ruɓuwar wani sinadarin rediyo kuma ƙayyade adadin kwayoyin zarra da suka ruɓe

question: Malamin shekarar farko ta sakandare, a cikin darasin Stoykiyometri, yana buƙatar tantance fahimtar ɗalibai game da ma'aunan stoykiyometri a cikin daidaitaccen lissafin sinadarai. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke tafe malamin zai iya gabatarwa don tabbatar da ilimin da aka samu?
answer_a: Yi lissafin rabon mol na adadi tsakanin abubuwan da suka yi aiki da samfuroran haɗuwar
answer_b: Lissafo nauyin abubuwan da suka yi aiki da samfurori kuma tantance alaƙar lissafi tsakanin su
answer_c: Gina tebur na daidaito tsakanin abubuwan da ke amsawa da abubuwan da suka samo asali, na kashi dari na abun da ke cikinsu
answer_d: Gina teburin daidaito tsakanin mol, kwayoyin halitta (molecules), da kuma atom, dangane da abubuwan da ke cikin halittar (reaction)

question: Wacece a cikin waɗannan ayyukan da malamin aji na 4 zai iya gabatarwa don haɓaka ƙwarewar tsarawa (planning skill) a cikin ɗalibansa yayin da suke aiki a kan yanayin abu (states of matter)?
answer_a: Ku gabatar da wani gwaji ga ɗalibai wanda ke nuna cewa awo (mass) na ruwa baya canzawa idan ya daskare.
answer_b: Ku tambayi ɗalibai su rubuta kuma su zana tsari don tabbatarwa ko ruwa yana canza girma (volume) lokacin da yake canza yanayi (state)
answer_c: Ku tambayi ɗalibai su tabbatar, ta amfani da ma'aunin zafi (thermometer), ko zafin ruwa a cikin gilashi yana canzawa idan aka ƙara ƙanƙara a cikin ruwan
answer_d: Ku gabatar da tambayar bincike mai zuwa ga ɗalibai: Menene zai faru da ruwan idan, yana cikin yanayi mai ƙarfi (kankara), aka fallasa shi ga zafin jiki na ɗaki?

question: A makarantar renon yara, malamin yana buƙatar tantance matakin cimmawa na wannan manuniya ta Jiki da Motsi mai zuwa: Yana nunawa ko nuna wurin gabobin ciki kamar zuciya, huhu, kwakwalwa. Wace dabarar tantancewa ce daga cikin waɗannan za ta fi dacewa da manufar malamin?
answer_a: Ku umarci yara su yi kwaikwayon sassan jiki na ciki na ɗan adam da laka kuma ku auna gwanintarsu ta amfani da jerin abubuwan dubawa
answer_b: Bari kowane yaro ya zaɓi wata gaba ta jikin ɗan Adam kuma ya yi jawabi a kanta. Ku tattara shaidu ta hanyar rikodin abin da kuka gani
answer_c: Ku roƙi yara su dora hotunan gaɓoɓin jikin a kan siffar jikin mutum, sa'annan ku rubuta yadda suka yi aiki ta amfani da ma'aunin ƙididdiga
answer_d: Ku nemi yara su kalli bidiyon jikin ɗan Adam sannan su tattauna a ƙungiyance abin da suka gani. Ku tattara shaida ta hanyar rubuce-rubucen abubuwan da suka faru ba zato ba tsammani

question: Ga yara 'yan K-kafin-aji, wani mai koyarwa ya gayyace su zuwa farfajiya don gudanar da wani darasi game da halin abu. Wannan ya haɗa da barin kyandir a rana don ganin abin da zai faru. A baya, yaran suna yin hasashe kuma su zana su a littafin rubutu. A cikin wannan ƙwarewar da aka bayyana, wane canji na halin abu yaran wannan matakin za su iya lura da shi?
answer_a: Haɗawa
answer_b: Turbuwa
answer_c: Daskarewa
answer_d: Tasirin danshi

question: Malamar ajin kananan yara tana shirya wani bangare na darasi mai taken Tunanin Masanin Kimiyya. Yaran sun shiga sosai cikin kwarewar koyarwa, kamar su gudanar da gwaje-gwaje da koyon Hanyar Kimiyya. Dabarun da za su horar da kansu a kansu sune lura da kuma yin hasashe bisa ga lura. Wane kayan aikin koyarwa ne zai dace don inganta ci gaban waɗannan dabarun ga yaran?
answer_a: Takardar sanin kai, don rubuta sababbin ra'ayoyin da aka koya yayin gwajin sannan a zana ƙarshe
answer_b: Littafin bin diddigi, don rubuta ra'ayoyi da lura na farko na gwaji, sannan a kwatanta bayanan da aka samu daga baya
answer_c: Rajistar tsarawa, ta inda ake tsara matakai da ra'ayoyi na farko na gwajin, sannan kuma a lura da yadda gwajin ya gudana
answer_d: Hanyoyin tattarawa da na lura waɗanda ke sauƙaƙawa da ba da damar bincike mai zurfi, don daga baya bayyana abubuwan da aka samu

question: Malamar makarantar gaba da firamare ta yi aiki a kan manufar koyo mai cewa: “A yi haɗin gwiwa a yanayi na yau da kullum, a ayyukan da ke ba da gudummawa ga ci gaban muhallai masu ɗorewa.” Don cimma wannan, ta raba wa yaran ƙananan abubuwan koyo daban-daban: kallon bidiyo, ƙirƙirar fosta, ziyartar cibiyar sake sarrafa shara, da sauransu. Daga nan, tana buƙatar tantance manufar da aka zaɓa. Wace dabarar tantancewa ce za ta dace don tabbatar da cimma wannan manufar koyo?
answer_a: Ku rubuta ayyukan da yara ke yi ba tare da an umarce su ba yayin da suke yin ayyukansu na yau da kullum ta hanyar amfani da ma'auni. Misali: rufe famfo, ɗaukar takardu
answer_b: Ku tattara shaidu, ta hanyar bayanan lura, na abubuwan da yaran suka yi tunani a kansu yayin da suke sauraron wani labari game da ayyukan da ke ba da gudummawa ga ci gaban muhallai masu ɗorewa
answer_c: Ku rubuta ta cikin jerin abubuwan dubawa ko yara sun bambanta tsakanin hotunan ayyukan da ke ba da gudummawa ga muhalli mai dorewa da kuma waɗanda ba sa bayarwa. Misali: sake amfani da kayan aiki, jefa shara a cikin kwandon shara
answer_d: A tattara bayanai ta hanyar bin tsarin tantance nazari (analytical rubric) na ra'ayoyin yara ko tunaninsu yayin kallon wani bidiyo da ke nuna yanayi da ba sa taimakawa ga kula da muhalli. Misali: amfani da ruwa ba tare da nuna kulawa ba, zubar da shara a bakin teku

question: Malamar aji na uku ta tantance, a cikin sashin Kula da Albarkatun Ƙasa, manufar “Gane Dokar 3Rs a cikin ayyukan zahiri”. Don yin haka, ta gabatar da wani aiki inda ɗaliban dole ne su rubuta aikin yau da kullun don kowane rukuni mai dacewa: Rage (Reduce), Sake Amfani (Reuse), da Sake Sarrafa (Recycle). Ɗaya daga cikin ɗaliban ya gabatar da amsa mai zuwa: 1. Yin amfani da abin rufe fuska mai wankewa. 2. Shuka tsire-tsire a cikin kwanonin man shanu. 3. Raba da kuma ajiye kwantenonin da za a jefar a gida. Wace martani ce daga malamar za ta ba ɗalibin damar ingantawa da kuma jagorance shi zuwa ga cimma manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Misalai masu kyau sosai! Amma shin duk Rs ɗin nan suna nan? Ina gayyatarka/ki da ka/ki amsa waɗannan tambayoyi: Wace matakiyar/matakiya ce ke ba ka/ki damar kashe albarkatu kaɗan ko kuma mallakar abubuwan da suka wajaba kawai? Wace sabuwar matakiyar/matakiya za ka/ki bada shawara domin kammala amsarka/ki?
answer_b: Misalai masu kyau kwarai! Amma dukkanin R din sun cika kuwa? Ina gayyatar ku da ku rubuta ma'anar kowanne daga cikin 3Rs: Rage, Sake Amfani, Sake Sarrafawa, bin misalan da aka bayar, sannan kuma sai ku amsa wannan tambaya: Wacce daga cikin waɗannan matakan kuke ganin tafi tasiri a rayuwar yau da kullum?
answer_c: Misalai masu kyau sosai! Amma ka manta da R guda ɗaya. Don kammala amsar, ina gayyatarka ka amsa waɗannan tambayoyi: Waɗanne matakai za ka ba da shawarar a aiwatar a makaranta? Ta yaya za ka ƙarfafa ɗan ajinka ya nemo sababbin amfani ga abubuwa maimakon jefar da su?
answer_d: Misalai masu kyau ƙwarai! Amma kun manta da R ɗaya. Don kammala amsar, ina gayyatarku ku amsa waɗannan tambayoyin: Me ya sa waɗannan ayyukan ke da inganci don kula da albarkatun ƙasa? Har zuwa wane mataki suke taimakawa wajen rage shara da gurbata yanayi a duniya?

question: Wace irin aiki ce ta dace ga ɗaliban aji na uku don su kwatanta al'amarin kusufin rana kuma su bayyana shi ga sa'anninsu?
answer_a: Suna karɓar takarda da aka buga da zobba na fanko da yawa waɗanda ke wakiltar Rana kuma su yi fenti da baƙi inuwar Wata a matakai daban-daban na gabaɗayan kusufin Rana, kuma su bayyana tafiyar al'amarin
answer_b: Suna haska hasken rana da tocila a kan ƙwallon roba wadda ke wakiltar Duniya, sai su lura da siffa da girman inuwar da ta bayyana a kan farin allo, suna rubuta abubuwan da suka lura.
answer_c: Suna wakiltar Rana da tocila kuma suna haska fitilarta a kan farin allo wanda ke wakiltar Duniya; sannan, ta amfani da wata karamar ƙwallo da suke motsawa a hankali a gaban tocilar, suna lura da yadda siffar yankin da aka haskaka a kan allon ke canjawa
answer_d: Suna wakiltar Rana da fitilar hannu, Duniya da kawunansu suna bayar da baya ga tushen hasken, da Wata da farin balan da suke riƙe da shi a hannunsu tare da miƙa hannu, kuma a hankali suna juya ta gaba da agogo, suna lura da abin da ke faruwa ga hasken balan ɗin

question: Wani malami na ajin yara ƙanana na farko yana shirin tattara hujjoji don wata alama ta tantancewa a babban fannin Jiki da Motsi: Yana gane wasu sassan jikinsa ta hanyar nuna su idan aka faɗi sunansu. Don tattara irin waɗannan hujjoji, malamin zai yi amfani da bidiyo da rubutattun bayanai. Wace dabara ce daga cikin masu zuwa za ta ba da damar tantance nasarar cimma wannan alama?
answer_a: A lokacin wasan kyauta a ɗaki, babba yakan zauna kusa da madubi, kuma idan yaro ya kusanto, yakan tambaye shi ina sassa daban-daban na fuskarsa suke.
answer_b: A lokacin da ake gudanar da ayyuka masu canzawa, babba tana tambayar yaro game da azancin jiki daban-daban, kuma ta ce su taɓa sassan fuskarsu da ke da alaƙa da kowanne ɗaya.
answer_c: A lokacin mu’amala, babba yana rera waƙoƙi daban-daban da suke da alaƙa da sassan fuska, yana taɓa su a jikinsa kuma yana lura ko yaron zai maimaita hakan
answer_d: Lokacin gaisuwa, babba yana motsa sassa daban-daban na jikinsa, kamar tafa hannu, motsa ƙafafu da kai; sa'an nan ya roƙi yaran su kwaikwayi wannan motsi.

question: Wata malamar ajin yara ƙanana tana shiri a cikin wani aikin kimiyya na manufa ta musamman da aka gindaya ta koyo daga tsakiya na Binciken Muhalli na Halitta: “Don tsara hasashe game da sakamakon al'amuran halitta da aka lura da su, bisa ga ilimi da gogewa na baya.” Wane ɗayan waɗannan gogewar koyo ne zai ba da damar magance manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Nuna bidiyo da ke bayani kan yadda ake samar da hadari. Daga nan, a cikin babban rukuni, gayyaci yara su yi magana kan abubuwan da suka faru da su, ta hanyar tambayoyi masu zuwa: Kun taɓa shiga hadari? Me ya faru a muhallin?
answer_b: Ka nuna wani samfuri mai wakiltar bakin teku a cikin wani kwantena na gilashi. Sannan, ka yi kwaikwayon ruwan tsunami, ka umarci yaran su lura da abin da zai faru kuma su amsa tambayar: Me ya faru lokacin da ruwan ya motsa zuwa ga tudu?
answer_c: Ku gayyaci yara su yi dutsen wuta daga laka, a cikin ƙananan ƙungiyoyi, bisa ga umarnin da aka bayar. Sannan, ku kwaikwayi fashewar dutsen wuta kuma ku tambaye su: Za ku iya bayyana abin da kuka gani? Yaya fashewar ta faru?
answer_d: Ku shirya wani da'irar tattaunawa da yara game da saninsu game da girgizar ƙasa. Sannan, ku gayyace su su lura, a cikin wani samfuri, da kwaikwayon girgizar ƙasa kuma ku tambaye su: Yaya za ku iya bayyana abin da ya faru? Wane tasiri zai yi a kan birane?

question: Malamar ajin yara ’yan riga-kafi tana aiki tare da yara a kan wadannan manufofin koyo daga Makasudin Gaggawar Bincike a Muhallin Halitta: “Gwajawa da hada-hadar abubuwa da ma’adanai ta amfani da kayan yau da kullum, kamar su kumfar sabulu, ruwan gishiri, da gelatin, suna bayyana canje-canjen da aka lura da su.” Don cimma wannan, tana gayyatarsu su shiga gwajin “Ruwan Sama Mai Launi.” Wannan ya hada da zuba ruwa, sa’an nan mai, sannan kuma digon rini na abinci a cikin gilashi, tare da taimakon babba. Yayin da take yin hakan, malamar ta tambayi yaran, “Me ke faruwa?” Antonio, daya daga cikin yaran, ya amsa, “Ina son launukan da kika saka.” Wane ne daga cikin wadannan shisshigin malamar zai taimaki Antonio don cimma abin koyo da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Madalla da ka so su, Antonio. Meye wanda ka fi so? Yanzu, lura da sauran abubuwan, misali, ruwa da mai ba su haɗu ba
answer_b: Abin mamaki kenan, Antonio, ni ma na ji daɗin launukan da muka yi amfani da su. Shin ka lura cewa idan sun shiga man, sai su tsaya kamar kumfa?
answer_c: Madalla, Antonio, da ka so launukan da muka yi amfani da su. Kana iya gaya mani ko kana ganin wani bambanci tsakanin launin da yake a cikin mai da wanda ya riga ya shiga cikin ruwa?
answer_d: Lalle abin sha'awa, Antonio, har abokan ajinka ma sun so kalolin da muka yi amfani da su. Yanzu, ina gayyatar ka ka duba abin da zai faru da waɗannan kalolin a ƙarshen gwajin.

question: A cikin aji na 8, bayan ya gama bayyana aikin sassan ƙwayar halitta a cikin ƙwayoyin halitta masu cikakken tsari, wani malami zai yi amfani da misali wanda ya danganta injina da sassan masana’anta da ƙwayar halitta don fayyace aikinsu. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan misalan da malamin zai ambata ya yi daidai da tsarin kwarangwal na ƙwayar halitta?
answer_a: Na'ura mai canza kwayar halitta zuwa makamashi
answer_b: Tsari da ke ba da damar kiyaye oda a cikin masana'antar
answer_c: Cibiyar sarrafawa da ke da bayanan masana'antar kuma ke jagorantar abin da ke faruwa a cikinta
answer_d: Na'urar da ke alamta kayayyakin da za a fitar daga masana'anta

question: Malamar aji na 8 ta gano cewa ɗalibanta suna da wahalar fahimtar ma'anar osmosis. Saboda haka, ta tsara wani aiki wanda zai ba su damar fahimtar yadda wannan nau'in jigilar marar ƙarfi yake faruwa. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba malamar za ta iya amfani da shi don ƙarfafa fahimtar ɗalibanta game da tsarin osmosis?
answer_a: Ku umarci ɗalibai su nutsar da guntun dankali mai nauyin gram 10 a cikin tsaka-tsakin ruwa mai daidaita karfi na maganin sodium chloride mai kaso 0.9%. Bayan minti 15, su cire guntun dankalin, su auna nauyinsa, kuma su kwatanta shi da nauyin farko. Bayyana abin da ya faru game da jigilar ruwa.
answer_b: Ka tambayi ɗalibai su tsoma jakar shayi (tea bag) a cikin gilashin ruwan sanyi kuma su lura da abin da zai faru. Sa'an nan, su tsoma wata jakar shayin a cikin gilashin ruwan zafi kuma su lura da abin da zai faru. Ka bayyana irin tsarin motsin abubuwa (transport mechanism) da ke faruwa da kuma yadda zafin jiki ke shafar lokacin da shayin zai ɗauka don ya bazu ko'ina a cikin gilashin.
answer_c: Yi gwajin da ke biyo baya: cika kwalbar gwaji da ruwa kuma zuba ɗigon tawada a ciki. Lura da abin da ya faru da tawadar kuma yi tambayoyi don fahimtar cewa tawadar ta haifar da bambancin ma'aunin haɗuwa bisa ga yawan ko ma'aunin haɗuwar tawadar da take yaɗuwa cikin ruwan
answer_d: A nuna a hoto wani akori mai rabe-rabe biyu waɗanda wata membrane mai izinin wucewa ta raba su. A wakilci kayan da aka narkar da su (solute) da ƙananan ƙwallaye, waɗanda suka fi yawa a ɗaya daga cikin rabe-rabun. A ƙirga ƙwallayen a cikin rabe-rabun biyu sannan a lura cewa matakin ruwan daidai yake. Bayan minti 5, a nuna akori ɗaya, a ƙirga ragowar ƙwallayen a cikin rabe-rabun biyu, sannan a lura cewa matakin ruwan ya canza, inda ya ƙaru a cikin rabe-raben da ke da ƙwallaye mafi yawa.

question: Malamar aji na takwas tana shirin darasi ne a kan halayen tsarin kwayoyin halittar da ke samar da ruwa (secretory cells) kuma ta ba da shawarar cewa ɗalibai su danganta gagarumar ci gaban tsarin membrane na cikin kwayar halitta (intracellular membrane system) da aikinsa. Wace daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan koyo ce za ta ba ɗalibai damar cimma burin da aka tsara?
answer_a: Duba hotunan ƙananan ƙwayoyin halitta masu fitar da sinadarai kuma ka tambaye su su gano aikin kowane ɗayan ƙwayoyin halitta da ke wajen
answer_b: Ka ce su zana a kan hoton da aka ɗauka na ƙaramin kwayar halitta mai fitar da sinadarai hanyar da sunadarai ke bi ta hanyar exocytic sannan su bayyana shi
answer_c: Nuna samfurin kwayar halittar mai fitarwa da kuma wani na kwayar halittar tsoka, sannan a roƙe su su kwatanta ayyukan sifofin da ke bambanta su
answer_d: Ku gabatar da samfuri na kwayar halitta mai fitar da sinadari (secretory cell) da kuma wani na kwayar halittar tsoka (muscle cell), sa'annan ku tambaye su su tantance aikin kowace kwayar halitta bisa ga tsarin gininsu (structures)

question: Malami na aji 8 yana fara darasi kan Kwayoyin Halitta (Cells). Don yin haka, ya bayyana manyan bambance-bambance tsakanin kwayoyin halitta na eukaryotic da prokaryotic, kamar kasancewa ko rashin kasancewar wani tsakiya (nucleus) a cikinsu. Bayan ya gama, wani ɗalibi ya tambaya: "Ta yaya kwayoyin halitta na prokaryotic ke iya rarrabuwa?" Idan aka yi la'akari da matakin ɗalibin, wane daga cikin bayanan da malamin zai yi a ƙasa zai ba da damar amsa damuwarsa ta hanyar da za a iya fahimta da kuma ingancin tsarin ra'ayi?
answer_a: Kwayoyin halitta na prokaryotic suna hayayyafa, amma ba tare da jima'i ba, wanda ke nufin babu haɗin kwayoyin halitta a cikin tsari, kamar yadda yake faruwa a cikin kwayoyin halitta na eukaryotic.
answer_b: Ikon salula na rabuwa ya dogara ne akan kasancewar DNA, ko akwai kwayar zarra ko babu. A wannan yanayin, dukkan sel prokaryotic da eukaryotic suna da DNA
answer_c: Rabuwar tantanin halitta aiki ne na samar da sabbin halittu guda biyu daga asalin tantanin halittar uwa. Dukkanin tantanin halittu na prokaryotic da eukaryotic suna da wannan halayyar
answer_d: Kwayoyin halitta da basu da gangan (nucleus), kamar prokaryotic, suna da kwayoyin halittar gado (genetic material). A cikinsu, aikin rarrabuwa biyu (binary fission) yana faruwa, inda DNA ke ninka sannan cytoplasm ya rabu, yana haifar da kwayoyin halitta guda biyu masu girman kamanceceniya.

question: A cikin kima ta ƙarshe, malamin aji na 8 ya tsara manufar kimantawa mai zuwa: “Bayyana ra’ayoyin farko na ka’idar atom ɗin Dalton.” Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin kimantawa zai nuna cewa ɗalibai sun cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Suna samar da sinadarai daban-daban dangane da zaɓin abubuwa biyu ko fiye
answer_b: Suna ƙayyade jimlar adadin zarra da suke shiga cikin wani sinadarin haɗi (chemical reaction)
answer_c: Suna danganta nauyin sinadaran da ke cikin haɗi da jimillar nauyin haɗin
answer_d: Suna auna nauyin wani sinadari da ke cikin mahadi uku daban-daban masu nauyi daidai

question: Malamin aji na shida, a ƙarshen darasi kan sarkar abinci, yana son ya tabbatar ko ɗaliban sun fahimci aikin halittu masu samarwa. Wane daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka da ɗaliban za su yi ne zai ba da damar kimantawar tsari game da koyon su?
answer_a: Ka kammala zane-zanen tsire-tsire wanda ke nuna abubuwan da yake bukata da kuma abubuwan da yake samarwa a lokacin daukar hasken rana (photosynthesis)
answer_b: Bada misalai na halittu masu samarwa
answer_c: Bayyana illar hakan ga halittu masu rayuwa idan tsirrai suka ɓace
answer_d: Kafa dangantaka tsakanin halittun da suka hada gidan cin abinci

question: Malamin makarantar sakandire na shekara ta farko, a cikin darasi game da abubuwan da ke shafar Hoton-hadawa, zai tattauna tsara hasashe tare da ɗalibansa. Wanne daga cikin matakan koyarwa masu zuwa ne zai goyi bayan cimma wannan manufa kai tsaye?
answer_a: Ku samar da sakamakon binciken kimiyya a kan tasirin haske da kuma hasashen da aka gindaya, domin ɗalibai su tantance ko gaskata shi ne ko kuma su ƙaryata shi.
answer_b: Samar da tsarin gwaji inda aka haskaka shuka da tsawon igiya daban-daban, kuma bisa ga nazarin gwajin, ɗalibai su gano ma'aunan da ake nazari a kansu
answer_c: Ka sanya tambayar bincike mai zuwa: “Ta yaya zafin wuri (temperature) da danshin iska (humidity) ke shafar samar da abinci a ganyen bishiya (photosynthesis)?” domin ɗalibai su gane ma’aunan da za a bincika (variables) da kuma dangantakar da ke tsakaninsu.
answer_d: Ku samar da hasashe (hypotheses) mabambanta domin tambayar bincike (research question) mai zuwa: “Ta yaya adadin CO2 yake shafar gudun hoto-sarrafa (photosynthetic rate)?” domin ɗalibai su zaɓi wadda ta fi dacewa

question: Malamar ajin farko na sakandare tana aiki kan Ka'idar juyin halitta ta Darwin. Ɗaya daga cikin manufofin shi ne ɗalibai su fahimci cewa nau'o'in halittu da ke da alaƙa sosai ta fuskar juyin halitta suna raba kakanni guda ɗaya na kwanan nan. A yayin wani tantancewa na koyarwa, ta lura cewa wasu ɗalibai har yanzu ba su fahimci wannan ra'ayi ba. Wanne ne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba zai bai wa waɗannan ɗalibai damar cimma manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Rarraba halittu ta hanyar kamanceceniya ta zahiri
answer_b: Amsa tambayoyi bisa ga binciken wani cladogram
answer_c: Zana taswira da ke rarraba misalan burbushin halittu kai tsaye da kuma marasa kai tsaye
answer_d: A kwatanta tsatsatson halittu na kwayoyin halittu daban-daban don tabbatar da dangantakarsu

question: Malami/Malamar sakandare na aji na huɗu yana shirin darasi don taimaka wa ɗalibai su fahimci rawar da rigakafin wucin gadi ke takawa a kiwon lafiyar jama’a. Wacece daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ɗalibai za ta bai wa malamin damar magance manufar, daidai da yadda tsarin manhaja ya jaddada kan sanin ilimin kimiyya?
answer_a: Suna fassara tasirin rigakafi ne bisa ga sakamakon gwaje-gwaje na da, irin wanda Edward Jenner ya yi.
answer_b: Sun bincika, bisa ginshiƙai, yawaitar wasu cututtuka masu yaɗuwa kuma sun gano musabbabin wannan yawaitar
answer_c: Suna kwatanta, bisa ginshiƙai, kashi na yawan jama'a da aka yi wa rigakafi kuma suna danganta shi da kawar da wasu cututtuka da kuma sake bayyanarsu
answer_d: Suna gina layin lokaci na muhimman matakai da suka shafi allurar riga-kafi, suna nuna matsayin masanan kimiyya masu gaba-gaba a wannan fanni

question: A cikin aji na biyu na sakandare, wanda manufarsa ita ce ɗalibai su fahimci juyin halittar ƙwai da mahaifa, wata ƙungiyar ɗalibai ta gabatar da bayani game da wannan juyi. Yayin da yake bayanin tsarin fitar ƙwai, wani ɗalibi ya ce: "Da zarar follicle ya girma kuma hormone mai suna luteinizing ya ƙaru, sai ya saki kansa daga ƙwan mace kuma ya daina samar da estrogen. Bayan haka, wani sabon tsari yana fitowa a cikin ƙwan macen wanda ake kira corpus luteum, wanda kuma yake fara samar da progesterone." Wace wahala ce wajen cimma manufar aji take bayyane a cikin amsar wannan ɗalibin?
answer_a: Da a ce rashin ɗaya daga cikin sinadaran hormones na mahaifa ne ke haddasa fara fitar da kwai
answer_b: Ganin cewa fitowar kwai ba ta dogara ga adadin sinadaran gonadotropic a cikin jini ba
answer_c: Kafa alaƙa marar inganci tsakanin matakan sake zagayowar kwan mace (ovarian cycle) da kuma hormone masu gonadotropic da ke shiga ciki
answer_d: Idan har an ɗauka cewa corpus luteum yana samuwa ne kai tsaye a cikin gurbin kwai, kuma ba daga wani tsari da ya riga ya wanzu a cikin wannan gurbin ba

question: Malami na ajin sakandare na farko, a cikin kashin Abubuwa da makamashi a cikin tsarin halittu, zai yi tantancewar ginawa don kimanta cimma manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Fahimtar dangantaka tsakanin matakan photosynthesis da numfashin salula." Wace ce daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba za ta bada damar tabbatar da cimma wannan koyon?
answer_a: Kammala jadawalin kwatantawa tare da manyan bambance-bambance tsakanin matakan fotosintesis da numfashin salula
answer_b: Bada bayani da zai bayyana muhimmancin matakan photosynthesis da cellular respiration a ma'aunin yanayin halittu (ecosystem)
answer_c: Yi fasta da dabarun sinadarai na fotosintesis da numfashin salula, inda aka nuna yadda tsarin biyu ke dogaro da juna
answer_d: Shirya zane na tsare-tsaren kwayar halitta inda tsarin halittar haske (fatosintesis) da numfashin kwayar halitta ke faruwa, kana bayyana sinadaran da ke cikin kowane tsari

question: Wata malama ta sakandire ta ajin huɗu ta sa a matsayin manufa ga ɗalibanta su fahimci aikin enzym da ke shiga cikin kwafi na DNA. A cikin jarabawar kammalawa a kan wannan batu, ta yi wannan tambaya mai zuwa: “Fludarabine magani ne da ake amfani da shi don magance wasu nau'ikan ciwon daji, yana hana gina DNA ta hanyar ƙinƙance DNA primase. Bisa ga wannan bayanin, wane mataki na kwafi na DNA ne fludarabine yake shafa kai tsaye?” Wane daga cikin alamomin ma'aunin tantancewa da ke biyo baya ne ake auna shi ta hanyar tambayar da ta gabata?
answer_a: Gano aikin enzyme ɗin da ke shiga cikin haɗar RNA mai gindi
answer_b: Bambanta aikin sinadarin (enzyme) da ke da hannu wajen warware karkatacciyar kwayar (double helix) biyu
answer_c: Bambanta aikin sinadarin (enzyme) da ke shiga cikin ƙara nukiliyotai (nucleotides) a jere-jere mai girma
answer_d: Bayyana hanyar aikin enzyme da ke shiga lalata igiyoyin hydrogen da ke haɗa zaruruwan DNA

question: Wani malami na shekara ta ɗaya a makarantar sakandare ya tsara wani darasi don aiki kan manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Ƙirƙiri samfura waɗanda ke bayyana al'amuran taurari na tsarin rana." Don magance girman Rana da taurari, malamin ya yanke shawarar nuna wani tebur na ƙima wanda ya haɗa da radius na Rana da taurari ta amfani da rubutun kimiyya. Wace dabara ce ta hanyar koyarwa ce ta fi dacewa don ƙarin haske ga teburin kuma don cimma manufar koyo daidai?
answer_a: Shirya jikin sama a cikin teburi tun daga mafi karami zuwa mafi girma, tare da ƙarfafa ɗalibai su mai da hankalinsu ga tsarin jere nasu fiye da daki-daki na lambobi
answer_b: Kafa Radius na Duniya a matsayin rukunin tunani kuma ka ƙirƙiri wani ginshiƙi na ƙari a cikin tebur yana nuna nisba tsakanin Radius na jikin sararin samaniya daban-daban da na Duniya
answer_c: A sauƙaƙa yaren da aka yi amfani da shi da gangan, kuma a ambaci girman jikokin sama ta hanyar amfani da kalamai irin su "ya fi girma da..." ko "ya fi girma matuƙa da..."
answer_d: Ku tsara jagorar motsa jiki na lambobi ta kimiyya (scientific notation) tare da misalai da matsalolin da ɗalibai za su warware ta yin amfani da dabi'u daga teburin, don samun ƙwarewa mafi girma a kan jigon.

question: Malamin sakandire na shekara ta biyu yana shirin darussan sashen Kinematics. A cikin ɗaya daga cikinsu, zai gudanar da wani aiki da zai magance abin da ke cikin darasin, yayin da yake amsa muhimmancin tsarin karatu a kan Yanayin Kimiyya. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka da ɗalibai za su gudanar ne ya fi dacewa wajen amsa wannan muhimmancin tsarin karatu?
answer_a: Suna bayyana yadda tunanin saurin ƙarfin nauyi yake aiki ga warware matsaloli na yau da kullum
answer_b: Sun bayyana yadda tunanin ci gaban gudun jawo (gravitational acceleration) ya samo asali a tsawon tarihin ɗan Adam
answer_c: Suna bayyana yadda ci gaban fasaha ya ba da damar samun daidaito mafi girma wajen auna darajar haɓakar nauyi
answer_d: Sun bayyana yadda motsin faɗuwa a 'yanci na wani abu yake samo asali da kuma yadda wannan motsi yake dogara ga saurin nauyi

question: A yawancin littattafan karatu, a cikin nazarin wutar lantarki da layukan wutar lantarki kai tsaye, ana amfani da misalin "ruwa mai gudana" don inganta fahimtar ra'ayoyi kamar ƙarfin wutar lantarki da yiwuwar wutar lantarki, da sauran su. A cikin wannan misalin, ana kwatanta halayen layin wutar lantarki na asali da halayen gudun ruwa da ke yawo ta cikin bututu, kamar dai gudun ruwan yana wakiltar cajojin da ke motsi. Wace zaɓi daga cikin waɗannan ce ta dace da iyakancewar wannan samfurin kwatancin a matsayin dabarar koyarwa don koyar da layukan wutar lantarki kai tsaye ga ɗalibai?
answer_a: Ba ya dace da nazarin da'irorin jere ko na kafa
answer_b: Yana ƙarfafa dalibai su gaskata cewa wutar lantarki tana iya "sauka" ta cikin waya, amma ba "hawa" ba
answer_c: Baya barin ɗalibai su haɗa ra'ayin juriya a cikin wata da'ira ta lantarki tare da kowane abu da za a iya gani na da'irar hydraulic
answer_d: Hakan yana ƙarfafa wa ɗalibai su yi tunanin cewa ƙarfin wutar lantarki a cikin da'irar lantarki daidai yake da gudun ruwa a cikin da'irar ruwa (hydraulic circuit)

question: A cikin aji na Farko na Sakandire, ɗalibai suna gudanar da ayyuka dangane da tsarin samar da hoto a cikin madubai masu faɗi da masu lanƙwasa. A lokacin aikin, wani ɗalibi ya ɗaga hannunsa ya ce: “Malam, har yanzu ban gane bambanci tsakanin hotuna na gaske da na kama ba, balle kuma dalilin da ya sa ake kiran su haka.” Wace bayani daga malamin ce za ta fi dacewa don warware rudanin ɗalibin, tare da amsawa cikin fahimta da kuma daidaiton tsarin tunani ga tambayarsa?
answer_a: Kalli gefe ɗaya da ɗayan cokali. Hoton da kake ganin kanka a tsaye hoton zahiri ne, kuma hoton da kake ganin kanka a juye hoton gaskiya ne.
answer_b: Ya kamata ku tuna cewa hotuna na gaske a koyaushe juye suke, daga sama zuwa ƙasa, yayin da hotuna na zahiri a koyaushe tsaye suke.
answer_c: Tunanin zane-zane na kama da waɗanda aka samar a bayan madubi, yayin da ainihin hotuna ke samuwa a gabansa kuma ana iya nuna su akan allon haske
answer_d: Hotunan kama suna samuwa a cikin wani sararin mai da hankali na kama ta hanyar faɗaɗa haskoki masu faɗuwa, yayin da hotuna na gaske suke samuwa ta hanyar ingantacciyar tsinkayar haskoki masu juyawa

question: Wane irin ilimi ne ya zama dole ɗaliban aji na farko na sakandire su riga sun samu a baya domin su fahimci al'amuran haske kamar su juyewar haske da karyewar haske?
answer_a: Fahimtar cewa haske yana yaɗuwa a madaidaiciyar layi
answer_b: Fahimtar cewa laser na fitar da haske mai launi guda ɗaya
answer_c: Fahimtar haske a matsayin raƙumin lantarki mai maganadisu
answer_d: Fahimtar yanayin kalaman-zarra na haske

question: Malami na shekara ta biyu, a cikin darussan Fizik da ke tafe, zai yi aiki tare da ɗalibansa kan manufa mai zuwa: "Don fahimtar dokokin Newton da kuma amfani da su wajen bayyana yanayi na yau da kullum". La’akari da wannan yanayin, wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ya ke nuna ra'ayoyin kuskure guda biyu na farko waɗanda za su iya kawo cikas kai tsaye ga koyon manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Nisa da gujewa kalmomi ne masu ma'ana ɗaya; ƙarfin da ake buƙata don motsa abu ya dogara ne akan nauyinsa
answer_b: Idan jiki yana hutawa, babu wani ƙarfi da ke aiki a kansa; haɓaka gudu koyaushe yana faruwa a shugaba ɗaya da motsi
answer_c: Ana iya bayyana matsayin jiki ta hanyar nisansa daga wurin farawa; halittu masu rai ne kawai ke iya amfani da karfi
answer_d: Rikici koyaushe yana adawa da motsi; ƙarfin da ƙaramin abu ya yi a kan babban abu ya gaza ƙarfin amsawa na babban abu a kan ƙarami

question: Malamin makarantar sakandare na aji na biyu yana tsara wani kayan aiki don tantance wannan manufar koyo: "Nuna cewa sun fahimci cewa ilimin Sararin Samaniya yana canzawa kuma yana ƙaruwa tare da sababbin shaidu." Wane alamar tantancewa ce ta fi dacewa wajen bayyana koyon ɗalibai dangane da wannan manufa?
answer_a: Bayyana a dunkule yadda sararin samaniya ya kasance kamar yadda ka'idar Big Bang ta nuna
answer_b: Bayyana matakan samuwar tsare-tsare na sararin samaniya daga rushewar jan hankali
answer_c: Kwatanta nagarta da iyakokin samfurori daban-daban na sararin samaniya don bayyana juyin halittarsa
answer_d: Ka gwada bayanan da tsarin geocentric da tsarin heliocentric suka yi game da tsarin rana

question: Malami a aji na biyu na sakandare, a sashin Kinematics (Ilimin Motsi), zai gudanar da tantancewar gano matsayi don fahimtar ra'ayoyin ɗalibai game da motsin abubuwa a faɗuwar 'yanci. Dangane da wannan manufa, wane aikin kimantawa ne zai bai wa malamin damar samun mafi kyawun shaida game da ilimin ɗalibai na baya a kan wannan darasi?
answer_a: A fili, suna jefa abubuwa daban-daban sama, kuma suna kwatanta sigogin kowane jefa
answer_b: Suna amsa tambayoyin da suka shafi kwatantawa da hasashen lokacin da abubuwa daban-daban za su ɗauka wajen faɗowa daga wani tsayi
answer_c: Suna nuna a zane alkiblar hanzarin ƙwallon tennis a lokacin da take cikin sararin sama tana tafiya daga ɗan wasa ɗaya zuwa wani
answer_d: Suna gina taswirar tunani wadda ta haɗa da ra'ayoyin motsi da suka shafi motsin abubuwa a faɗuwar 'yanci

question: A ƙarshen darasi game da Tasirin Doppler ga ajin sakandare na farko, wani malami ya gudanar da kimantawa don tabbatar da koyon ɗaliban. Ɗaya daga cikin tambayoyin da ke cikin wannan kimantawar ya bayyana kamar haka: A cikin Tasirin Doppler da raƙuman sauti, shin gudun yaɗuwar sauti ya canza? Bayyana. Wani ɗalibi ya amsa kamar haka: "Gudun yana canzawa saboda ya dogara da mita da tsawon raƙumi, kuma duka biyun suna canzawa a Tasirin Doppler." Wace martani daga malamin ce ta fi dacewa don jagorantar koyon ɗalibin ta yadda zai iya gano kuskurensa kuma ya shawo kansa?
answer_a: Ba cikakken daidai ba ne a ce mitar sauti da tsawon zangonsa sun canza, domin wannan tasirin yana faruwa ne kawai ga mai ji. Bugu da ƙari, duka biyun suna canzawa a rabo na kishiya, don haka samfurin waɗannan girman biyu yana kasancewa a tsaye.
answer_b: Waɗanne dalilai ne ke haifar da canji a mitata da tsawon taguwar sauti? Shin akwai irin wannan canji a nan? Gudun yaɗuwar sauti a cikin tasirin Doppler ba ya canjawa. Don haka, idan mitata da aka ji na sautin ta ƙaru, to tsawon taguwarsa zai ragu.
answer_c: Kuskure ne a ce gudun yaɗuwa yana canjawa, domin yana dawwama. A cikin tasirin Doppler, tsawon zango zai bambanta ga mai lura, amma a cikin ma'aunin da ya saba wa canjin mitar ga mai lura. Saboda haka, abin haɗin waɗannan girman biyu yana dawwama.
answer_d: Ka tuna da abin da ke sa gudun sauti ya canja. Akwai wani a cikin wannan yanayin? Ko da yake ga mai sauraro mitar da tsawon guguwa suna iya canjawa, gudun yaɗuwar bai canjawa. To ta yaya mitar da tsawon guguwa na sauti ke canjawa?

question: Malami na shekara ta biyu a makarantar sakandare, a cikin sashin Stereochemistry da Isomerism, yana shirin wani darasi wanda burin koyonsa shine kamar haka: "Gane muhimmancin tsarin R ko S a cikin sinadarai da ake amfani da su a rayuwar yau da kullum." Wace daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ce ta dace don cimma burin da aka gabatar tare da ɗalibai?
answer_a: Ka umurci ɗalibai su yi nazari kan tasirin tattalin arziki na ƙera magunguna waɗanda ke da R da S isomers
answer_b: Nemi ɗalibai su bincika tasirin da ke kan lafiyar ɗan Adam na amfani da magunguna guda biyu waɗanda suke enantiomers na juna
answer_c: Nemi ɗalibai su kwatanta sifofin kimiyya da zahiri (physicochemical properties) na R da S stereoisomer na sinadarai 5 da ake amfani da su sosai, misali, ibuprofen
answer_d: Nemi ɗalibai su yi amfani da Dokokin Cahn-Ingold-Prelog don tantance tsarin R da S na mahaɗan 5 da aka saba amfani da su, misali, fructose

question: Malamar sakandare ta aji na biyu, a cikin babi na Hade-hade, tana bayanin *koloids*. Ta nuna cewa a cikin irin wannan nau’in gauraya akwai ƙwayoyi masu shawagi. Ta ƙarfafa bayyaninta ta hanyar nuna hotunan misalai, kamar mayonnaise da jelatin. A ƙarshen ajin, wani ɗalibi ya ɗaga hannunsa ya ce: “Ban gane dalilin da ya sa mayonnaise da jelatin suke *koloids* ba idan har ba za a iya ganin waɗancan ƙwayoyin masu shawagi ba. A gare ni, gauraye ne iri ɗaya.” Wane aiki ne zai bai wa malamar damar yin aiki a kan halayen *koloid* don amsa shakkar ɗalibin?
answer_a: Aiwatar da tasirin Tyndall a cikin wani abin daskararre na gama-gari
answer_b: Haɗa samfurin mayonez da ruwa kuma ka lura da abubuwan da aka gani
answer_c: Zana tsarin kwayar halittar wani abu mai kala da ke rarrabe (colloid) na gama gari
answer_d: Kwatanta tsarin kwayar halitta ta sanwa da kuma ta gurbi

question: Wani malami na ajin farko na sakandare, a cikin rukuni na Sunayen Abubuwa Marasa Kwayoyin Halitta, yana gudanar da aji da manufa kamar haka: "Don amfani da hanyoyin sunayen abubuwa na tsari (systematic), Stock, da na gargajiya wajen sanya sunan oxide na karafa." Lokacin da yake bayyana yadda ake sanya sunayen waɗannan mahaɗai ta amfani da hanyar sunan Stock, sai ya gane cewa ɗaliban ba su fahimci dalilin da ya sa dole ne su haɗa da ƙarfin haɗi (valence) na ƙarfe a cikin lambobin Roman a wasu lokuta kaɗai ba. Don warware wannan matsala, malamin ya yanke shawarar gudanar da wani aiki. Wane aiki ne daga cikin waɗanda ke gaba ke magance matsalar da malamin ya gano a tsakanin ɗalibansa?
answer_a: Malami ya rubuta a allon rubutu jerin oxids na karafa kuma ya tambayi dalibai su lissafa matakin oxidation na karfen a kowane misali. Daga nan, sai su yi nazari kan darajojin matakin oxidation daban-daban da karafan suka nuna a kowane sinadarin kemistiri.
answer_b: Malamin yana rubuta a kan allo jerin darussa game da oxide na karafa, sannan ya tambayi ɗalibai su fadi sunan kowannensu, ta hanyar amfani da ka'idojin tsarin sunaye na Stock. Daga nan, sai su amsa tambayar: Me ya sa waɗannan oxide na karafa dabam-dabam da aka ambata suke da sunaye dabam-dabam?
answer_c: Malamin yana rubutu a kan allo dabarun sinadarai na dioxo da gwauron tagulla mai oxygen guda ɗaya, kuma ɗaliban sun amsa tambaya mai zurfi kamar haka: "Ta yaya za a iya banbanta sinadaran guda biyu a tsarin sunaye na Stock idan sinadarin ƙarfe mai oxygen ɗin ya ƙunshi haɗin abubuwan sinadarai guda ɗaya?"
answer_d: Malam ya rubuta a kan allo jerin abubuwan ƙarfe tare da yawan haɗinsu, kuma ya umarci ɗalibai su rubuta a cikin litattafansu nau'ikan 'oxide' na ƙarfe da waɗannan ƙarfafan za su iya samarwa, sannan, su amsa tambayar: "Me ya sa wasu ƙarfafan za su iya haɗuwa da iskar oxygen a cikin adadi daban-daban, suna samar da sinadarai daban-daban?"

question: Malami na biyu a sakandare zai yi aiki da ɗalibanta kan abubuwan da ke shafar narkewa (solubility) da kuma yadda ake amfani da su. Manufarta ita ce yin hakan ta hanyar magance ƙarfin gwiwar manhaja akan wayewar kimiyya (scientific literacy). A cikin wannan mahallin, wane aiki ne, wanda ɗaliban za su gudanar, ya ba da damar magance wannan abun ciki da kuma amsa ƙarfin gwiwar manhaja akan wayewar kimiyya?
answer_a: Suna binciken abubuwan da ke jawo girgiza sannan kuma buɗe kwalbar soda
answer_b: Suna tsara gwaji da tsire-tsire na ruwa a yanayi daban-daban kuma su kwatanta shi da tasirin tashar samar da wutar lantarki ta hanyar zafi
answer_c: Suna gudanar da gwaji inda hura ta cikin bututu a cikin gilashin ruwan lemun tsami ke mai da ruwan fari
answer_d: Suna fassara bayanan daga wani grafi da ke nuna matakin oxyhemoglobin a cikin jini dangane da matsin iskar oxygen

question: Malamin sakandire na ajin 4, yayin da yake shirya darasin halayen acid-base, ya saita manufar koyo mai zuwa: “Danganta ƙarfin sinadari (concentration) da furcin lissafi don ƙididdige pH a cikin nau'o'in acid da base marasa ƙarfi daban-daban”. Wane ilimi na farko ne wajibi ga ɗalibai su riga sun mallaka don cimma wannan koyo da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Dangantakar ƙarfin acid da matarsa ​​ta wajen gaza (conjugate base)
answer_b: Wakilcin narkewar abubuwan da ke da sinadarin lantarki
answer_c: Furuci na Ma'aunin Daidaituwa na Reaksiyon Sinadarai
answer_d: Ƙaddara Adadin Molar a cikin Maganganun Sinadarai na Lantarki

question: Malami/Malama na sakandare a aji na 4, a cikin darasin Makamashin Nukiliya, ya/ta sanya manufar darasin cewa ɗalibansa/ta su bayyana abubuwan da ke tantance daidaituwar nukiliya (nuclear stability) a cikin atoms. Wane ilimi na farko ne yake da matukar muhimmanci ɗalibai su mallaka don cimma burin koyon da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Sinadaran fitarwa masu hadari
answer_b: Matsakaicin nauyin sinadarai
answer_c: Lambar atom da lambar nauyi
answer_d: Niƙi da matakan kuzari na atom

question: Wani rukuni na ɗaliban sakandare na shekara ta biyu dole ne su gudanar da wani aiki da aka yi nufin cimma burin koyo cewa: "Siffanta mahaɗanai na halitta ta hanyar rukunonin ayyukansu." Wanne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin tantancewa ne bai dace da wannan manufa da aka gabatar ba kuma bai kamata ya zama wani ɓangare na jagorar kimantawa don wannan aikin ba?
answer_a: Yana gane rukunai masu aiki
answer_b: Rarraba sinadarai gwargwadon karfin aiki nasu
answer_c: Rarraba mahaɗai gwargwadon nau'in isomerism
answer_d: Rarraba mahadanai na Organic daban-daban ta amfani da tsarin sunayen IUPAC

question: Malami na aiki a kan babi na Zafi da Makamashi tare da ajin aji na 8. Don ɗaya daga cikin azuzuwan, ta shirya wani aikin gwaji wanda manufarsa ita ce ɗalibai su nuna cewa zafin da aka sha ya dogara ne akan takamaiman zafin kowane abu. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan matakan gwaji ne ya dace don magance manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Ku ɗumama ruwa da man gileriti daidai gwargwado a cikin beakers daban-daban kuma ku auna zafin farko da zafin ƙarshe bayan wani ɗan lokaci da aka bayar
answer_b: Zuba 50 mL na ruwa mai zafin digiri 90 silsiyus a cikin kofi biyu masu girma daya, daya na gilashi dayan kuma na kumfa, kuma auna lokacin da zai dauka don zafin ruwan ya sauka zuwa digiri 25 silsiyus
answer_c: A ɗora ruwa mai tsafta 50 mL da ruwan gishiri 50 mL a cikin beakers daban-daban kuma a auna lokacin da zai ɗauka kafin ruwa mai tsafta da ruwan gishiri su kai matakin tafasa
answer_d: Suna ɗumama cokali na ƙarfe a kan murhu sannan su saka shi a cikin kofin ruwa mai zafin ɗaki kuma su auna zafin ruwan duk bayan daƙiƙa 20 har sai ya daidaita.

question: Malamar ta tsara darasi don aiki da ɗalibanta na aji na 8 kan manufa mai zuwa: "Gano masu canji masu dogaro da waɗanda ba sa dogaro a cikin abubuwan da ke shafar samar da fitsari." Wane aiki, wanda malamar ta gabatar, ne ya dace da manufar darasin?
answer_a: Kwatanta abubuwan da ke cikin fitsarin mai lafiya da mai ciwon sukari
answer_b: Gina taswira a kan tasirin shan barasa a kan yawan fitsari
answer_c: Cika teburin da ke nuna launin fitsari a lokuta daban-daban na rana
answer_d: Cika jadawali da matakin haɗuwar sinadarai daban-daban a sassa daban-daban na bututun koda

question: Malama tana shirin tsara darasin Gas Masu Cikakken Halitta wanda za ta koyar ga ajin aji 7. Manufar ɗaya daga cikin darussan ita ce: “Don fahimtar dangantakar da ke tsakanin zafi da girman (volume) gas a cikin yanayin rayuwar yau da kullum.” Don nuna wannan dangantaka, Malama za ta yi amfani da misali mai alaƙa da dokokin gas. Wanne ne daga cikin yanayi masu zuwa zai zama misali mai kyau don wakiltar abin da za a koyar a aji?
answer_a: Aikin tukunyar matsi
answer_b: Lushin burodi da aka yi da yisti
answer_c: Shakar da fitar iska daga da zuwa huhu
answer_d: Fitar kumfa lokacin buɗe kwalbar soda

question: A cikin aji na aji 8, wata malama ta gudanar da kimantawa kan atom da samar da ions. Sakamakon ya nuna cewa kaso mai yawa na ɗalibai sun yi imanin cewa samar da cations yana faruwa ne saboda atom ɗin yana ƙarawa ko "samun" protons. Wace hanya malamar za ta iya gabatar wa ɗalibanta don inganta fahimtar daidai game da samar da cations?
answer_a: Ku umurci ɗalibai su tantance adadin protons, electrons, da neutrons na ions daban-daban dangane da lambar atom (Z) da kuma lambar mass (A)
answer_b: Bukatanci ɗalibai su ƙirƙira, tare da malami, tebur mai ɗauke da adadin protons, electrons, da neutrons na cations da anions daban-daban
answer_c: Ku nemi ɗalibai su samar da taswira mai nuna ra'ayi a kan allo wadda ke bayyana dangantakar waɗannan ra'ayoyin: nucleus, shell, electrons, protons, neutrons, ions, cations, da anions
answer_d: Ka buƙaci ɗalibai su kwatanta tsarin kwayar halitta ta sodium mai daidaituwa da tsarin sodium a matsayin ion, la'akari da adadin protons, electrons, da neutrons na kowannen su.

question: Malama tana koyar da darasin Tsarin Kariya na Jiki ga ɗalibai na aji bakwai. A ɗaya daga cikin ajujuwan, tana shirin koyar da wannan manufa: "Fahimtar yadda shingen kariya na uku yake aiki." Wane banbanci ne yake da matuƙar muhimmanci ɗalibai su fahimta kafin ta kai ga manufar darasin da aka shirya?
answer_a: tsakanin rigakafin jiki da abin yake gogayya da shi (antigen)
answer_b: Tsakanin ayyukan B da T lymphocytes
answer_c: Tsakanin juriya da ƙwaƙwalwar garkuwar jiki
answer_d: Tsakanin kariya mai sauƙi da ta halitta

question: Malamin aji na bakwai yana shirin darasi don sashin Karrarrafa, wanda aka tsara don bayyana ma'anar karfin bazara, ko dokar Hooke. Wace daga cikin waɗannan ilimin da aka riga aka koya ake bukata ga ɗalibai su samu don fahimtar wannan doka?
answer_a: Wakilcin girman, shugabancin, da ma'anar karfi
answer_b: Alaƙa tsakanin ƙarfin nauyi da murɗewar da jiki ke fuskanta
answer_c: Banbanci na ɗanɗano ko ƙarfin dawo da yanayin da wasu kayayyaki ke fuskanta
answer_d: Gane tasirin ƙarfi a kan siffa da motsin jikin abubuwa

question: Malami na tsara wata kimantawa ta rubutu ta ƙarshe ga aji na 7 domin tattara shaida game da matakin cimma waɗannan manufofin koyo: "Bayyana halayen gas mai manufa a yanayin rayuwa na yau da kullum, tare da la'akari da dokokin da ke bayyana shi." Wanne daga cikin alamomin masu zuwa ne ke nuna cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Suna amfani da ka'idojin Boyle, Gay-Lussac, da Charles a misalai na yau da kullum, ta hanyar kwatanta ingancinsu.
answer_b: Suna fassara zane-zane, suna kafa alaƙa tsakanin ma'aunan matsi da zafin jiki na gas
answer_c: Suna gano girman kundin iska da zafin sa a rayuwar yau da kullum
answer_d: Suna lissafa ƙimar zafin jiki, murajin sarari, da matsin lamba na gas, ta amfani da dabarar dokokin gas mai kyau a cikin al'amuran yau da kullum

question: Wani malami wacce ta rufe darasin Wutar Lantarki da ajin 5 za ta gudanar da jarabawa; a tsakanin wasu abubuwa, tana fatan tabbatar da cikar wannan mai nuna alama: "Bambance kayayyakin da ke gudanar da wuta (conductors) daga wadanda ba sa gudanar da wuta (insulators) ta lantarki". Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke biye ya dace da wannan mai nuna alama da aka ambata a baya?
answer_a: Ku nemi ɗalibai su lura da aiki da'irar lantarki mai aiki kuma su kwatanta ta da wata wacce ba ta yi aiki ba, kuma su bayyana dalilin da ya sa ta biyun ba ta aiki
answer_b: Ku tambayi ɗalibai su lura da wani ginshiƙi mai nuna kashi na watsa wutar lantarki na ƙarfe daban-daban, sannan su amsa tambaya mai zuwa: Wanne ne daga cikin ƙarfafen da ke kan ginshiƙin zai fi aiki a matsayin mai watsa wuta a cikin da'irar lantarki?
answer_c: Nemi ɗalibai su lura da wani hoto da ke nuna wani mutum yana mu'amala da wayoyin lantarki yana sanye da safar hannu na roba, domin daga baya su amsa tambaya mai zuwa: Me ya sa dole ne mutumin ya yi amfani da safar hannu na roba yayin da yake taɓa wayoyin lantarki?
answer_d: Umurci ɗalibai su lura da hoton wata kewayar lantarki da ba a kammala ba, sannan su zaɓi daga cikin kayayyaki, kamar cokali mai yatsu na ƙarfe, tsefe na filitik, da kuma bandejin roba, wanne ko waɗanne ne zai iya kammala kewayar don fitilar ta kunna

question: Malam/Malamar zai/za ta tantance wannan mai nuna nasara a ajin aji na 7: “Bambance-bambancen sigogin da ake amfani da su don bayyana lamarin girgizar ƙasa.” Wace aiki ce ga ɗalibai za ta ba da damar tattara shaidar cika wannan mai nuna nasara ta tantancewa?
answer_a: A gano cibiyar girgizar ƙasa ta hanyar amfani da bayanan tashoshin sismografi guda uku
answer_b: Binciko girgizar ƙasa mafi girman ma'auni da suka faru a ƙasar Chile da kuma barnar da ta haɗa da su
answer_c: Gano kurakuran fahimta wajen amfani da kalmomin girman ma'auni da tsanani a rahotannin jarida
answer_d: Banbancin da ke tsakanin digiri biyu a jere a ma'aunin Richter dangane da kuzarin da aka saki.

question: Malami, a shekarar farko ta Sakandare, a sashin Juyin Halitta da Bambancin Halittu, yana gudanar da wani aiki tare da ɗalibansa inda dole ne su kwatanta amino acids daban-daban na protein C daga nau'in dabbobi daban-daban kuma su kafa alaƙar juyin halitta a tsakaninsu. A lokacin ci gaban wannan aiki, wani ɗalibi ya tambaya: “Idan abin da ke bambanta halittu shi ne bayanan da ke cikin DNA ɗinsu, menene amfanin kwatanta jerin amino acid na protein?” La’akari da matakin ilimin ɗalibin, wane daga cikin bayanan malamin ne zai warware tambayar ɗalibin?
answer_a: Sunadarin iri ɗaya za a iya bayyana shi a cikin halittun jinsuna daban-daban. Bayanin don haɗa sunadaran an tsara shi a cikin kwayoyin halitta. Saboda haka, ta hanyar gano bambance-bambance tsakanin kwayoyin halittun da ke tsara sunadarin da jerin sinadaran amino na shi, za a iya kafa alaƙar juyin halitta tsakanin jinsunan.
answer_b: Kwayoyin halitta (proteins) suna samuwa ne daga takamaiman jerin amino acids wanda aka ajiye a cikin DNA. Idan aka samu gyara a cikin wannan, zai canza tsarin amino acids na wannan kwayar halittar. Saboda haka, ta hanyar la'akari da yawan bambancin amino acids na kwayar halitta guda ɗaya, mutum zai iya tantance yadda nau'i biyu suke da kusanci a bangaren juyin halitta
answer_c: Sunadarai suna samuwa daga fassarawar kwayar halittar RNA mai ɗaukar sako, wadda ke fitowa daga rubutawar wata kwayar halitta. Ana iya bayyana wannan sunadarin tare da sauyi a cikin jerin karshe na amino acid. Don haka, ta hanyar nazarin waɗannan jerin, ana iya tabbatar da dangantakar juyin halitta tsakanin nau'o'in halittu
answer_d: Jerin amino acid na protein yana dogara ne akan jerin codon da messenger RNA ke da shi wanda aka gina shi daga gare shi. Tunda kowanne codon yana dacewa da jerin nucleotides guda uku, idan aka canza wannan, ana iya samun protein mai jerin amino acid daban da na ainihin protein ɗin. Saboda haka, sanin yawan bambancin amino acid tsakanin nau'i biyu, mutum zai iya tantance yadda suke da kusanci ta fuskar juyin halitta.

question: Ɗaliban aji na biyu na sakandare, ƙarƙashin jagorancin tambayoyin malami, suna nazarin gwaje-gwaje na gargajiya waɗanda ke bayar da shaida game da inda kwayar halitta take da kuma dangantakarta da fenoza (phenotype) a cikin yukariyoti. Daga gwajin canja nukiliya (nuclear transfer) a kan *Xenopus laevis* wanda John Gurdon ya yi, wanda ya ba da shaidar cewa ƙwayoyin epithelial na hanji suna ɗauke da dukkanin bayanan halitta da suka wajaba don cikakken bunƙasar halitta babba, ɗaya daga cikin ɗaliban ya tambaya: “Me ya sa ake amfani da oocyte (kwai) wanda aka cire nukiliya a cikin gwajin, kuma ba wata ƙwayar da aka cire nukiliyar ba?” Wanne daga cikin bayanan da malamin zai yi ne zai ba da damar samun amsa madaidaiciya ta mahanga wadda kuma ɗalibin zai fahimta game da damuwarsa?
answer_a: Domin don aikin canja wurin nukiliya ya samar da cikakkiyar halitta, kwayar karɓar nukiliyar dole ne ta kasance ba tare da bambanci ba kuma dole ne ta ƙunshi abubuwan bambance-bambance a cikin sitoplasmar ta waɗanda suka sha bamban da na kwayar halitta mai bayar da nukiliya.
answer_b: Saboda oosite kwayar halitta ce da ba a bambance ta ba, wacce ke da ikon haifar da nau'ukan kwayoyin halitta fiye da ɗaya, tun da yake saitoplasam dinta yana dauke da faktocin bambanci da ke kunna zabaɓɓun rubutun asali da fassarar kwayoyin halittar da ke cikin ginin kwayar da aka dasa
answer_c: Saboda sauran nau'ikan ƙwayoyin jiki, kamar ƙwayoyin hanji, ƙwayoyi ne da suka bambanta waɗanda ruwan ƙwayar su (cytoplasm) ke ɗauke da abubuwan da ke haifar da bambanci waɗanda ke ƙarfafa cire kwayoyin halitta waɗanda suke da muhimmanci ga cikakken girman ɗan tayi, abin da baya faruwa a cikin oocyte.
answer_d: Domin jigon ƙwayar halitta ta oocyte—sabanin na sauran ƙwayoyin da suka bambanta, kamar ƙwayoyin hanji—yana ɗauke da dukkan abubuwan bambance-bambance da ake buƙata don kunna takamaiman kwayoyin halitta da ke cikin nukiliyar da aka dasa, wanda ke ba da damar cikakken ci gaban ɗan tayi

question: Malamar sakandare tana bayani game da hanyar aiki ta rigakafin ruwa, musamman nau'o'in kwayoyin rigakafi, sai wani ɗalibi ya tambaye ta: “Me yake nufi idan gwajin kwayoyin rigakafi na cutar virus ya nuna inganci ga IgG amma bai nuna ga IgM ba?” Wanne daga cikin bayanan malamar ne zai bada damar amsa mai sauƙin fahimta kuma daidai ta fuskar ilimi ga damuwar ɗalibin?
answer_a: Wannan yana nufin cewa mutumin yana kan kololuwar matakin tsanani na kamuwa da cuta, domin IgG da IgM sune ƙwayoyin rigakafi na musamman ga kowane nau'in kwayar cuta, kuma ana fitar da su ne kawai a yayin wannan matakin.
answer_b: Yana nufin cewa mutumin yana cikin mataki na ƙarshe na matakin tsanani na kamuwa da cuta, domin kuwa a wannan matakin ne sel ɗin plasma da ke keɓance ga kowane nau'in ƙwayar cuta suka fara samar da IgG da IgM
answer_c: Yana nufin cewa mutumin yana cikin farkon mataki mai tsanani na kamuwa da cuta, domin a wannan matakin ƙwayoyin plasma na musamman ga kowane nau'in kwayar cuta suna fara samar da IgG da IgM
answer_d: Yana nufin cewa mutumin yana murmurewa, domin kuwa IgG da IgM su ne takamaiman kwayoyin rigakafi ga kowane irin ƙwayar cuta, waɗanda ake samar da su a lokacin matakin tsanani na kamuwa da cuta, da farko IgM sannan IgG, inda na ƙarshen yana daɗewa a cikin jini na tsawon lokaci.

question: Malami a makarantar sakandare, a ajin Shekara ta Biyu, yayin da ake koyar da babi kan DNA da kuma rabuwar kwayoyin halitta, yana shirin wani aiki don cimma manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Fahimtar yadda ƙwayoyin cutar kansa ke samuwa." Waɗanne ilimai ne ɗalibai ke buƙatar sani a gabaki ɗaya don magance wannan manufa?
answer_a: Matakai na zagayowar salula
answer_b: Muhimmancin mitosis
answer_c: Tashoshin Bincike na Kewayar Kwayar Halitta
answer_d: Irin nau'o'in canjin DNA da na chromosomes

question: Wani malami a aji na sakandire a ƙarshen darasin Tsarin Jijiyoyi zai tantance manufar koyo ta gaba ɗaya kamar haka: "Bayyana yadda tsarin jijiyoyi ke daidaita ayyukan halitta don dacewa da abubuwan motsa rai na yanayi ta hanyar siginar da jijiyoyi ke watsawa a ko'ina cikin jiki." Wane ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan alamomin ne ke nuna cimma manufar da aka tantance?
answer_a: Suna nazartar zane-zane daban-daban na motsa jiki mai sauƙi kuma su banbanta ɓangarorinsu.
answer_b: Suna bayyana sauye-sauyen da aka lura da su a wasu amsoshin jijiyoyi masu tsanani daban-daban
answer_c: Suna bayyana halaye na tsarin kwayar halittar jijiyoyi (neurons) da ke ba da damar samar da nau'o'in martani daban-daban
answer_d: Suna danganta rawar kashin baya, kwakwalwa, abubuwan gani, da kuma masu aikatawa a cikin tsarin amsawar jijiyoyi

question: Malami a sakandare yana shirya darasi don aji na biyu inda za ta bunƙasa manufa mai zuwa: “Don amfani da dokar kiyaye kuzari a cikin rufe tsarin.” Wane ne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ga ɗalibai ke ba da damar magance manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Suna bada misalai na guguwa (ko karo) inda ƙarfin motsi yake kiyaye shi
answer_b: Suna auna ma'aunan nauyi (masses) da gudun farko da na ƙarshe na motocin da suke karo a kan doguwar hanya mai karancin juzu'i (friction) sosai
answer_c: Suna tantance alaƙar dake tsakanin ƙarfin da aka yi amfani da shi, lokacin amfani, da kuma bugun (impulse) da jiki ya karɓa a ma'auni ɗaya (one dimension)
answer_d: Suna hangen sakamakon karo tsakanin tubalan iri ɗaya guda biyu masu zamiya a inda babu tangarɗa

question: Malamin makarantar sakandare na shekara ta farko yana shirya darasi da manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Don amfani da samfurin igiya don bayyana cewa haske yana juyawa kuma yana lanƙwasawa lokacin da ya bugi mahadar da ke raba nau'in abubuwa guda biyu." A matsayin dabarar hanya don magance wannan manufa, malamin ya yanke shawarar amfani da wata kayan koyarwa da ke sauƙaƙa fahimtar abun ciki. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan kayan koyarwa ya dace da wannan manufa ta koyarwa ta malamin?
answer_a: Sashi na littafin karatu da ke bayyana bambance-bambance tsakanin tsarin haske na ɗigon-ɗigo (corpuscular) da na igiya (wave), da kuma hasashen da kowannensu ya yi game da gudun haske a lokacin karyewar haske (refraction)
answer_b: Kwakkwalwar kwaikwayo ta zamani wadda ke nuna dalla-dalla tasirin da ke faruwa a kan gabanin raƙuman ruwa saboda juyawa da lankwasawar haske a lokacin da ya faɗa kan iyakar sararin tsakanin maƙalatan biyu.
answer_c: Nunin aji na yadda wata katangar haske ta laser ke bugun saman ruwa a cikin akwatin kifi (aquarium), inda za a iya lura da cewa wani ɓangare na hasken yana mantsewa (reflects) ɗayan kuma yana karkata (refracts) a wasu ƙayyadaddun kusurwoyi
answer_d: Simalan kwa-kwakwalwar gudanarwa mai mu'amala inda za'a iya lura cewa idan aka haska katangar haske zuwa kan mahaɗin tsakanin kafofin watsa labarai guda biyu, wani ɓangaren katangar yana tunawa ɗayan kuma yana karkata, kowanne da takamaiman kusurwa

question: A cikin ajin makarantar sakandare na shekara ta biyu, malami yana yi wa ɗalibai bayani game da dokar jawo juna ta duniya. Don ba da misalin tasirin wannan ƙarfin, sai ya gabatar da wani faifan bidiyo na dijital na wata 'ya'yan itace (apple) da ke faɗowa daga bishiya ko kuma wata da ke kewaya duniya. Malamin ya lura da ɗan ruɗani a tsakanin wasu ɗalibai, waɗanda suka kasa danganta waɗannan yanayi da dokar da aka gabatar. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan misalan da ke biye wanda malamin zai yi amfani da shi ya dace don haɓaka fahimtar ɗalibai game da wannan abun ciki, tare da kawar da ruɗaninsu?
answer_a: Ɗaure wani zaren roba a jikin goge sannan ya nuna musu cewa, ta hanyar juyar da gogen daga ƙarshen zaren, yana samun motsi na kewaya. Sannan, ya bayyana cewa ƙarfin jawo-ciki wanda tarkar zaren ke fitarwa yana kama da ƙarfin nauyi a lamarin Wata
answer_b: Ya nuna wani motsi inda aka wakilci sarari a matsayin wani filin roba wanda aka shimfiɗa inda wani abu mai nauyi, wanda ke wakiltar Duniya, ya dulmuya wannan filin, yana sa abubuwa na kusa masu ƙarancin nauyi su faɗi ko su yi kewaye da abu na farko ta hanyoyi daban-daban
answer_c: Yana nuna faɗuwar tuffa ta wurin jefar da ƙwallo; sannan, ya jefa ta a kwance don ya nuna cewa idan gudun farko ya fi girma, za ta faɗi a wuri mai nisa. Bayan haka, ya zana zane a kan allon rubutu tare da yiwuwar hanyoyin da tuffar za ta bi, har sai ta fara kewaya duniyar.
answer_d: Ya yi zane a kan allo na faɗuwar tuffa a sarari, yana bayyana ma'auninta da na Duniya, nisan da ke tsakanin cibiyoyinsu da kuma ƙarfin janyo. Sai kuma ya gyara zanen domin bayyana mu'amalar janyo tsakanin Wata da Duniya, yana canza bayanan da suka gabata

question:

answer_a: Tushen motsi da ƙarfi
answer_b: Daza kuma tsawon igiya
answer_c: Rawa da mita

question: Malamin ajin shekara ta farko ta babbar sakandire yana shirin wani kimantawa na ginawa wanda zai yi a ƙarshen darasi kan alamomin sauti. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ɗalibai ne ke nuna cewa sun fahimci dalilan tasirin Doppler?
answer_a: Suna wakilta a zane mai hoto yadda gaban raƙuman ruwa ke matsawa ko rabuwa saboda gudun mai fitar da su
answer_b: Suna nazarin gudun tushen sauti da kuma mitar sautin da yake fitarwa don hasashen mitar da mai ji zai fahimta
answer_c: Suna bayyana yadda motsin dangi tsakanin mai fitarwa da mai karɓa ke gyara mitar da gabanin igiyar ruwan ke zuwa ga na ƙarshen.
answer_d: Suna gano yanayi a inda mai kallo ke fahimtar bambancin mita saboda gudun da yake matsowa ko janye wa daga mai fitar da sauti (ko haske)

question: Malamin makarantar sakandare, a cikin sashin Al'amuran Sinadarai a Muhalli da Tasirinsu, yana shirin tantancewar ƙarshe na tsarin halayen rage-ƙaruwa. Don yin haka, an saita manufa kamar haka: "Gane matakai na *redox* a rayuwar yau da kullun da tasirinsu a kan al'ummar yau." Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ne zai ba da damar tattara shaida na nasarar manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Yi tunani, ta hanyar rubuta kasida, a kan lalacewar gine-ginen ƙarfe saboda ruwan sama mai guba (acid rain)
answer_b: Yi lissafi, ta amfani da ma'auni na lissafi, na yanayin iskar sadarwa (oxidation states) na abubuwan sinadarai da ke shiga cikin aikin sinadarai na alcolest
answer_c: Daidaita, ta yin amfani da hanyar electron-ion, ma'auni na sinadarai don iskar shakar tagulla (oxidation) a cikin bututun ruwan sha ta hanyar oxygen na kwayoyin halitta
answer_d: Gano, ta hanyar canjin adadin ƙwayoyin hali, adadin ƙwayoyin lantarki da aka canja a cikin ma'amalar sinadarai tsakanin abubuwan da ke cikin batirin alkaline

question: Ɗaya daga cikin manufofin da ɗaliban ajin sakandare na biyu suka yi aiki a kai shine "Shirya da fassara bayanai da suka shafi sifofin sinadarai da na zahiri na mahaɗan halittu." Wacece daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ce za ta ba da damar tantance wannan manufa da aka ambata?
answer_a: Ku isar wa ɗalibai bayanan ma’adanar tafasasshen ruwan hydrocarbons masu tsayin sarkar jere daban-daban kuma ku nemi su bincika ko suna cikin yanayi mai karko, ko ruwa-ruwa ko gas a zafin ɗaki
answer_b: Umurci ɗalibai su binciki zafin tafasawar hydrocarbons masu bambancin tsawon jeri, su tsara su a teburi, kuma su gano ko suna cikin yanayi mai ƙarfi, ruwa, ko iska a zafin ɗaki
answer_c: Ku bai wa ɗalibai bayanai game da wuraren tafasasshen ruwa na hydrocarbons masu tsawon sarƙa-sarƙa daban-daban da aka tsara a cikin teburi kuma ku sa su fassara yanayin da aka gani bisa ga mu'amalar da kwayoyin halittar ke bayyanawa
answer_d: Ku samar wa ɗalibai bayanai kan wuraren tafasawar sinadaran hydrocarbon masu tsawon sarka daban-daban, waɗanda za su tsara a cikin teburi gwargwadon adadin carbon da ke cikin sarkar sannan kuma su fassara wannan hali bisa ga girman ma'amalar da kwayoyin halittar suka nuna.

question: Wani malamin ajin farko na sakandare ya gudanar da wani tantancewa don tabbatar ko ɗalibai za su iya gane matakan sinadarai a cikin abubuwan da ke faruwa a kusa da su. Ƙari ga haka, zai tantance muhimmancin da tsarin karatu ya bai wa ilimin kimiyya. Don yin haka, ya nemi ɗalibansa su nuna mu'amalolin sinadarai da ke faruwa a kusa da su, a cikin ƙungiyoyi. A ƙarshen aikin, ɗaya daga cikin ƙungiyoyin ya gabatar da waɗannan mu'amaloli: mu'amalar sodium hydroxide da hydrochloric acid, samuwar hydrochloric acid daga hydrogen da chlorine, da kuma samuwar carbon dioxide daga carbon da oxygen. Wacece daga cikin waɗannan kalamai na malamin za ta iya shiryar da ɗaliban zuwa ga koyon da aka tantance?
answer_a: Madalla. Yanzu, don Allah ka amsa tambaya mai zuwa: Waɗanne alamomi ne ke da alaƙa da mu'amalar sinadarai da ka gabatar?
answer_b: Aiki mai kyau. Yanzu, don Allah a amsa tambaya mai zuwa: Waɗanne abubuwan da ke faruwa a rayuwar yau da kullum za a iya wakilta su ta hanyar lissafin sinadarai (chemical equations)?
answer_c: Aiki mai kyau. Yanzu, don Allah a amsa tambaya mai zuwa: Waɗanne mahadi (compounds) ne ke haddasa al'amura na yau da kullum da ke faruwa a kusa da kai?
answer_d: Aiki mai kyau. Yanzu, don Allah a amsa tambaya mai zuwa: Wacece daga cikin halayen da ka kawo ake samun ta a ayyukan yau da kullum?

question: Mene ne ilimin farko da dole ne dalibai su mallaka don fahimtar tushen ka'idar Bernoulli?
answer_a: Aiwatar da Ƙa'idar Pascal
answer_b: Aiwatar da Ka'idar Karewar Makamashi
answer_c: Amfani da tsarin yanayin dorewa a cikin ruwa mai gudana a hankali
answer_d: Amfani da dangantakar motsi a cikin ruwayoyi marasa matsi

question: Wata malamar makarantar yara tana aiki a kan wannan manufar koyo mai zuwa daga ginshikin Harshe na Baka: “Fahimtar, ta hanyar sauraro mai da hankali, abubuwan da ke bayyane daga rubuce-rubucen adabi da waɗanda ba na adabi ba, gane muhimman ra’ayoyi, nuna abubuwan da aka fi so, yin bayani mai sauƙi, da yin tambayoyi game da abin da ke ciki.” Don gudanar da kimanta tsari, an saita wannan ma’aunin nasara mai zuwa: Yana fahimtar abubuwan da ke bayyane daga rubuce-rubucen adabi. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka ya dace don samun shaida na matakin cimma wannan ma’aunin nasara da aka nuna?
answer_a: Mai koyarwar ya nuna wa yara murfin tatsuniyar nan "Zomo da Kunkuru" sa'annan ya tambaye su me suke tsammanin labarin zai kunsa
answer_b: Malamin ya gayyaci yaran su kwaikwayi tatsuniyar "Zaki da Bera," sannan ya tambaye su game da darasin da labarin da halayen cikinsa suka koya
answer_c: Mai koyarwa ya faɗi labarin "Dodo Mai Launi" sannan ya tambayi yaran waɗanne launuka ne motsin ran da Dodo Mai Launi ya gane suke da su
answer_d: Malamin ya gayyaci yaran su yi wasan kwaikwayo na labarin "No Laughing, Pepe", sannan ya tambaye su wane ɓangare suka fi so a labarin, kuma ya ƙarfafa su su ƙirƙiri wani ƙarshen daban ga labarin.

question: Wane ilimin farko ne ya kamata ɗalibin ya mallaka domin gane baitocin hendekasyllabic?
answer_a: Gane sinalefas
answer_b: Gane anaphora
answer_c: Gane ƙananan ayoyin fasaha
answer_d: Gane terṣet da kuartet

question: Malami yana aiki a matakin fahimtar karatu na dogaro da tunani (inferential level) bisa ga karanta gajeren labarin nan mai zuwa: Hutun Shekara mai zuwa iyalina suna shirin zuwa wata. Mahaifiyata ta gaya min in gayyaci abokina idan ina so, tabbas, don kar in ji gundura dole ta yi tunani. Gaskiyar ita ce ban ji daɗin hakan sosai ba, ban sani ba, ban taɓa son fita daga duniyar ba sosai, na gwammace in ci taliya (noodles) da miya da cuku. Ko ta yaya, abokina tace za ta so ta tafi, amma ta gaya min tana buƙatar sabon bikini, suna cewa mata a kan wata suna da kyau sosai, amma ban yarda ba. Za mu zauna a Otel Armstrong kuma za mu yi tafiya a kan Pullmanmoon (da fatan yana da bandaki). Zan kawo kankana. Catalina Yáñez Wace tambaya malamin zai iya yi wa ɗalibai don haɓaka karatu a matakin dogaro da tunani?
answer_a: Mene jarumin yake ji game da tafiyar zuwa wata?
answer_b: Yaya tafiyar hutu zuwa wata ya kamata ta kasance?
answer_c: Don so Uwar jarumar ta gaya mata ta gayyaci abokiya?
answer_d: Wane hali jigon ya nuna game da tafiyar a ƙarshen labarin?

question: Wannan tsarin ya dogara ne kan koyon karatu da rubutu a hankali, mataki bayan mataki, tare da bayyanannar koyarwa ta haruffa, nau'ikan silebobi, kalmomi, jimloyi, sannan kuma a ƙarshe rubutu, farawa daga ƙwarewa a fannin fahimtar sirrin harshe zuwa fahimtar rubutu mai sarkakiya, ma'ana, an tsara shi ne a cikin matakan buɗe sirrin karatu (decoding). Wane tsarin koyar da karatu wannan hanyar koyarwa take da alaƙa da shi?
answer_a: Haɗaɗɗe
answer_b: Na dukkanin bangarori
answer_c: Dangane da ƙwarewa
answer_d: Mai alaƙa da mu'amala

question: Cikin ajin uku na firamare, wata malama ta umarci ɗalibanta su maimaita karanta wani gajeren labari wanda aka haska a kan allo. Da farko, suna yin hakan a shirunsu, kowannensu shi kaɗai, sannan kuma da babbar murya, suna kiyaye tsayawa da salon magana da alamomin rubutu suka tanadar. Wane koyo ne wannan aikin da aka yi ya fi tallafawa?
answer_a: Bunkasa sassaucin karatu
answer_b: Ƙarfafa fahimtar karatu
answer_c: Gano wayar murya
answer_d: Gabatar da ka'idodin harshe na taimako

question: Wacece daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ke ba da damar tantance ci gaban sanin sautukan magana (phonological awareness) a cikin ɗaliban aji na 1?
answer_a: Ku ba su waka mai kafiya kuma ku ce su yi atisayen ta don su karanta a gaban aji
answer_b: Ku samar da kalmomi a rubuce, dogaye da gajeru, sannan ku ce su rarraba su bisa tsawonsu
answer_c: Ka ba da waƙa da aka yi a ajujuwa, kuma ka ce musu su maye gurbin kalmomin da aka ja layi a ƙarƙashinsu da gumaka da ke wakiltarsu
answer_d: Ka ba da takarda mai zane-zane daga muhalli kuma ka ce su nuna yawan kashe-kashen kalmomi a kowace kalmar da aka nuna ta hanyar amfani da layi"

question: Wace ce a cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ce ke baiwa damar tantance ko ɗalibai a matakin farko na karatu sun gano foṇem-foṇem (sautukan asali) a cikin kalmomi masu baƙin da ya biyo da wasali kai tsaye?
answer_a: Malami ya ba da kalmar "mariposa" kuma ɗalibai dole su rubuta adadin haruffan sautin da take da shi
answer_b: Malami ya ba da tarin haruffa, kuma dole ne ɗalibai su rarraba su kuma su samar da kalmomi da su
answer_c: Malamin yana wasa "Wasiƙa ta iso" tare da ɗalibai, ta amfani da kalmomin da suka fara da sautuka daban-daban.
answer_d: Malamin ya furta kowace harafa ta kalmar "pala" kuma ɗaliban dole ne su gane kalmar da ta dace da ita

question: Malami ya saita burin koyo kamar haka: "Fahimtar matani na baki don samun bayanai da haɓaka sha'awar duniya." Wace ce daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan da aka tsara don aiki a kan wannan buri ta yi la'akari da mahallin ɗalibai?
answer_a: Biyo umarnin baka don gina samfurin makaranta
answer_b: Saurari labarai game da abubuwan da suka faru da takwarorinsu a lokacin hutun
answer_c: Shiga cikin tattaunawa ta rukuni game da halayen haruffa a cikin labarin da aka karanta
answer_d: Zagaya dakin da rufe ido, kana bin umarnin da abokin ka ya bayar a fili

question: Wanne daga cikin tambayoyin nan ne ya dace don inganta ci gaban sanin hanyar tunani (metacognition) a tsakanin ɗalibai yayin karatun littafi tare da ajin?
answer_a: Ta yaya za ku gano ma'anar kalmomin da ba ku sani ba?

answer_d: Mene ne jigon abin da muka karanta yanzu?
