question: Malamin makarantar tsakiya ya riga ya koyar da ɗalibansa game da dangantaka kai tsaye kuma yanzu yana buƙatar fara koyar da dangantaka kishiya. La'akari da matakin koyo da ɗaliban suke kai, wane ne daga cikin manyan kurakurai da aka saba yi waɗanda suka shafi wannan darasin ya kamata malamin ya yi la'akari da shi domin ya yi hasashe kuma ya magance shi yadda ya kamata?
answer_a: Kuskure a wajen ninka ɓangarori da lambobi masu digo
answer_b: Rudar a wajen nazarin halayen ma'aunan da aka shigar ciki
answer_c: Rude a rarrabe tsakanin bayanan da suka dace da waɗanda ba su dace ba a cikin wata matsala da ta shafi alaƙa ta kai tsaye da ta kishiya
answer_d: Kuskure a wajen gano alakar dake tsakanin mizani mai daidaituwa na gaskiya (direct proportionality) da na saba (inverse proportionality) da kuma yadda ake nuna su ta hanyoyi daban-daban (zanen taswira, alamomi, teburin kimomi)

question:
Manufar koyarwa ta ajin lissafi na aji 7 shine warware matsalar kwaikwayo ta mataki na farko da ke da matsaya (solution) a lissafi mai ma’ana.
Wanne alamar tantancewa (evaluation indicator) ce ta fi dacewa da wannan manufa?
answer_a: Suna warware lissafi na siga x+b=c inda b da c suke lambobi masu adadi gabaɗaya
answer_b: Suna gano ma'aunoni na mataki na farko masu mafita na lambobi gabaɗaya
answer_c: Suna warware ma'a'dodin nau'in ax+b=c inda a, b, da c suke lambobi gaba ɗaya
answer_d: Suna warware matsalolin yau da kullum ta hanyar amfani da lissafin mataki na farko

question: A aji na makarantar tsakatsakiya, malamin yana niyyar gudanar da wani aiki wanda aka yi niyya don ɗalibansa su fahimci dangantaka tsakanin motsawar wuri na siffofi masu girma biyu (2D) da samar da siffofi masu girma uku (geometric solids). Wace ce daga cikin ayyukan da malamin zai iya gabatarwa wa ɗaliban ita ce mafi dacewa don cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Ku lura da jikoki daban-daban kuma ku tantance siffofi masu girma biyu waɗanda ake samar da su daga gare su
answer_b: Motsa siffofin masu girma biyu a tsaye daidai da jirgin da ke ɗauke da su kuma a lura da ƙunshi-ƙunshin da aka samu
answer_c: Motsar da ƙwaƙƙwaran siffofi, ƙayyade fekto na motsi, kuma bayyana matsayin siffar da aka samu
answer_d: Yi amfani da daskararrun abubuwa na lissafi (kamar akwatuna masu kusurwa huɗu, silinda, da/ko firam), sa'annan ka nuna su a 2D, kuma ka tantance siffofin da suka samu

question: A cikin darasin lissafin sarari (geometry) a aji na 6 na makarantar sakandare ta farko, malamin yana so ɗalibai su bambanta tsakanin aikin layi (linear function) da aikin alaƙa (affine function). Sun riga sun san yadda ake zana layuka idan aka ba su ma'aunin su. Dole malamin ya gabatar da ayyuka waɗanda za su ba da damar ganin bambance-bambancen da ke tsakaninsu. Waɗanne daga cikin waɗannan rukunin ayyukan ne suka dace da wannan burin?
answer_a: Ku zana kuma ku lura da layuka masu zuwa: a) Layin ya ratsa ta (2,1) kuma yana da gangara ta 4; layin ya ratsa ta (−3,−2) kuma yana da gangara ta −2. b) Ku tantance mahadar kowane layin da tsayin jigon tsaye (ordinate axis) sannan ku kwatanta su da juna
answer_b:
Nemo ma'adanar layuka masu zuwa kuma ka amsa:
a) Menene mahadar layukan da aka gabatar?
b) Menene gangarowar kowannensu?
answer_c:
a) Zana waɗannan layukan: L1: y=3x + 4, L2: y=3x, L3: y=-2x + 3, L4: y=-2x.
b) Gano maki haɗuwar layukan da axis Y (gagar Y) kuma kwatanta da ma'aunan su daban-daban.
answer_d: Dubi layin da ke gaba kuma kayyade lissafin: a) Zana layin L2: y = -3x. b) Kayyade wurin haɗuwar dukkan layukan biyu kuma ka kwatanta gangararsu.

question: A cikin ajin Sakandare, Malami yana fatan ɗalibansa za su koyi yadda ake warware lissafin mataki na biyu ta amfani da hanyoyi daban-daban. Wanne ne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa zai ba su damar ƙarfafa asashen ra'ayoyin da ake buƙata don cimma manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Ƙarfafa muhimman kayayyaki da rarrabuwar maganganun algebra (factorizations of algebraic expressions)
answer_b: Ƙarfafa ingantattun kayayyaki kuma sake nazarin ayyuka da ƙarfi da saiwa
answer_c: Ku tuna halayen daidaito kuma ku yi amfani da su don warware ma'auni na layi
answer_d: Fasalta ma'amalolin algebra kuma tuna a wane yanayi samfuri daidai yake da sifili

question: Malamar aji na biyu na sakandare ta gudanar da tantancewa game da halayen logarithms da dangantakarsu da iko (powers) da tushe (roots). Bayan ta yi nazarin sakamakon tantancewar, abin ya ja hankalinta cewa, a wata tambayar gaskiya ko ƙarya, kashi 70% na ɗaliban sun yanke hukuncin cewa lissafin: log a·log b=log a+log b gaskiya ne. Wace dabara ce ta fi dacewa don magance wannan matsalar?
answer_a: A gaban allon rubutu, ɗauka cewa tsarin gaskiya ne kuma a yi amfani da shi ga yanayin a=1 da b=10, don isa ga saɓani na hankali
answer_b: Yi nazarin haƙiƙanin jimlar logarithms, log a+log b=log(a·b), sannan a yi kimantawa don auna koyo
answer_c: Ka yi bayani a kan allo cewa a cikin lissafin log a · log b, ba za ka iya raba ta hanyar “log” ba, kuma saboda haka, log a · log b = log(a · b) = log a + log b ba gaskiya ba ne
answer_d: Sake gudanar da wani kimantawa wanda zai buƙaci ɗalibai su nuna siffofin logaritmi, ta hanyar dangantakarsu da ikoki da tushe

question: Wani malami yana da niyyar tattaunawa da ajin makarantar tsakiya (middle school) a kan zane-zanen (graphical representation) tsarin lissafin daidaitawa (system of equations). Don yin haka, yana so ya ƙarfafa ainihin ra'ayoyin da suka shafi batun, domin bai wa ɗalibai damar fahimtar sabon abun da za a koya yadda ya kamata. Wace ce a cikin ayyukan da malamin ya tsara ta fi dacewa da wannan manufa?
answer_a: Nemo digire-gire a cikin jirgin Cartesiya
answer_b: Zanan layin grafi a cikin siffar sigogi ta Cartesian
answer_c: Warware tsarin ma'a'a'i na layi
answer_d: Neman gangara da ma'adanar da aka bayar a cikin daidaiton layin lissafi

question: Malam/Malamar zai/za ta tantance manufar koyo mai zuwa: “A tabbatar da hujjoji na lissafi cewa lambobi masu ɗigo na maimaitawa da na rabi-maimaitawa lambobi ne masu ma’ana (rational numbers).” Wacece daga cikin ayyukan da ɗaliban suka yi a ƙasa ce mafi dacewa don tantance wannan manufar?
answer_a: Bincika daidaito tsakanin lambobi bayan ɗigo masu maimaitawa ko rabin-maimaitawa da kuma gaɓoɓi, ta amfani da kalkuleta
answer_b: Bayanar da kuma tabbatar da hanyar da za a bi don rubuta lamba mai digo mai maimaitawa ko mai maimaitawa wani ɓangare a matsayin rabo tsakanin lambobi gaba ɗaya
answer_c: Sauya lambobin adadi goman masu maimaitawa da waɗanda ba duka ke maimaitawa ba zuwa kasashe ta hanyar amfani da algorithm ɗin da aka koya, tare da bayyana wannan sauyawa
answer_d: Ka bayyana cewa lambobi masu ɗigo masu maimaitawa da lambobi masu ɗigo masu ɗan maimaitawa za a iya bayyana su a matsayin rabo na dukkanin lambobi guda biyu tare da mai rabawa mara sifili kuma ka bayyana wata hanya

question: Wani malami ya yi aiki da ɗaliban ajin makarantar tsakiya tsawon makonni uku da suka gabata kan waɗannan manufofin koyo. Mako na 1: Gano alaƙa tsakanin logarithms, ƙarfi, da tushe. Mako na 2: Fitar da siffofin logarithms. Mako na 3: Warware matsaloli a cikin harkoki daban-daban masu alaƙa da lambobi na gaske, tushe, da logarithms. Don kawo ƙarshen wannan sashi a mako na huɗu, wace dabara ce daga cikin masu zuwa ta fi dacewa don tantance koyo wanda ya inganta?
answer_a: Nemi ɗalibai su gina taswirar manufa a tsarin dijital da ke bayyana alakar dake tsakanin tushe (roots), iko (powers), ko (logarithms). Ɗalibai za su tantance ayyukan da aka gabatar.
answer_b: Aiwatar da ɗan gajeren jarabawa wanda ya yi bayani kan dukkan manufofin koyo da aka rufe a cikin makonni ukun. Sa'an nan, tattara kimantawar kuma a gyara su domin ba wa ɗalibai maki
answer_c: Ku ba wa ɗalibai matsaloli biyu waɗanda ba na yau da kullum ba waɗanda suka danganci abin da aka gani a cikin waɗannan makonni uku waɗanda dole ne su warware su a cikin ƙungiyoyi huɗu. Ƙungiyoyin su gabatar kuma abokan aikinsu su tantance su.
answer_d: A umarci ɗalibai su tattauna amfani daban-daban na tushe, da kafi, da logarithms wajen magance matsalolin rayuwa. Sannan, a wallafa dukkan ayukan a kafafen sada zumunta na makaranta.

question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin tantancewa ne ya fi dacewa don tantance manufar koyo ta Aji 10/11 ‘Nuna ka’idar Pythagorean da ka’idar converse Pythagorean?’
answer_a: Ku tabbatar, da abubuwa masu gani, dangantakar dake tsakanin fadin murabba'ai da aka gina akan kafafun alwatika mai kusurwa daidai da fadin murabba'in da aka gina akan gwanin.
answer_b: Buga matsaloli ta amfani da ka'idar Pythagorean da juyawarta, tare da tabbatar da kowane mataki
answer_c: Binciko alakar da ke tsakanin ƙafafuwa da babban gefen alwatika mai-kusurwa-dama, bisa ga ka'idojin Euclid
answer_d: Bincika, ta amfani da sau uku na Pythagorean, asalin Pythagorean da juyin sa

question: Malami a makarantar tsakiya yana so ɗalibansa su koyi 'warware jimla da ragi na lambobi masu ma'ana'. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin tantancewa ya fi dacewa, bisa ga manufar malamin?

question: A makarantar sakandare, malamin yana so ya yi amfani da ka’idojin ayyukan logarithms ta hanyar hada alaka da sauran fannoni. Wace matsala ce daga cikin wadanda malamin ya gabatar za a iya warware ta ta hanyar amfani da ka’idojin ayyukan logarithms kawai?

question: Malami ce a shekarar karshe ta babbar sakandire tana shirin ajujuwan da ke tafe, inda take sa ran ɗalibai za su fahimci ma'anoni da ke da alaƙa da rarraba na al'ada (normal distribution). Malamar za ta yi amfani da ajujuwa biyu masu zuwa don tattauna abubuwan da aka koya a baya waɗanda za su sauƙaƙa fahimtar ɗalibai game da sabon abun. Wace ce daga cikin jerin-jerin waɗannan ce ta fi dacewa da manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Aji na 1: Fahimtar manufar *discrete random variable* a matsayin aiki wanda ke danganta abubuwan sararin samfurin zuwa ga lambobi na gaske. Aji na 2: Aiwatar da manufar *discrete random variable* don nazarin rabe-raben yiwuwa a cikin yanayi daban-daban
answer_b: Ajin Farko: Fassarar manufar ci gaba da canjin bazuwar. Ajin Biyu: Aiwatar da manufofin aikin yawa da rarraba yiwuwar a ci gaba da canjin bazuwar
answer_c: Aji 1: Kwatanta siffofin rukunan bayanai biyu ko fiye ta amfani da ma'aunan tsaka-tsaki da watsawa. Aji 2: Tabbatar cewa matsakaicin samfura bazuwar masu girman n, waɗanda aka ɗauko daga yawan bayanai, an rarraba shi kusan bisa ka'idar al'ada yayin da girman samfurin ke ƙaruwa
answer_d:
Aji na 1: Lissafta da fassara matsakaicin lissafi na tarin bayanai marasa rarraba.
Aji na 2: Lissafta da fassara karkatar ma'auni na tarin bayanai marasa rarraba.

question: A shekarar farko ta sakandare, wani malami zai koya wa ɗalibansa yadda za su gano adadin tarin duk sakamakon da zai iya faruwa na duk wani gwaji na izgili mai iyaka. A farkon darasin, ya shirya bita na ilimin da aka koya a baya wanda yake da muhimmanci. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ilimai ya kamata wannan malamin ya yi la’akari da shi a cikin bitarsa?
answer_a: Ƙaddara sararin samfurin gwajin bazata
answer_b: Lissafa yiwuwar ka'ida na wani lamari a cikin gwaji na bazuwar
answer_c: Bayyana yiwuwar faruwar wani lamari a cikin gwaji na bazuwar
answer_d: A gano yawan samfuran bazuwar da za su yiwu na wani girman da aka bayar, waɗanda za a iya ɗauka ba tare da mayarwa ba, daga jimilla mai iyaka

question:

question: Karanta wannan yanayi: Malamar ajin firamare na huɗu za ta yi aiki da ɗalibanta kan warware lissafin mataki ɗaya tare da ƙari da ragi, don haka tana son gabatarwa, a farkon ajin, wani aiki da zai kunna ilimin ɗaliban na baya da ke da alaƙa da batun kuma ya taimaka musu su ƙara fahimtar sabon karatu. question: Karanta yanayin da ke biyo baya: Malamin Lissafi a ajin firamare na uku ya fara aiki a darasin aljebra tare da ɗalibansa. Wane sanin da aka riga aka yi ne mafi dacewa don gabatar da wannan darasin?

question: Don Manufar Koyo na Aji na Biyu 'Auna tsayin abubuwa ta amfani da ma'aunan da ba su da ka'ida da ma'aunan da ke da ka'ida (cm da m)', wane aiki ya fi dacewa don tada ilimin dalibai na baya?

answer_b: Bari ɗalibin ya auna abubuwa daban-daban ta amfani da rula

question: A cikin darasin Lissafi, Malamar ta yi niyyar fara sashin da ya haɗa da nazarin surkulle. question: Karanta wannan yanayin: Wata malama tana koyar da siffofin wasu siffofi na lissafi, tana mai da hankali kan halayen da suka zama gama-gari ga dukkan siffofi na wani nau'i. Wace siffa ta gama-gari ta dukkan nau'o'in trapezoid ya kamata malamar ta faɗa wa ɗalibanta?

question:
Karanta aikin da ke gaba: Wata malama ta nemi yara su zana hanyoyi daban-daban a ƙasa don tafiya daga gefen ɗaki ɗaya zuwa ɗayan, suna nuna wurin farawa da wurin ƙarewa. Bayan sun zana su, malamar ta gayyace su su kalli hanyoyin sannan ta tambaya: “Wace ce a cikin waɗannan ta fi tsayi?”. answer_c: Bayyana wasu lambobi daga jerin lambobi na ainihi da aka bayar a cikin siffar lamba goma, kuma ka bayyana tare da tabbatar da hanyar da aka yi amfani da ita
answer_d: Bayyana wasu lambobi daga rukunin lambobi na gaske da aka bayar a cikin surar kaso kuma ka bayyana sharuddan da wannan sauyawar take yiwuwa a karkashinsu

question: Malamin aji na goma sha biyu yana shirin wani darasi tare da burin "Gano yadda ake nuna a taswira (graphically) na aikin juyawa (inverse function) na wani aiki da ake iya jujjuya shi (invertible function) wanda aka gabatar a taswira". answer_d: Aiwatar da tunanin siffofi dangane da wani batu

question: Malamin makarantar sakandare na aji na farko yana shirin darasi wanda manufar sa ita ce 'Gano murabba'in mai'uni biyu ta hanyar zane-zane da kuma alamomi'. Wane ilimin da suka gabata ne ya kamata ɗalibai sun riga sun koya dole don su iya cimma wannan manufa?

question: Malamar aji na biyu ta sa burin ajin kamar haka: “Ku hango abin da zai faru ga wani adadin ruwa idan aka mai da shi wani kwanon daban”. Wace daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ce ta dace ɗalibai su yi domin cimma wannan burin?

question: Malamin Aji na Uku ya yi aiki tare da ɗalibansa kan bayyana ninka a matsayin ƙari mai maimaitawa, kuma ya gudanar da jarrabawa don lura da yadda suke koya. A cikin wannan jarrabawar, ɗalibai sun rubuta ayyukan ninka da aka yi, bayyanarsa ta amfani da ƙarin lambobi daidai, da kuma bayanin aiki na ninka a cikin kalmomi a kowace matsala da aka warware. Bayan ya duba, malamin ya lura cewa ɗaya daga cikinsu ya ba da amsa kamar haka ga ɗaya daga cikin matsalolin: Matsala: Idan ina da kaji 6 kuma kowace kajin tana da ƙafafu biyu, gabaɗaya ƙafafu nawa ne? Amsa: 2·6=6+6=12 "Biyu sau shida". Duk da cewa sakamakon ƙarshe daidai ne, wanne daga cikin waɗannan sharhin martani zai ba da bayanan da suka dace ga ɗalibin don ya fassara bayanan da ke cikin wannan matsalar daidai?
answer_a: Ka cimma lambar daidai, amma akwai wata hanyar da za ka iya nuna matsalar? Yi zane na halin, sannan ka gwada shi da sakamakonka. Akwai wani bambanci?
answer_b: Sakamakonka daidai ne, amma ka tuna cewa a cikin jedawalin ninka biyu sau shida ɗaya ne da shida sau biyu? Su ɗaya ne, amma ba su ɗaya ba a cikin wannan misalin. Ka lura?
answer_c: Sakamakon ya yi daidai, amma kana ganin ka wakilci ninkin ta amfani da dukkan lambobin da ake bukata? Kula da cewa ka rubuta "2 sau 6" ba "6 sau 2" ba
answer_d: Lambar da ka kirga daidai ce, amma ka tabbata ka bi dukkan matakan warware matsala? Yi bita don ganin wane mataki ka baro.

question: Malamar aji na huɗu, wacce ta daɗe tana aiki kan ninkawa (multiplication) na lambobi gaba ɗaya tare da ɗalibanta, na da niyyar gabatar da dabarar ninkawa ta gargajiya (conventional multiplication algorithm) don lissafin ninkin lambobi masu lamba uku da lambobi masu lamba ɗaya. answer_a: Wargaza abin da za a ninka mai lambobi uku gwargwadon darajar matsayin lambobinsa, don a tara sakamakon ninkawar tsakanin waɗannan darajojin da abin da za a ninka mai lamba ɗaya
answer_b: Nuna ma'ajiyin mai lamba uku tare da kayan aiki da za a iya ƙirga, don gudanar da yawan ƙidaya kamar yadda ma'ajiyin lamba ɗaya ya nuna
answer_c: Ƙari na maimaitawa na lamba mai lambobi uku don danganta adadin lokutan da aka maimaita wannan lambar a matsayin abin ƙari da lamba mai lamba ɗaya
answer_d: Yin jerin ninkawa farawa da lambobin gida ɗaya da gida ɗaya, sannan gida biyu da gida ɗaya, har zuwa gida uku da gida ɗaya

answer_d: Yi layin giwaye, suna jera kansu daga mafi girma zuwa mafi karami ko kuma daga mafi karami zuwa mafi girma, bisa ga abin da malamin ya nuna.

question: Malamin aji takwas yana aiki tare da ɗalibansa kan ninka da raba lambobi masu ma'ana. A lokacin ajin, wani ɗalibi ya nuna wannan: "Lokacin da na ninka lambobi biyu masu kyau (positive integers), koyaushe ina samun sakamako da ya fi waɗannan lambobin girma. Shin hakan yana faruwa idan na ninka lambobi biyu masu ma'ana masu kyau (positive rationals)?" Wane bayani ne a cikin waɗannan da ke tafe daga malamin zai ba wa ɗalibin amsa daidai kuma, a lokaci guda, ya sauƙaƙa fahimtar abin da ake tattaunawa a cikin ajin?
answer_a: Tarhon lambobi masu rabo faɗaɗa ne na tarhon lambobi na ɗabi'a; don haka, ninkin lambobi masu rabo ingantattu yana riƙe halayensa. Bari mu nuna a matsayin misali ninkin \(\frac{7}{3} \cdot \frac{5}{2}\)
answer_b: Ta ma'ana, sakamakon ninka lambobi masu inganci ko da yaushe yana da inganci; saboda haka, abin ninka na lambobi masu rabo masu inganci shima yana gamsar da wannan sifa. Bari mu bayyana a matsayin misali abin ninka na \(\frac{7}{2} \cdot \frac{5}{3}\)
answer_c: Samfurin adadi mai kyau ya fi abubuwan da aka ninka girma kawai idan dukkan su sun fi 1 girma; saboda haka, ya wadatar cewa ɗaya daga cikin abin da aka ninka ya zama ƙasa da 1 don wannan ya daina riƙewa. Bari mu yi aiki da samfurin \(\frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{5}{2}\) a matsayin misali.
answer_d: Wakiltar hoto na samfurin rabon adadi masu inganci biyu ya dace da yankewar juna ta zane tsakanin kowane ɗayan abubuwan; saboda haka, sakamakon ya kamata ya zama ƙasa da su. Bari mu yi aiki a matsayin misali samfurin na \(\frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{2}{5}\)

question: Malami/Malamar aji na 7 yana koyar da manufar darajar tsantsa (absolute value) ta lambobi. A lokacin da ake gyara wasu misalai da aka rubuta a allo, wani ɗalibi ya tambayi malamin: “Me ya sa sakamakon yake zama mara kyau (negative) idan akwai alamar mara kyau a gaban darajar tsantsa? Ka ce darajar tsantsa ta kowace lamba kullum mai kyau ce (positive), don haka ban gane me ya sa dole ne hakan ya faru ba.” Wanne daga cikin waɗannan bayanan ne zai amsa wannan tambaya daidai, ta amfani da yaren da ɗalibin aji na 7 zai iya fahimta?
answer_a: Alamar raguwa kafin lissafi na nufin “cikar-juyawar-adadi.” Tunda cikakken daraja (absolute value) koyaushe ya fi ko daidai da sifili, cikar-juyawar-adadin sa koyaushe zai kasance ƙasa ko daidai da sifili
answer_b: Alamar koruwa a gaban wani lissafi kuma tana nufin "canjin alama." Tun da darajar mutlak ko da yaushe ya fi ko ya yi daidai da sifili, canza alamar ko da yaushe yana haifar da daraja wadda ta yi ƙasa ko ta yi daidai da sifili.
answer_c: Alamar korau kafin wani bayani daidai take da amfani da ka'idar alamomi a ninkayar lambobi. Tun da darajar lamuni koyaushe ta fi ko daidai da sifili, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa "ingantacce a ninka da korau korau ne," sakamakon koyaushe zai zama kasa da ko daidai da sifili.
answer_d: Shi alamar korau kafin bayani daidai yake da kasancewar lambar korau kafin baka. Tun da cikakkiyar daraja koyaushe ya fi ko daidai da sifili kuma alamar korau tana canza alamar da ke cikin baka, darajarsa zai kasance koyaushe ya fi ko daidai da sifili.

question: Malamin aji na takwas zai yi bayani kan makasudin nan na Fahimtar ma'anar function da ke danganta masu canji guda biyu ta hanyar wakilci daban-daban a cikin tsari mai biyo baya. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke biyo baya ne ya yi daidai da makasudin koyo kuma zai sauƙaƙa wannan canjin tsarin wakilci?
answer_a: A zana hoton aiki a kan farfajiyar aiki ta siffar Cartesian
answer_b: Wakilta wani aiki ta hanyar teburin ƙimomi
answer_c: Gano nau'in biyu da ke cikin aiki (function)
answer_d: Amsa a lissafin baki magana da take wakiltar wani aiki

question: Malama tana aiki a kan manufa mai zuwa tare da ɗaliban aji na 8: "Fahimtar ƙa'idar haɗawa ta ninka", kuma za ta tsara wani aiki don fara ajin nata. Wace ce a cikin waɗannan ayyukan farawa za ta ba ɗalibai damar su fitar da wannan ƙa'idar?
answer_a: Yanke adadin haɗin-kai duka lokacin da aka yi jifa da tsabar kuɗi biyu
answer_b: Ƙayyade yiwuwar wani lamari da ya shafi jefa tsabar kuɗi da dabba
answer_c: Ayyana sararin samfurin da aka samu lokacin da aka jefa tsabar kudi biyu, ta amfani da ma'aurata masu tsari
answer_d: Tantance sararin samfuri da ake samu yayin jefa tsabar kudi da dara, ta amfani da zane mai siffar bishiya

question:
Wani malamin aji na biyar yana aiki da ɗalibansa kan motsa jiki da suka shafi ƙari na kaso da masu raba daban-daban kuma ya lura cewa ɗalibai da yawa suna yin kuskure kamar haka:

$2/3 + 1/2 = (2+1) /( 3+2) = 4/5 = 3/7$

Idan aka yi la’akari da yanayin da ke sama, wace dabara ce daga cikin waɗannan masu zuwa za ta ba wa ɗaliban damar fahimta tare da amfani da hanyar alama (symbolic method) daidai wajen haɗa kaso da masu raba daban-daban?
answer_a: Samo duka lambobin a kan layin lambobi don tantance nisan su daga sifili, kuma, daga jimlar waɗannan nisa, samu matsayin sakamakon a kan layin. Sannan, gano juzu'in da ya dace kuma a warware aikin.
answer_b: Danganta aikin da wani misali mai gaskiya domin nuna kuskuren. Sa'an nan, yi aiki a kan ci gabansa na alama ta hanyar ƙara girman kowane ɗayan masu haɗawa a cikin aikin don danganta shi da ra'ayin ɓangarori daidai kuma a warware shi da maƙasudi ɗaya gama gari
answer_c: Kara bayyana hanyar haɗa juzu'i masu raba daban-daban, ta hanyar amfani da wasu misalai masu sabbin adadi, domin ɗalibai su fahimci tsarin ta hanyar aiki. Sannan, ka nemi su ci gaba da aikin
answer_d: Gabatar da wata matsala mai ma'ana inda za a yi amfani da lambobin da ake haɗawa da ke cikin aikin, ta yadda ɗalibai za su fahimci tarawa daga haɗa-haɗar abubuwa a cikin yanayi na gaske. Sannan, a nemi su bayyana sakamakon ta hanyar lamba.

question: Malamin aji na 7 yana shirin wani darasi wanda zai yi magana kan manufar "Haɗa kalmomi masu kama a cikin bayanan aljebra." Waɗanne ilimi ne na baya ya kamata ɗalibai sun riga sun samu domin su iya cimma manufar darasin?
answer_a: 1) Yi ayyukan lissafi da lambobi cikakku da kuma lambobin rabo masu kyau. 2) Gano sassan wani juzu'i da kuma furuci na aljebra.

1) Yi aiyuka tare da cikakkun lambobi da kuma lambobin rabo masu inganci.
2) Fassara furci daga harshen yau da kullum zuwa harshen lissafin Algebra, kuma akasin haka.
answer_c:
1) Gane sassan kalma da na bayanin aljebra.
2) Fassara bayanai daga harshe na yau da kullum zuwa harshen aljebra, da kuma juyawa.
answer_d: 1) Warware ayyuka tare da lambobi masu cikakken daraja da kuma lambobi masu ma'ana masu inganci. 2) Wakilta sauƙaƙan maganganun aljebra a zahiri, a hoto, da kuma a alama

question: Malami zai yi aiki da ɗalibansa na aji na 7 a kan manufar koyo da ta shafi fahimtar da'ira a matsayin wuri na lissafi, da kuma ƙirga kewayenta da fadinta. answer_a: Gabatarwa ga lambobi marasa hankali gami da darajar π

answer_d: Dangantakar daidaiton kai tsaye tsakanin kewayen da diamita na da'ira

question: Malami na Aji na 8 na Farko ya yi aiki tare da ɗalibansa a kan wakilci daban-daban da aikace-aikacen ayyukan layi da alaƙa, kuma a ƙarshen wannan sashe, za su gudanar da kimantawa ta taƙaitawa na waɗannan abubuwan koyo. answer_a: 1) Nemi bayanin da yake wakiltar kudin da za a biya idan an sayi goge-goge adadin n. 2) Wace irin alaƙar daidaito ce ke tsakanin canza-canzan farashi da adadin goge-gogen?
answer_b: 1) Samar da teburin ƙimomi da ke nuna adadin kuɗin da za a biya don siyan goge-goge 2, 3, 4, 5, da 6, a jere, idan mahimman suke daidai gwargwado. 2) Wane irin aiki ne—na layi ko affine—ke haɗa mahimman na teburin da ya gabata?
answer_c:

2) Wane abu ne na aikin algebra na baya wanda ya yi daidai da madaidaicin rabon da ke danganta masu canji biyu?

question:
Malamin aji na 8 yana aiki tare da ɗalibansa kan raba maganganun aljebra zuwa sassa (factoring algebraic expressions), ta hanyar wakiltar fannoni da harshen aljebra. Don tattara shaidar tsarin koyon ɗaliban, sun gudanar da kimantawa mai tasiri (formative assessment) akan wannan abun. A lura da martanin ɗaya daga cikinsu game da wani aiki na kimantawar:

Nemi kewayawa P da fanni A na murabba'i (square), wanda gefensa ya kai (x + 2) cm.

·

Ci gaba: P=4 (x+2)=4x+8

Ci gaba: A=(x+2)2=x2+4

Martani: Fannin shine (x2+4)cm2 kuma kewayawar shine (4x+8)cm.

Wanne daga cikin martanin da ke biyo baya daga malamin zai ba wa ɗalibin bayanai masu amfani don inganta aikinsa a cikin wannan tsarin koyo?
answer_a: Duba aikinka, domin ɗaya daga cikin sakamakon biyu daidai ne, ɗayan kuma ba daidai ba ne. Ina ba da shawara ka yi amfani da dabarar murabba'in binomial don gyara shi
answer_b: Ko da yake ka ƙidaya tsawon kewaye daidai, ka yi kuskure wajen lissafin fili, saboda ƙa'idar murabba'in binomial ita ce (a+b)² = a² + 2ab + b²
answer_c: Kodayake ka ƙayyade ƙewayen daidai, ka yi kuskure wajen lissafo fadin. Faɗaɗa (x+2)² a matsayin (x+2) (x+2) don sake samun fadin.
answer_d: Bincika aikinka, domin ɗaya daga cikin sakamako biyu daidai ne, ɗayan kuma ba daidai ba ne. Kara karanta shi kuma ka warware shi, a wannan karon, ka ba da hankali sosai ga kowane ɗaya daga cikin sharuɗɗan algebra.

question: Wani yaro a matakin manya na makarantar renon yara yana wasa a teburin aiki da katunan guda bakwai. Dukkan katunan an zana musu zuciya ja a kansu, amma launin jajinsu ya bambanta daga ja mai tsananin gaske zuwa mara tsanani. Yaron, bayan ya lura da waɗannan katunan, ya jera su daga katin da ke da zuciya ja mafi tsanani zuwa wanda ke da zuciya ja mafi sauƙi. Wace fasaha ce ke ƙarƙashin aikin da yaron ya nuna?
answer_a: Shirya wani tsari
answer_b: Tsara jeri
answer_c: Raba cikin rukunai
answer_d: Yi daidaitawa ɗaya-da-ɗaya

question: Malami/Malamar aji na huɗu (Grade 4) wanda ya yi aiki tare da ɗalibansa a kan dangantakar da ke tsakanin nauyi (mass) da girma (volume) na abubuwa ya kawo ƙarshen darasin ta hanyar gabatar da ƙwallaye huɗu masu girman kamanni amma na kayan daban-daban: roba, yumbu, gilashi, da ƙarfe (steel). Sannan ya/ta tambaya: “Bisa ga abin da muka gani, menene dangantakar da ke tsakanin nauyi da girman waɗannan abubuwan?” Yawancin ɗalibai sun amsa cewa tunda dukkan ƙwallayen suna da girma ɗaya, suna da girman kama (volume) ɗaya, don haka nauyin (mass) ma ya zama ɗaya. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ɗalibai za su iya yi a darasi na gaba don fahimtar dangantakar da ke tsakanin nauyi da girman abubuwa daidai?
answer_a: Shigar da ɗaya daga cikin ƙwallayen a cikin ɗan kwalba da ruwa kuma a lura da ƙimar da aka samu. Sannan a yi haka da sauran ƙwallayen. A ƙarshe, a kwatanta sakamakon kuma a alaƙanta su da kayan kowanne ɗaya.
answer_b: Auna ƙwallaye 4 a kan ma'auni na dijital kuma a lura da sakamakon. Sannan a kwatanta sakamakon kuma a gwada shi da abubuwan da aka yi ƙwallayen da su. A ƙarshe, a kammala game da dangantakar da ke tsakanin sakamakon da ƙarar ƙwallayen.
answer_c: A nitsar da kwallayen ɗaya bayan ɗaya, a jere, a cikin kofi mara awo, kuma a yi alamar girman ruwan da kowacce kwallo ta tada da alkalami na alama a kan kofin. A ƙarshe, a kwatanta sakamakon kuma a alaƙanta su da nauyin kowacce kwallo.
answer_d: Sanya ɗaya daga cikin ƙwallayen a cikin faranti ɗaya na ma'aunin sanda mai sanda (beam balance) sauran 3 kuma a cikin ɗayan farantin kuma rubuta abin da ya faru. Sannan, sanya ƙwallaye 2 a faranti ɗaya sauran 2 a cikin ɗayan, kuma rubuta sakamakon, da sauransu. A ƙarshe, kwatanta abin da aka rubuta kowane lokaci da kayan (material) kowace ƙwallo kuma ka danganta shi da nauyin (mass) kowanne ɗaya.

question: Don Manufar Koyarwa ta Ajin Farko: "Kwatanta da tsara lambobi daga 0 zuwa 20 daga ƙarami zuwa babba da/ko akasin haka, ta amfani da kayan zahiri da/ko manhajar koyarwa", wace daga cikin manufofin da ke ƙasa ce ta dace da manufar koyarwa ta baya?
answer_a: Kiyasta adadi har zuwa 20
answer_b: Karanta kuma wakilci lambobi har zuwa 20
answer_c: Ƙirƙira da warware lambobi har zuwa 20
answer_d: Haɓaka dabarun ƙididdiga a zuciya har zuwa

question: Malami mai koyarwa a aji uku yana aiki kan sifofin adadi masu girma uku (3D figures) tare da ɗalibansa, kuma ya tsara wani aiki don taimaka musu su fahimci ma'anonin fuskoki (faces), gurɓaɓɓi (vertices), da gefuna (edges). Bayan ya bayyana abin da kowane ɗayan sabbin ma'anonin ya ƙunsa, sai ya gabatar da waɗannan adadin 3D: [Hotunan wani dala (pyramid), wani tsani (prism), da wani kwalliya (cube)] Malamin ya tambaye su: “Wanne daga cikin waɗannan miƙaƙƙen siffofi na jiki (geometric solids) ke da gurɓaɓɓi 6 gaba ɗaya?”, inda wasu ɗalibai suka amsa: “Kwalliyar (cube)”. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba zai taimaka wa ɗaliban su fahimci sabbin ma'anonin da kyau?
answer_a: Kammala hotunan 3D da abubuwa na ainihi
answer_b: Gina siffofi masu-girma uku daban-daban daga ragarsu
answer_c: Gano siffofi masu faɗi biyu (2D) da kuma abin da suke daidai da shi a siffofi masu faɗi uku (3D)
answer_d: Bambanta abubuwan da ke tattare da siffofi daban-daban na 3D da aka yi da siminti (ko: kankare)

question:
Wata malamar makarantar renon yara a matakin Aji na Rengo na Ƙarami tana tsara ƙwarewar koyo don aiki tare a kan manufofi masu zuwa:

- Babban Jigon Tunanin Lissafi: “Don samun fahimtar dorewar abubuwa da kuma muhimman mutane, ta hanyar wasanni da abubuwan yau da kullun daban-daban.”

- Babban Jigon Jiki da Motsi: “Don daidaita motsin sarrafawa ta hanyar sanya abubuwa dangane da jikinsu, kamar kusanto da ƙananan abubuwa ta amfani da yatsan hannu da babban yatsa a haɗe.”

Wacece daga cikin waɗannan ƙwarewar koyo ce za ta ba mai koyarwa damar cimma manufofin da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Boye abubuwa masu halaye daban-daban a cikin ɗakin, kuma ka gayyaci yaran su bincika sararin don gano abubuwan da ke ɓoye
answer_b: Ku ba da kwanduna cike da abubuwa na yau da kullum da waɗansu kwanduna fanko, kuma ku ƙarfafa yaran su motsa abubuwan kuma su musanya su
answer_c: Bazu kwantena da abubuwa masu halaye dabam-dabam cikin ɗakin, sa'annan a gayyaci yara su yi mu'amala da su, su haɗa su, kuma su rarraba su ta rukuni
answer_d: Ku bayar da akwatina rufe da ramuka da ƙananan abubuwa waɗanda yara za su iya sakawa da cirewa da hannu

question: A farkon zangon karatu na farko, kungiyar malamai ta matakin Manyan Yara (Senior Kindergarten) a wata makarantar renon yara, suna zabar kayan koyarwa don aiki da yaran bisa ga wannan manufa ta koyo: "A hankali a wakilci lambobi da adadi ta fuskoki biyu: na zahiri (concrete) da kuma na hoto (pictorial)." Wane ne daga cikin kayan koyarwa masu zuwa ya dace da manufar wannan kungiya ta malamai?
answer_a: Akwatuna da maɓallai: akwatunan filastik da maɓallai masu launuka da girma dabam-dabam
answer_b: Lambar takardar yashi: katinan kwali masu girman santimita 15 x 15, tare da lambobi daga 0 zuwa 9 a cikin takardar yashi
answer_c: Takardun aikin lambobi: Jagororin da aka rufe da leda masu ɗauke da atisaye kan lambobi daga 1 zuwa 10. Takarda mai girman 'Letter'
answer_d: Shimfiɗa ta kumfa mai lambobi, da lambobi daga 1 zuwa 9, mai rarrabuwa. Kowane murabba'i kimanin 30 x 30 cm

question: Malamin matakin renon yara zai gudanar da tantancewa ta farko ga jarirai dangane da manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Binciko halayen abubuwa ta hanyar amfani da hankalinsu da motsinsu," a cikin babban jigon Tunani na Lissafi. Wace dabara ta tantancewa daga cikin masu zuwa ce ta dace da malamin don gano matakin cimma wannan manufar koyo?
answer_a: A lokacin shiyya, zaɓi ka kuma samar wa yara kayayyaki masu nau'o'in laushi, kauri, da girma dabam-dabam
answer_b: Lokacin gaisuwa, nuna kuma bayyanawa yara hotunan abubuwa daban-daban bisa ga sifofi: launuka, da girma
answer_c: A lokacin sauyi, nuna wa yaran rukunonin abubuwa daban-daban waɗanda ke da sifofi iri ɗaya kamar launi da siffa
answer_d: Yayin lokacin ayyuka daban-daban, ku ƙarfafa yara su gano abubuwa daban-daban ta hanyar sauraron bayanin siffofinsu: kamarsu da kuma amfaninsu.

question: Malamar aji na 3 ta tantance ɗalibanta don ganin ko sun koyi gane da kuma bayyana ƙa'idoji/tsaruka a cikin jadawalin lamba 100. Daga cikin ayyukan da aka ba a cikin tantancewar, ta gabatar da jadawalin da ke ƙasa kuma ta tambayi menene tsarin jerin da lambobin da aka haskaka suka samar. Wani ɗalibi ya amsa cewa tsarin shine a ƙara 1. (Jadawalin da ke da lambobi daga 1 zuwa 100) Wanne daga cikin kalamai masu zuwa daga malamar ne zai jagoranci wannan ɗalibin zuwa ga cimma burin?
answer_a: Ku tuna cewa muna aiki kan siffofi da jerawa. Ina ba da shawara ku rina ɗaya daga cikin layukan da ke cikin taswirar da launi ɗaya, kuma ɗaya daga cikin ginshiƙan da wani launi. Ku dubi lambobin da ke cikin kowane layi da kowane ginshiƙi. Wadanne lambobi ne suke canjawa a cikin layin? Wadanne lambobi ne suke canjawa a cikin ginshiƙin? Ina gayyatar ku da ku ƙirƙiri sabon taswira tare da siffofin da kuka lura da su.
answer_b: Ku tuna cewa muna aiki ne kan fasali da jerin lambobi. A cikin ginshiƙin da aka gabatar, a ina za ku iya lura da jerin lambobi da ke bin fasalin da kuka nuna a amsar ku? Ina ba da shawarar ku zagaye shi da launi. Yanzu, menene zai faru idan muka yi amfani da fasalin ƙara 17 ga jerin lambobin da ake magana a kai? Ina gayyatar ku da ku nemo waɗannan jerin lambobin a cikin ginshiƙin
answer_c: Ku tuna cewa muna aiki ne a kan tsari da jerin abubuwa. Ina ba ku shawarar ku kewaye da wani launi dukkan lambobin da ke cikin jerin abubuwan da ake magana a kai. Menene bambanci tsakanin lamba ta farko da ta biyu? Kuma tsakanin ta biyu da ta uku? Shin zai kasance iri ɗaya idan kun lissafa shi ga dukkan lambobin da kuka kewaye? Mene ne zai zama tsarin jerin abubuwan da kuka yi wa alama? Ku gwada wannan tsarin da wanda kuka bayar a baya
answer_d: Ku tuna cewa muna aiki a kan tsare-tsare da jerorori. Ku lura cewa a cikin teburin da aka gabatar akwai jerorori fiye da wanda aka haskaka. Waɗanne sauran jerorori kuka gano? Ina ba da shawarar ku yi alama da launuka daban-daban ga jerororin da kuka samu a kwance, a tsaye, da kuma a kaikaice. Wane tsari ne kowannensu yake bi? Yaya suke kama da juna kuma yaya suke bambanta? Me muke kiran irin waɗannan tsare-tsare?

question: Malami yana shirya ajujuwa inda za a koyar da manufa mai zuwa: "Fahimta da kuma amfani da halaye da siffofin da suka shafi da'ira." Tun da ɗaliban suna farkon matakin koyon wannan manufa, malamin ya yanke shawarar farawa da aji inda za su yi kiyasin darajar π (pi) kawai. Wace daga cikin ayyukan da ɗaliban za su gudanar za ta ba su damar magance manufar, la'akari da manufar koyarwa da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Suna neman bayanai kan lambar π da dangantakarta da da'irori da kuma kewayensu
answer_b: Suna warware matsaloli na farko da suka shafi lissafin kewayen da kuma fadin da'ira
answer_c: Suna lissafin kewayen da faɗin da'irori masu ma'aunin radius daban-daban, ta amfani da kusanto ma'aunin lambar π
answer_d: Suna auna kewaye na da'irori masu bambancin radius, kuma suna tantance dangantaka tsakanin kewaye da radius ɗin da ya dace

question: Wata malamar aji na 6 tana shirin wani darasi wanda za a yi aiki a kan manufar koyo mai zuwa: “Don hasashen yanayin sakamakon da aka samu daga maimaita gwaji iri ɗaya da aka yi da dīs, tsabar kuɗi, ko wasu, da hannu da/ko ta amfani da manhajar ilimi.” Don haka, za a raba ajin zuwa ƙungiyoyi na membobi 3 kuma za su gudanar da aiki ta amfani da dīs. Idan aka yi la’akari da cewa ɗalibai suna cikin matakin farko na koyon wannan abun ciki, wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ne zai bada damar magance manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Kowace ƙungiya ta mirgina 'yar caca sau 12 kuma ta rubuta maki da aka samu a kowace jefa. Sai ɗaliban su fitar da ƙarshe game da yanayin waɗannan sakamakon kuma su raba su da sauran ajin.
answer_b: Kowace ƙungiya ta jefa daba sau ɗari da ashirin kuma su rubuta makin da suka samu a kowane jifa. Bayan haka, ɗalibai su fitar da ƙammalawa game da yanayin waɗannan sakamakon kuma su raba su da sauran ajin.
answer_c: Kowace ƙungiya ta jefa kantu biyu a lokaci guda kuma su rubuta jimlar maki da suka samu, suna gudanar da wannan gwajin sau 24. Sannan, ɗalibai su fitar da ƙarshe dangane da yanayin tafiyar waɗannan sakamakon kuma su raba su da sauran ajin.
answer_d: Kowace rukuni su mirgina diis biyu a lokaci ɗaya kuma su rubuta jimlar maki da aka samu, suna gudanar da wannan gwaji sau ɗari da ashirin. Sa'an nan, ɗalibai su fitar da ƙarshe game da yanayin waɗannan sakamakon kuma su raba su da sauran ajin.

question: Malami ce ta aji na shida tana aiki tare da ɗalibai kan wasu atisaye game da ma'auni (ratios). A ajujuwa na baya, ta yi aiki da su kan hanyoyi daban-daban na nuna su. A lokacin ajin, ta lura cewa ko da yake yawancin ɗalibai suna amfani da dacewar ma'auni a cikin atisayen lissafi, ba su fahimci bambanci tsakanin $a : b$ da $a : (b : a)$, kamar tsakanin $1 : 2$ da $2 : 1$ ba, misali. Ta yaya malamin zai iya bayyana bambancin tsakanin ma'aunai biyun domin ɗalibai su kawar da ruɗaninsu kuma su maimaita abin da suka koya a atisayen gaba?
answer_a: Bayyana duka ma'a'unin a matsayin surori
answer_b: Wakiltar kowace rabon ta amfani da grid-grid
answer_c: Sanya kimar rabon rabon a kan layin adadi
answer_d: Amfani da misali na zahiri don bayyana yadda ake amfani da rabo biyu/kowane ɗaya na rabon biyu

question: Malami tana aiki tare da ɗalibai kan ninka tsakanin ingantattun lambobi masu ma'ana. Don yin hakan, ta shirya wani darasi wanda za a magance samfurin tsakanin lamba ta halitta da ingantaccen juzu'i. Dangane da kwarewarta, ɗaya daga cikin kurakuran da ɗalibai ke yi akai-akai game da wannan abun shine rikitar da samfurin lambar halitta da juzu'i da kuma haɓaka shi. Misali, za su warware aikin kamar 10 . 3/4 kamar 10 . 3/10 . 4. Saboda haka, malamar ta yanke shawarar fara darasin ta hanyar magance wannan rikitarwa. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da malamar ta ɗauka a ƙasa ne zai baiwa ɗalibai damar fahimtar banbancin dake tsakanin hanyoyin guda biyu?
answer_a: Nuna a zane kaso uku bisa hudu sau goma sannan kaso talatin bisa arba'in, kana kwatanta waɗannan zane-zane domin gano ko sun yi daidai ne ko a'a
answer_b: Ka yi ƙirar wata matsala mai sauƙi da malami ya gabatar ta amfani da aikin lissafi na $10 \cdot 3/4$ da wata ta amfani da aikin lissafi na $10 \cdot 3/10 \cdot 4$, ta hanyar warware duka biyun da kwatanta sakamakonsu
answer_c: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa haɓaka kaso ba daidai yake da ninkawa tsakanin adadin asali da kaso ba, kana kawo misalai daban-daban waɗanda ke nuna wannan bambanci
answer_d: Canza samfurin lamba ta halitta da kasafi zuwa kasafi wanda

question: Malami yana tsara darussan sashen Geometry; musamman ma, darasin wanda manufarsa ita ce: "A yi amfani da Ka'idar Pythagoras wajen gano tsawon gefuna da ba a sani ba na alwatika masu kusurwa daidai, tare da bayyana matakan da aka bi." Wane ilimin farko ne dole ɗalibai su mallaka don su cimma wannan manufa cikin nasara?
answer_a:
1) Nemo fadin uku-kusurwa.
2) Nemo fadin murabba'i.
3) Warware ma'aunin layi.
answer_b:
1) Nemo tushen murabba'i na lambobin halitta.
2) Nemo fadin alwatiku.
3) Nemo fadin murabba'ai.
answer_c:
1) Neman tushen murabba'i na lambobi na asali.
2) Neman faɗin murabba'ai.
3) Warware ma'aunin layi.
answer_d:
1) Nemi tushen murabba'i na lambobi na halitta.
