question: Malami ya yi aiki tare da ɗalibai a cikin aji a kan maƙasudin: "Fahimtar manufar bambancin kashi." Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin ya kamata malamin ya yi la'akari da shi lokacin da yake tantance abin da aka yi aiki a kai, kamar yadda yake bayyana cewa ana cimma maƙasudin?
answer_a: Gane ƙaruwar ko raguwar kashi a cikin yanayi na mahallin kuma rubuta su a alamance
answer_b: Ka warware matsaloli masu dangane da lissafin yawan kari ko raguwar kaso (percentage) a yanayi na gaske
answer_c: Kwatanta ƙaruwar ko raguwar kaso a cikin yanayi na gaskiya don jagorantar yanke shawara
answer_d: Gane bayanan da ke ba da damar warware matsalolin da suka shafi lissafin ƙaruwa ko raguwa bisa kashi ɗari

question: Malami a aji na 6 yana shirin darasi a kan ginshiƙin maudu'in MA'AUNI. A darasin da ya gabata, ya yi aiki kan ra'ayin fadin wajen jikin siffofi na lissafi, kuma a wannan darasin zai fara aiki kan manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Lissafa fadin wajen siffar kubu, kana bayyana sakamakon a cikin cm² da m²." A farkon darasin, zai tunatar da su dabarar fadin wajen murabba'i, ta yadda, da wannan bayanin, za su iya samar da jagorar aikin rukuni wanda ya dace da manufar da aka bayyana. Idan aka yi la'akari da wannan manufar ilimi, wanne ne daga cikin jerin ayyukan masu zuwa ya fi dacewa ga wannan jagorar aiki?
answer_a: Suna bincika ma'aunin yanki na kubu a intanet sannan su bayyana abubuwan da ke cikinsa. 2) Suna warware matsalolin da suka shafi yankunan kubu, suna ba da amsoshinsu a cm² ko m², gwargwadon dacewa. 3) Suna canza ma'aunin yanki daga cm² zuwa m², kuma akasin haka.
answer_b:
1) Suna gano abubuwa masu siffar kubi a cikin aji kuma su zana zanen buɗewarsu.
2) Suna lissafa faɗin wuri na waɗannan abubuwan ta amfani da dabarar da malami ya ba su.
3) Suna warware motsa jiki da ya shafi faɗin wuri na kubi, suna ba da amsoshinsu a cikin cm² ko m², kamar yadda ya dace.
answer_c:
Suna tattauna jerin ka’idodin lissafi da malamin ya bayar don gane wacece ta dace da fadin fuskokin jiki mai siffar kubu.
Suna gano abubuwa masu siffar kubu a cikin ajin kuma suna lissafin fadin fuskokinsu.
Suna canza ma’aunin fadi daga cm² zuwa m², da akasin haka.
answer_d: Suna gano dabarar fadin murabba'in sarari (cube) ta hanyar buɗe shimfidarsa. 2) Suna gano abubuwa masu siffar murabba'in sarari a cikin aji kuma su auna fadin su. 3) Suna warware matsaloli game da fadin murabba'in sarari, suna ba da amsoshin su a cikin cm² ko m², kamar yadda ya dace.

question: Wani malami yana aiki da aji na biyar wanda manufar koyonsu ita ce kamar haka: “Auna tsawon abubuwa da ma'aunan da aka daidaita sannan a gano ka’idojin sauyawa tsakanin waɗannan rukunonin ma’aunai.” Domin cimma wannan, ya raba ɗaliban zuwa ƙungiyoyi kuma ya umarce su da su gudanar da aikin nan kamar haka: 1) Su yi amfani da ma’aunin zane wanda ke nuna mita da santimita duka, don auna tsawon abubuwa daban-daban a cikin ajin. 2) Su rubuta ma’aunan waɗannan abubuwa a cikin rukunonin ma’auni guda biyu. 3) Su tsara wata ƙa’ida don canza santimita zuwa mita. Sashe na farko da na biyu na aikin sun tafi daidai. Amma, a sashe na uku, wasu ƙungiyoyi sun kammala da cewa don canza ma’auni daga santimita zuwa mita, wajibi ne a ninka da 100, tunda mita ɗaya yana da santimita 100. Idan aka yi la’akari da kammalawar ɗaliban, wane shisshigin malami ne zai fi dacewa don jagorantar su a cikin koyonsu?
answer_a: Ku ce su sake fasalta wata doka don canza daga santimita zuwa mita, suna bitar rubuce-rubucen ma'aunan su kuma suna gudanar da hanyoyinsu a hankali sosai
answer_b: Ka nuna cewa dokar da aka samu tana mayar da ma'auni daga mita zuwa santimita, ba daga santimita zuwa mita ba. Sa'an nan, ka roƙe su su gyara amsar su ta hanyar rubuta aiki na akasi ga wanda aka samu a baya.
answer_c: Ka ce musu su yi amfani da ƙa’idar da aka tsara don su canza tsawon santimita na abubuwan da aka auna zuwa mita, kuma su kwatanta wannan sakamakon da rikodin su na baya, su daidaita ƙa'idar bisa ga abin da suka lura.
answer_d: Nuna cewa ƙarshensu kuskure ne, saboda don juyar da ma'auni daga santimita zuwa mita, dole ne a raba shi da

question: Malamar aji na takwas tana aiki tare da ɗalibanta kan darasin Aljebra, kuma a cikin darusanta masu zuwa, za ta yi magana kan manufar “Don nuna rashin daidaito ta zahiri, hoto, ko ta alamomi.” Don cimma wannan, aikin farko zai mai da hankali kan kunna ilimin da ya gabata don haɓaka wannan manufa. Wane ilimin da ya gabata malamar dole ne ta kunna a aikin farko?
answer_a:
1) Juyawa daga Harshe na Yau da Kullum zuwa Harshen Algebra.
2) Taƙaita Kalmomi Masu Kama da Juna.
answer_b: 1) Ainihin ayyukan kirga da lambobi. 2) Warware daidaitattun lissafi ta hanyar amfani da hanyoyi daban-daban na nuna su
answer_c: Fahimtar ma’anar alamomin >, <, ≥, da ≤. 2) Fassara rashin daidaito ta amfani da ma’auni mara daidaituwa
answer_d:
1) Wakilcin zane na rashin daidaito.
2) Fassarar mafitocin rashin daidaito

question: A Aji na 5, malamin yana ƙirƙirar wannan manufar koyo mai zuwa: Gano wata ƙa'ida da ke bayyana jere da aka bayar kuma take bada damar yin hasashe. Wane ne daga cikin ma'aunai na tantancewa masu zuwa zai tabbatar an cimma manufar da ta gabata?
answer_a: Suna gina hasashe a kan wani tsari da aka bayar
answer_b: Suna bayyana sharuɗɗan jerin abubuwa don nemo tsari a tsakaninsu
answer_c: Suna gina jeri bisa ga wani tsari da aka bayar kuma suna tabbatar da ingancin ginin
answer_d: Suna miƙa jerin kuma su bayyana yadda ake samun adadi daga wanda ya gabata

question: Malamar aji na shida tana aiki da ɗalibanta kan warware lissafin mataki na farko da mai canji ɗaya, ta amfani da dabaru daban-daban. Yayin wani darasi, malamar ta yi bayani kan dabarar rarrabawa da dangantakar ɗaya-da-ɗaya tsakanin rukununan da ke kowane gefen lissafin. Wane ɗayan ayyukan da ke biyo baya ne ke nuna cewa ɗaliban sun koyi amfani da wannan dabarar wajen warware lissafi?
answer_a:
1) Wakilta ma'aunin 14 = 6 + x a zahiri; misali, ta hanyar amfani da ma'auni wanda bai daidaita ba, da kubus 14 a gefe ɗaya da 6 a ɗayan.
2) Gano adadin kubus ɗin da zai daidaita wannan ma'aunin na baya.
3) Bayyana maganin a yaren lissafin algebra: x = 8
answer_b:
1) Fassara lissafin 14 = 6 + x zuwa harshe na yau da kullum, ta amfani da jumloli kamar: "Wane lamba ne idan aka haɗa shi da 6 zai kawo 14?"
2) Nemi lambar ta hanyar amfani da dabarar 6 + 8 = 6 + x.
3) Bayyana amsar a cikin harshen algebra: x = 8
answer_c:
1) A samar da matsalar "Wace lamba ce idan aka haɗa ta da 6 sakamakon zai zama 14?" ta hanyar amfani da lissafi 14 = 6 + x?
2) A warware lissafin da aka gabatar, har a samu x = 8.
3) A amsa matsalar.
answer_d:
1) Yi kwatanci ga matsalar "Idan aka ba ni fensir 6 kuma yanzu ina da 14, fensir nawa ne na fara da su?" ta hanyar amfani da lissafin 14 = 6 + x.
2) Warware lissafin da aka gabatar, har a samu x = 8.
3) Amsa matsalar

question: Wata malama a aji na biyu na makarantar sakandire tana shirin darussan da za ta yi bayani a kan manufar “Jera lambobi marasa ma'ana da kuma nuna su a kan layin lambobi.” Wace jerin ayyuka ce a cikin waɗannan ta dace ga ɗalibai su yi a aji don cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a:
1) Gano matsaloli a fannin lissafi waɗanda ba su da mafita a lambobi masu ma'ana.
2) Nemi tushen murabba'in lambobi firam, sannan ka nazarta ƙimar da aka samu.
3) Kusanta tushen da suka gabata har zuwa kashi dubu, ta hanyar raguwa da ta hanyar ƙari.
answer_b:
1) Lissafa tushen murabba'i na lambobin firam, a kimanin, ta hanyar amfani da kalkuleta.
2) Sanya tushen da suka gabata a kan layin lambobi, la'akari da darajarsu ta kimanin.
3) Sanya tushen da suka gabata a kan layin lambobi, ta amfani da rula da jigwada.
answer_c:
1) Gina murabba'i mai gefen 1 cm kuma ka nuna layin miƙa-kafi (diagonal) ɗinsa.
2) Gina sabon murabba'i a kan layin miƙa-kafi (diagonal) na murabba'in da ya gabata.
3) Ka gabatar da dabarun tantance yankin sabon murabba'in kuma ka gano darajarsa a kan layin lambobi.
answer_d:
1) Nemi Akarin murabba'in lambobin firam ta amfani da algoritam, kana mai kiyasin ƙimar sa.
2) Bincika alaƙar rashin daidaito tsakanin akarorin da suka gabata, la'akari da cewa aikin Akarin murabba'i yana ƙaruwa.
3) Sanya akarorin da suka gabata a kan Layin lambobi, ta amfani da shirin sifofi.

question: Ɗaya daga cikin manufofin koyo na tsarin karatu na shekara ta 1 na sakandare shine kamar haka: Don haɓaka ƙa'idodin yiwuwa, ƙa'idar tarawa, ƙa'idar ninkawa, da haɗin gwiwar duka biyun, a cikin tsari na zahiri, hoto, da kuma alama, da hannu da/ko da manhajar ilimi, a cikin yanayin warware matsaloli. Wace daga cikin dabarun da malami ya tsara za ta sa ɗalibai su fahimci abin da aka yi magana a kai a cikin wannan manufar?
answer_a: Kawo matsalolin da suka shafi lissafin yiwuwa
answer_b: Bada ma'anar tarayya da mahadar saiti
answer_c: Bayyana yadda ake samo fọmaloli ta amfani da zane-zanen bishiya
answer_d: Rarraba lokutan da ake amfani da kowace dabara ko doka

question: Wani malami na sakandire na shekara ta biyu yana shirin wani darasi inda zai fara cimma manufar: “Kirkira da bayar da hasashe kan dabarar girman kubba.” Wace harka ce da ɗaliban za su gudanar za ta ba su damar yin aiki a kan manufar darasin, idan an yi la’akari da cewa sun mallaki ilimin farko da ake tsammani don matsayinsu a cikin fannin?
answer_a: Motsa yashi daga kwallon zuwa silinda da ke kewaye da ita, kuma bayyana rabon girmansu
answer_b: Yi amfani da ƙa'idar Cavalieri a kan mazugi, silinda, da kwallo masu tsayi ɗaya, kuma ka danganta tsarin lissafin kundinsu
answer_c: A riƙa juya siffofin da ke wakiltar rabin da'ira a kai a kai ta hanyar ma'ajin juyawa kuma a tantance ma’aunin girman ƙwallon
answer_d: Lissafa bambancin darajar fadin (area) mazubi mai kaifi (cone) da silinda da suke da radiyo (radius) iri ɗaya kuma a ƙaddara alakar sa da juz'in (volume) kwayar sarari (sphere)

question: Wata malama a ajin shekara ta uku tana aiki tare da ɗalibai a kan aikin exponential function, kuma a cikin aji na gaba za ta yi aiki a kan aikin logarithmic function. Domin yin haka, za ta gudanar da wani aiki na jagoranci wanda, farawa daga furucin algebraic f(x) = log10(x), za su lissafa wasu ƙimar x tare da kimarsu a cikin wannan aikin kuma za su zana taswirarsa, suna tantance yankinsa (domain) da iyakarsa (range) ta hanyar binciken algebraic. Saboda wannan dalili, malamar ta yanke shawarar cike gurbin binciken algebraic ta amfani da wata dabarar salo na koyarwa. Idan aka yi la'akari da wannan manufa ta koyarwa, wace ce daga cikin dabarun da malamar ta gudanar ke haɓaka fahimtar yankin (domain) da iyakokin (range) ayyukan logarithmic functions?
answer_a: Bada yanayi masu kama da ayyukan logarithmic da aka bayyana ta hanyar lissafi, tare da fassara yankinsu da kewayarsu dangane da mahallin da aka bayar.
answer_b: Ku nuna hotunan zane na ayyukan logaritmic daban-daban, kowannensu tare da nasa aikin awo (exponential) na juyawa (inverse), tare da tantance yankin (domain) da tasirin (range) na farko, bisa ga na biyun.
answer_c: Bayyana babban lissafin aljabra na ayyuka daban-daban na logaritm, inda za a nemi ɗalibai su sami yankinsu da kewayarsu, waɗanda aka bayyana a cikin rubutun lissafi
answer_d: A nuna zanen ma'amalolin logaritm daban-daban, kowanne tare da bayanin aljebra nasa, ana nazartar bambance-bambance da kamance-kamance da aka lura da su a cikin yankin shigarwar su da yankin fitarwar su.

question: Malami a aji na shekara ta biyu zai yi aiki a kan manufa mai zuwa: “Nazarin yanayin hoton zane na *function* mai *quadratic* na sigar f(x) = ax² + bx + c, inda a ≠ 0, lokacin da ma'aunan sa a, b, da c suka canza,” yana haɗa shi da jaddadawar manhajar karatu a kan amfani da ICT (Fasahar Sadarwa da Watsa Labarai). Wane daga cikin ayyukan da ɗalibai za su gudanar zai ba da damar magance manufar ajin, la'akari da jaddadawar manhajar da aka nuna?
answer_a: Kimanta masu canji na aikin quadratic, ana nazarin canje-canjensu ta hanyar takardar lissafi
answer_b: Ƙirƙiri wani gabatarwa na dijital da ke nuna parabolas daban-daban a cikin wakilcinsu na lissafi da kuma dangantakarsu ta algebra
answer_c: Yi amfani da manhajar lissafin siffofi (geometric software) don wakilta, ta hanyar surkulle (parabolas), sauye-sauyen alƙaluma (coefficients) na wani aiki mai murabba'i (quadratic function)
answer_d: Nemo ma'aunan wani aikin murabba'i kuma ka zana shi a cikin software na jannati don tabbatar da kasancewar waɗannan ma'aunan

question: Wani malami a ajin sakandare na biyu zai fara aiki tare da ɗalibai kan darasin "akasin aiki." Don tsara darasinsa, zai zaɓi wani kayan koyarwa domin ɗalibai su sami fahimtar darasin. Bisa la’akari da cewa a aji na 8 ɗaliban sun koyi game da ayyukan affine, a aji na ɗaya kuma sun wakilci alaƙar layi a cikin masu canji biyu, kuma a wannan matakin sun riga sun yi aiki a kan manufofi masu alaƙa da aiki mai murabba’i (quadratic function), wanne a cikin kayan koyarwa masu zuwa ne ya fi dacewa da ajinsu?
answer_a: Hoton kibiya na aikin \( f(x) = \sqrt{x+3} \) tare da ƙimarori daban-daban, domin ɗalibai su tantance asalinsu a kowace fitarwa, kuma daga nan za su iya gina ma'anar aikin juyawa
answer_b: Taswirar Kwance-Tsaye da Aikin Kwadiratik, yana bayyana ko'odinatin wasu maki da ke kan aikin, don ɗalibai su fahimci manufar Aikin Sabani bisa tabbatarwa ta Aljebra
answer_c: Jirgin Cartesian tare da aikin layi wanda za a iya bayyana halayen shigarwa ɗaya-ɗaya da na cikawa daga gare shi, waɗanda su ne muhimman ma'anoni don fahimta da amfani da aikin juyawa, bisa ga tabbacin zanen su a cikin jirgin
answer_d: Zana mai kibiya na aikin Affine inda hotuna ke da alaƙa da kowane asalin hoto, domin dalibai su danganta aikin da aka bayar ta fahimta da aikin da ke haɗa waɗannan ƙimar a juyawa, su tsara zato, kuma su sanya su a hukumance tare.

question: A aji na biyu na sakandare, malami ya gano cewa lokacin amfani da ka'idojin logarithms, wasu ɗalibai suna kirkiro misalai suna bayar da daidaito kamar haka: \( \log(a + b) = \log(a) + \log(b) \). Wace dabara ta malami ce daga cikin masu biyowa kai tsaye za ta taimaka wa ɗalibai su gano kuskurensu?
answer_a: Kawo wasu misalai na lambobi masu saba wa juna
answer_b: Karfafa yin aiki da logaritmai
answer_c: Yi nazarin halaye da ma'anoni na logaritim (logarithms)
answer_d: Bayyana logaritmus a cikin tsari na iko

question: Malamar sakandare a shekarar karatu ta uku tana shirin tsarawa ajujuwa inda za ta gabatar da manufa mai zuwa: “Warware matsalolin lissafin sararin samaniya na Euclidean da ke tattare da alaƙar ma'auni tsakanin igiyoyi, mai yanke, da mai taɓa da'ira.” Wane ne daga cikin abubuwan da ke gaba dole ne ɗalibai su riga sun ƙware don cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Kamusancin alwatika
answer_b: Daidaiton siffofi masu kusurwa uku
answer_c: Bangaren da yankin da'ira
answer_d: Wurin da da kuma kewayen da'ira

question: A cikin aji na shekara ta 3, malamin sakandire yana aiki a kan manufa mai zuwa: "Gane lambobi masu sarkakiya a matsayin fadada filin lambobin hakika." A ɗaya daga cikin atisayen, ɗalibi ya gabatar da hanyar aiki mai zuwa: 1 = √-1 - √-1 - √-1 - √-1 - i = i² = -1. Mafi yawan ɗalibai ba su gano matsalar dabaru a cikin hanyar aikin ba. La'akari da wannan shaida, wane abun koyarwa ne ɗaliban suka fahimci kuskure, wanda ya kawo cikas ga cimma manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Fassarar ma'anar √-1
answer_b: Amfani da siffofin tushe da ƙarfi
answer_c: Bambanci tsakanin lambobi masu rikitarwa da suke na ainihi (reals) da waɗanda ba haka ba
answer_d: Fahimtar iyakokin halayen tushe (roots) a lambobi masu rikitarwa (complex numbers)

question: Ɗaya daga cikin manufofin koyo na tsarin karatu na sakandare na Ajin Biyu shine baiwa ɗalibai damar yin lissafi masu haɗa da ayyuka kan ainihin lambobi. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin tantancewa ne kai tsaye yake nuna cikar wannan manufa?
answer_a: Suna banbanta tsakanin lambobi masu hankali da marasa hankali
answer_b: Suna aiki da lambobi masu ma'ana da marasa ma'ana
answer_c: Suna warware matsaloli da suka shafi tushe (roots) a fannoni daban-daban
answer_d: Suna gane lambobi waɗanda ci gabansu na goma shine mara iyaka kuma basu da lokaci

question: Wani Malami a aji na biyu na makarantar sakandare ya yi aiki da ɗalibai a kan wannan manufa: "Ƙayyade aikin jujjuyawa na aikin layi," kuma zai gudanar da kimantawa ta ƙarshe don tabbatar da koyon su game da abin da aka koyar. Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin kimantawa ke nuna kai tsaye nasarar cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Suna ƙirƙiro teburan ƙima don juyaicin aikin layin lamba (linear function)
answer_b: Suna lissafin lissafin da ke da alaƙa da juyawar aikin layi
answer_c: Suna tantance yankin ma'ana da yankin sakamako na ayyukan juyawa na ayyuka na layi da aka bayar
answer_d: Suna warware matsaloli waɗanda suka shafi amfani da jujjuyawar aikin layi (inverse of a linear function)

question: Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan darussan da ake buƙatar saninsa kafin a ci gaba wajen fahimtar rabo na trigonometri a cikin alwatika mai kusurwa ɗai-ɗai?
answer_a: Siffofi masu ƙumba
answer_b: Rukunin ƙa'idar Euclid
answer_c: Kamusanci na alwatika
answer_d: Kusurwoyi a cikin alwatika mai kusurwa daidai

question: Rukunin ilimi na ajin makarantar gaba da firamare suna shirin ƙarfafa fahimtar bambance-bambance bisa ga wannan manufar koyo mai zuwa na babban darasin Fahimtar Muhallin Al'adu da Jama'a: "Gane abubuwan da suka faru masu muhimmanci a cikin tarihinsu na kansu da na iyali, a cikin yanayi daban-daban." Wacece daga cikin dabarun nan masu zuwa za ta ba da damar cimma wannan manufar koyo da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Gudanar da gabatarwa kan iyalin kowane yaro, ana gabatar da mambobinta
answer_b: Ka haɗa a cikin yankin gida kayan aiki da kwantena na samfuran da yaran ke amfani da su a rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum
answer_c: Ku shirya wuraren aiki inda yaran za su wakilci ayyuka daban-daban da suke yi tare da iyalansu
answer_d: A gudanar da zama na da'ira inda yara za su gabatar da sana'ar wani a cikin iyalinsu

question: Dangane da wannan manufa mai zuwa: "Karanta tsare-tsare masu sauƙi na muhallinka, ta amfani da alamomin nuni da kuma rukunonin matsayi na dangantaka," waɗanne ayyuka ne suka fi dacewa don kimanta shi a Shekara ta Biyu?
answer_a: Zana hoton ajin koya da karatu
answer_b: Fassara alamomin tsarin gari
answer_c: Bayyana matsayin wurare a kan taswira da aka bayar
answer_d: Neman tsari (coordinates) na wurare da aka bayar a kan grid

question: Wata malamar aji na 8, a ƙarshen wani sashen darasi, za ta tantance ikon ɗalibanta na zaɓar tushen bayanai, tana la'akari da ingancin su. Don yin haka, tana shirya wani tsari kuma ta tsara alamomin tantancewa kamar haka: 1. Sun gano marubucin tushen. 2. Sun bayyana a taƙaice asali ko yanayin tushen. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin da ke biye, wanda ya dace da abun ciki da matakin ɗaliban, zai bada damar kammala wannan tsarin tantancewar?
answer_a: Suna gano nau'in tushe
answer_b: Suna jayayya akan ma'anar tushen
answer_c: Sun gane nufin tushen da gangan
answer_d: Suna tantance ingancin bayanan daga tushen

question:
Karanta halin da ke gaba:
A jigon Tarihi na Farko na Ajin Hudu, wata malama ta tambayi dalibanta su kwatanta wayewar Maya, Aztec, da Inca kuma su nuna abubuwa uku masu kama a tsakaninsu. Daya daga cikin amsoshin da ta duba ya ce kamar haka:
“Dukansu manoma ne, kuma duk da cewa suna da ajizai na zamantakewa bayyanannu, dukansu talakawa ne saboda ba su da fasaha kamar mu kuma suna zaune a gidajen dutse masu sanyi sosai.”
Wane kuskure ne ya bayyana a cikin amsar dalibin?
answer_a: Ba ya amincewa da ƙimar asali ta wayoyin Amurka
answer_b: Yin hukunce-hukuncen zamani game da wayewar Amurka
answer_c: Bilikta al'adun da wayewar Amurka ta gada ga al'adar yanzu
answer_d: Rikita halayen wata wayewar Amurka da na wata dabam

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: Bayan Malam ya yi wa ɗalibai bayani kan muhimmancin ƙwaƙwalwa a rayuwar mutane, Malamin ya saita manufar koyo na tsara abubuwan da suka haɗa da ƙwaƙwalwa. Domin cimma wannan manufa, an gabatar da aikin bincike kan batun, wanda za a gudanar a cikin darasin sa'o'i biyu, biyu-biyu, a ɗakin kwamfuta. Aikin aji: 1. Gano waɗanne ne abubuwan da suka haɗa da ƙwaƙwalwa waɗanda ke shiga cikin tsarin haddace abu. 2. Ƙirƙiri tsarin hoto (diagram) wanda aka tsara waɗannan abubuwa bisa ga dangantakarsu a cikin tsarin, tare da bambance kowane ɗayansu a sarari. 3. Haɗa zanenka da bayani, gajere gwargwadon hali, don bayyana yadda aka gina ƙwaƙwalwa. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ne ya bayyana daidai ma'aunin tantancewa wanda ya dace da aikin da Malamin ya gabatar?
answer_a: Dalibai sun bambanta kuma sun bayyana ɓangarorin ƙwaƙwalwa
answer_b: Dalibai suna banbanta sassan ƙwaƙwalwa, kuma suna kimanta alaƙarsu ta juna
answer_c: Dalibai suna bambance sassan ƙwaƙwalwa kuma suna nazarin alaƙar da ke tsakaninsu
answer_d: Dalibai suna banbanta ɓangarorin ƙwaƙwalwa kuma suna bayyana kowannensu

question:
Karanta wannan yanayi mai zuwa:
A farkon wani sashin darasi, wani malami ya bayyana manufar saba da yanayi ta hanyar ma'ana. A cikin wannan yanayin, wani ɗalibi ya nemi ƙarin bayani ta hanyar misali.
Wanne daga cikin waɗannan maganganu ne ya dace ya zama misali don bayyana manufar saba da yanayi?
answer_a: Idan muka ci gaba da sa kankara a hannunmu, zai yi sanda, kuma ba za mu ji sanyin kankarar ba
answer_b: Mukan saya shamfu iri ɗaya saboda mun saba da shi
answer_c: Ta hanyar yin ƙarya akai-akai, muna haifar da rashin yarda a wajen wasu
answer_d: Idan mota da aka ajiye a titi ta kada ƙararrawa kowane dare da ƙarfe biyu na dare, a wani lokaci za mu daina damuwa da ita

question: Karanta yanayi mai zuwa: Farfesa Estefanía tana aiki a kan ka'idojin Pavlov da Skinner. Wani ɗalibi ya ambata cewa ya riga ya san su saboda ya gan su a cikin fim ɗin *A Clockwork Orange*. Ɗalibin ya ambaci lokacin da aka sanya babban jarumin ya kalli hotunan tashin hankali a fili a kai a kai yayin da ake masa allurar wani abu da ke haifar da rashin jin daɗi na jiki domin a gyara halayensa. Ta gaya masa cewa ya yi gaskiya wajen danganta wannan yanayin da ka'idojin da aka yi nazari a kansu. Na gaba, farfesar ta yi tambaya mai zuwa: Da wace ka'idar halayya kake danganta yanayin da ka bayyana? Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ya wakilci amsar ɗalibin da ta dace?
answer_a: Ina ganin horo ne na aiki domin maimaita al'amuran tashin hankali ƙarfafawa ce mara kyau wadda zata taimaka wajen kawar da halayen tashin hankali na jarumin
answer_b: Ina ganin classical conditioning ne saboda kallon fina-finan tashin hankali yana haifar da ƙarshen halayen tashin hankali na jarumin kuma wannan martani ne da aka koyar (conditioned response)
answer_c: A cikin yanayin nan, na ga koyarwar gargajiya domin an danganta zaman kallon fina-finai masu tashin hankali da rashin jin daɗin jikin babban jarumin domin ya samu gyara
answer_d: A cikin fage, ka’idoji biyun suna nan saboda an haɗa hotunan tashin hankali da rashin jin daɗin jiki. Wannan ya zama hukunci don kawo ƙarshen halayyar tashin hankali ta jarumin.

question: Malama ta gabatar da ma’anar motsin rai kuma ta nuna cewa motsin zuciya suna da tsanani, amma tsawon lokacinsu ya yi daidai da abin da ya motsa su. Bayan haka, ta nemi ɗalibai su yi jerin sunayen motsin rai. Wani ɗalibi ya ba da shawarar cewa, bisa ga abin da malamar ta bayyana, soyayya tana ɗaya daga cikin motsin rai da ya kamata a saka a jerin. Wane bayani ne daga malamar ya gyara shawarar ɗalibin?
answer_a: Soyayya wata ji ce mai tsanani, har abin da ke kawo ta kullum yana nan
answer_b: Yanayin kasancewa cikin soyayya koyaushe yana buƙatar kasancewar dalilin da ya haifar da shi, don haka shi ma motsin zuciya ne
answer_c: Halìn soyayya ba kamar motsin rai ba ne, saboda baya buƙatar abin da ke jawo shi
answer_d: Soyayya ba ta buƙatar kasancewar abin da ke motsa ta, don haka ba lallai ba ne a ɗauke ta a matsayin motsin rai

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: Wata malama ta yi wa ɗalibanta bayani game da bambanci tsakanin tarbiyyar farko da tarbiyyar ta biyu. Bayan ta yi musu tambayoyi game da waɗannan ra'ayoyin, sai ta gano cewa ɗaliban ba su fahimce su yadda ya kamata ba. Wanne ne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba zai zama aikin da ya dace don sauƙaƙa fahimtar dukkanin ra'ayoyin biyu?
answer_a: A aji na gaba, ta bukaci ɗaliban su yi jerin abubuwan da suka koya daga iyalansu kafin su shiga makarantar yara kanana da kuma wani jerin abubuwan da suka koya a makarantar yara kanana, makaranta ko wasu da'irori da suka kasance a ciki a tsawon rayuwarsu. Sannan ta tattauna kuma ta yi nazarin waɗannan jerin abubuwan tare da su.
answer_b: A darasi na gaba, ta ce su yi jerin abubuwan koyo da suka tuna sun samu a cikin shekaru biyar na farkon yarinta da kuma wani jerin na abubuwan koyon da suke tare da su tun lokacin haihuwa. Daga nan, sai su tattauna tare, su yi nazari, kuma su fitar da manyan ra’ayoyin.
answer_c: A aji na gaba, ta tambayi ɗaliban su yi jerin bambance-bambance tsakanin girma a matsayin ɗa guda da girma tare da ƙarin 'yan'uwa. Sa'an nan ta tattauna kuma ta nazarta wannan jerin tare da su.
answer_d: A darasi na gaba, ta umurci ɗalibai su bayyana inda suka fito kuma su bambanta tsakanin rayuwa a ƙauye da ta a birni. Daga nan kuma, tare za su tattauna bayanan nasu kuma su fitar da manyan ra'ayoyi domin su gina waɗannan manufofi tare da haɗin gwiwa

question: Malami yana aiki kan batutuwan muhawara da ɗalibansa na zaɓi kuma ya gabatar musu da wannan batu: Batu na 1: Wasu masoya suna da kyawawan halaye, Batu na 2: Wasu masu kyawawan halaye maza ne nagari. Wace tambaya malam ya kamata ya yi wa ɗaliban don su warware batun muhawarar daidai?
answer_a: Shin sigalojizim yana da kalmomi uku?
answer_b: Menene faɗin kalmar tsakiya a cikin hujojin?
answer_c: Shin akwai wata saɓani tsakanin sharuɗɗan da ke cikin matakan farko?
answer_d: Shin akwai aƙalla asali na duniya ɗaya?

question: Karanta tsarin tunani mai zuwa wanda dalibin shekarar ƙarshe ta sakandare ya shirya: Manufar makarantar sakandare ita ce kamala. Shekarar ƙarshe ita ce manufar makarantar sakandare. Shekarar ƙarshe ita ce kamala. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ke nuna kuskuren da dalibin ya yi?
answer_a: Syllogism ɗin yana da fiye da kalmomi uku
answer_b: Babban fage ya ƙunshi ƙaramin fage a cikin ma'anarsa ta hankali
answer_c: Girman Farilla ta farko ya fi na Farilla ta biyu
answer_d: Ɗaya daga cikin hujjojin keɓaɓɓiya ce, saboda haka matuƙar ba za ta zama dunƙulalliya ba

question: A cikin azuzuwan darasi na "Tushen Ɗabi'a," malamin yana tattauna ra'ayin halin ɗan Adam a wajen Hobbes da Rousseau. Wani dalibi ya ce ana ƙaddara nagarta ko muguntar ɗan Adam ne ta mutanen da ke kewaye da shi. Wane bayani malamin zai iya bayarwa don gyara wannan kuskuren?
answer_a: Yanayin dabi'a yanayi ne da ake tsammani don sukar gina Jiha dangane da yanayin ɗan adam
answer_b: A Yanayin Halitta, wajibi ne a sami mutane nagari da miyagu don a sami yarjejeniya
answer_c: Halayen kirki ko miyagu na mutane yanayi ne masu muhimmanci waɗanda ke gaba da aiwatar da yarjejeniyar zamantakewa
answer_d: Yanayin halitta wani yanayi ne na hasashe don bayyana yadda nagarta ko mugunta ke tantance irin gwamnatin da ke tasowa.

question: Karanta lamarin da ke biyo baya: Wata malama ta tambayi ɗalibanta su danganta fahimtar haƙiƙa a cikin Plato da Aristotle ta hanyar ra'ayoyi ko ma'anoni. Wace kwatanci da ɗaliban suka gabatar ce ta nuna bambancin da ke tsakanin waɗannan marubuta a sarari?
answer_a: Rai da mutuwa
answer_b: Duniya da Aljannar Kirista
answer_c: Gaskiya da ƙarya
answer_d: Sihiri da kimiyya

question: A lokacin karatun rubutun *Essay Concerning Human Understanding* na John Locke, malamin ya gabatar da niyyar zurfafa bincike kan ra'ayin siffofin ji (sensitive qualities) na ka’idar ilimi, don sauƙaƙe fahimtar sa da kuma ƙarfafa wannan ilimin. Wacece a cikin dabarun da ke biye za ta dace don haɗa shi da wasu ra'ayoyin da aka riga aka gani a cikin darasin kuma ta baiwa ɗalibi damar fahimtar wannan abun ciki?
answer_a: Ka gayyaci dalibi ya sake duba ƙwaƙwalwar azanci (sensory memory) a matsayin wani ɓangare na sarrafa ilimi (cognitive processes) kuma ya danganta wannan ga hujjojin Locke (Locke's postulates), yana kwatanta ainihin ra'ayoyin duka shawarwarin.
answer_b: Ka shawarta ɗalibin ya kwatanta tunanin Locke da tunane-tunane da suka shigo cikin tunanin Descartes (adventitious ideas) ta hanyar amfani da taswirar ma'ana (concept map)
answer_c: Umurci dalibin ya yi nazari a kan ma'anonin tsinkaya da fahimta daga Ilimin halayyar ɗan adam na fahimta (cognitive Psychology) kuma ya kwatanta su da ma'anar Locke, ta hanyar kafa kamanceceniya, bambance-bambance, da tambayoyi
answer_d: Ka nuna wa ɗalibin ya kafa kwatanci tsakanin ra'ayin Aristotle na asali (essence) game da gina ilimi da ra'ayin Locke wanda ya dogara kan bambance-bambancen tushe (elemental distinctions) na kowace hujja (postulate)

question: Karanta wannan shari’ar: Wani malami ya gabatar da wasu ra’ayoyin Jean Paul Sartre game da ‘yancin ɗan adam. Wata ɗaliba ta shiga tsakani don nuna cewa tana ganin yana da wahala a fahimci ra’ayin marubucin cewa babu asalin halittar ɗan adam. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan amsoshin malamin zai iya taimaka wa ɗalibar ta fahimci ra’ayin Sartre?
answer_a: Ba kamar mutane ba, abubuwan da wani ya tsara, misali maƙeri, ba za su iya samun ainihi ba kafin wanzuwar da ake ba su a lokacin da ake ƙera su.
answer_b: Kamar yadda yake ga mutane, abubuwan da wani ya tsara, mai sana’a misali, suna iya samun haƙiƙa da aka riga aka ƙayyade, amma duk da haka, saboda wannan dole ne su wanzu kuma
answer_c: Mu mutane ba wani ne ya tsara mu ba, saboda haka babu wani asali ko ɗabi’ar ɗan Adam da ke gaba da aiwatarwa da kuma fahimtar ‘yancinmu na aiki
answer_d: An tsara mutane ne ta wani wanda ya ba mu damar yin aiki (zabi mai 'yanci); saboda haka, mu ne kawai muke ƙayyade abin da muke bisa ga ayyukanmu.

question:
Yi la’akari da yanayin da ke gaba:
A wani ajin 'Asali na Da’a', malamar ta yi bayanin ra’ayin tsananin damuwa (anguish) a cewar Jean Paul Sartre. Lokacin da take neman misali na ra’ayin daga ɗalibanta, ɗaya daga cikinsu ya amsa cewa: "Tsananin damuwa shi ne lokacin da mutum ya shiga baƙin ciki saboda rashin sa’a a soyayya."
Mene ne ainihin kuskuren da ke tattare da misalin da ɗalibin ya bayar?
answer_a: Kuskure ne a danganta ƙuncin wanzuwa da matakai na ruhi da zamantakewa, domin alaƙa da wasu tana duka biyu tana sauƙaƙawa kuma tana hana tabbatar da kai a matsayin wani aiki
answer_b: Bai dace ba a takaita damuwar wanzuwa zuwa wata lalura ta tunani; wannan fassarar tana ware sanin kai a matsayin wani al'amari na wanzuwa
answer_c: Gaggaruwa ce a haɗa ra'ayin kunci na rayuwa da yanayin motsin zuciya, domin hakan bai fahimci dangantakar kunci da sanin hakkin ɗaukar nauyi ba.
answer_d: Kuskure ne a danganta baƙin ciki na rayuwa (existential anguish) da alamomin damuwa (depression), tunda gazawar soyayya na iya zama turjiya ga 'yancin kai na mutum

question: Karanta lamarin da ke gaba: Malami ya yi bayanin ka'idar Nietzsche game da asalin ɗabi'a, wadda aka kwatanta a cikin 'On the Genealogy of Morality'. Wani ɗalibi ya bayyana cewa yana goyon bayan ra'ayoyin marubucin saboda yana kare ɗabi'ar masu ƙarfi, wadda take adawa da ta masu raunin hali. A cikin zaɓuɓɓuka na gaba, a wanne ne aka yi bayanin kuskuren da ke ɓoye a cikin bayanin ɗalibin?
answer_a: Ɗalibin yana danganta ɗabi'ar masu mulki da 'yancin yin aiki, yana barin sakamakon ɗabi'a na ayyukan
answer_b: Ɗalibin yana zato cewa ɗabi'ar nihilism dole ne marasa ƙarfi su shawo kanta don isa ga Mafi-mutum
answer_c: Dalibi ya rikita sake tantance ɗabi'ar masu rauni da bayyanar wasu halayen mutum
answer_d: Dalibin ya rikita sauyin ƙimar dabi'u da bayyanar ƙarfin hali

question: Karanta yanayin da ke biyo baya: A cikin mahallin darasin nan mai taken "Manyan wayewar zamanin kafin zuwan Columbus", malami, yayin da yake bayyana manyan halaye na tsarin tattalin arzikin Incas, ya lura cewa wasu ɗalibansa ba su fahimci kalmar "tattalin arzikin sake rabawa" ba. Sai ya yanke shawarar sake bayyana manufar, amma a wannan karon ta hanyar misali. Wanne daga cikin misalan da ke biyo baya ya fi dacewa da manufar tattalin arzikin sake rabawa?
answer_a: Ƙaramar hukumar ta mayar wa tsofaffin mazaunanta kuɗin da suka biya bara don kwasar shara
answer_b: Telethon ɗin ya ƙaddamar da sabon gangami don tara kuɗi fiye da na bara, kuma da su a gina sabon cibiyar gyara hali
answer_c: ONEMI ta karkatar da albarkatun da Jiha ta ware domin tunkarar bala'in da kuma sake gina yankin da ambaliyar ta shafa
answer_d: Tushen Hogar de Cristo ya rage kudin gidajen zaman su na jin kai

question: A lokacin raka'ar "Tasirin tsarin mamayewa," wani malami na aji biyar yana so ya tantance ko ɗalibansa sun fahimci tasirin mamayewar a kan ƴan asalin Amurka. Don yin hakan, ya tsara wani kayan aikin tantance fahimtarsu. Wace manuniya ta nasara daga cikin waɗanda malamin ya samar ce ta dace da manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Nemo a taswira al'ummomin 'yan asali waɗanda Spaniyawa suka ci galaba a kansu
answer_b: Kammala, bisa ga teburorin kididdiga, menene tsarin zamantakewa ya kasance a lokacin cin nasara
answer_c: Yi la'akari da abubuwan da suka jawo raguwar yawan jama'a daga cikin tarihai
answer_d: Ku gano, bisa ga majiyoyin zane-zanen gumaka, halayen fafatawar da ke tsakanin 'yan asali da masu nasara

question:
A karanta rubutu na gaba:
[...]Wata rukuni na yara suna karanta wani rubutu mai bayani game da wata ƙabila ta asali (Diaguita) waɗanda ke aikin tukwane. Rubutun yana tare da hoto da ke nuna mata suna niƙa hatsi a turmi, da kuma tukwanen yumbu a gefensu.

Malamar ta matso kusa da rukuni, sai ɗaya daga cikin yaran ya ce:
-“Waɗannan 'yan asalin sun yi sana'ar tukwane.” “Mene ne suka yi da waɗannan kayan aikin?” Malama ta tambaya.
-“Don ƙawata gidaje,” yaron ya tabbatar.
-Malamar ta kalli hoton kuma ta sake matsawa: “Me ya sa kake ganin sun yi amfani da waɗannan abubuwan don ƙawatawa?”
-“Shi ya sa mahaifiyata take sayen su.”
-Sai wani yaron ya ƙara da cewa: “Haka ne, mahaifiyata ma tana son sana’o’in hannu. Muna da su da yawa a gida.” [..]
Aisenberg, Beatriz (gyarawa)
Waɗanne rikice-rikice a fahimtar lokacin tarihi ne suka bayyana a cikin halin da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Tushen wahalar ganewa a cikin abubuwan yau da kullum dabi'ar tushen tarihi
answer_b: Zuciyar danganta ma'ana ga abubuwa da yanayi daga abubuwan ishara na zamani
answer_c: Kimanun wahalar da ke tattare da kiyaye tsaka-tsaki a kan zubin fasaha a matsayin tushen kayan aiki
answer_d: Sha'awar yin game-gamen gaban yanayin da ke gabatar da abubuwan da ke nuna ci gaba

question: A lokacin raka'ar "Tsarin 'Yancin Kai na Ƙasa," malamin ya nanata wa dalibansa na aji na takwas iya yin aiki da ma'ajin bayanai, domin su iya banbance fagen da ke bayyana ci gaban wannan tsari. Wanne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa zai ba da damar cimma manufar da aka sanya wa ajin?
answer_a: Zana daga Tsarin Mulkin Spain na 1812, menene canje-canjen da suka biyo bayan 'yantar da Sarki Ferdinand VII
answer_b: Koyi ra'ayoyin Creoles game da kafa Babban Junta na Cádiz
answer_c: Gano a cikin tarihin rayuwar shugabannin 'yancin kai, matakan da suka tsara tsarin (ko: matakan da suka gina tsarin)
answer_d: Shirya a cikin jawaban Juntar Gwamnatin Ƙasa ta Farko, ka'idojin siyasa da suka goyi bayan matakin.

question: Dalibai na aji takwas sun yi wannan tambaya kan batun "Juyin Juya Halin Masana'antu": Me ya sa ake kiran batun Juyin Juya Halin Masana'antu alhali ba mu ga wani yaki ko bore da zai tabbatar da sunan ba? Don fadada fahimtar takaitaccen tsarin tarihi da dalibin yake da shi, wane irin la’akari ya kamata sabon tsari kan wannan ra'ayi ya yi?
answer_a: Bayyana masana'antu daga mahanga mai dalilai-masu-yawa
answer_b: Ku zurfafa yanayin masana'antu a matsayin jerin abubuwan da ke da alaƙa da juna tare da nasu kuzarin (dynamic)
answer_c: Bayyana sarai mahallin lokaci da Juyin Juya Halin Masana'antu ya samo asali a cikinsa
answer_d: Ƙarfafa nazarin bincike mai zurfi na kafofin game da yanayin ma'aikatan masana'antu

question: Wani malami yana aiki da ɗalibansa na aji na 6 a kan manufa ta koyo kamar haka: don bayyana yankunan siyasa-mulki na ƙasar ta fuskar yanki. Saboda haka, ya yanke shawarar haɗa batun da labarai masu zuwa game da ƙirƙirar yankin Ñuble kuma ya gudanar da bincike kan tushen labarin: Majalisar Dattijai ta amince da ƙirƙirar Yanki na Sha Shida (XVI) na Ñuble. Wannan matakin, wanda yanzu yake shirye don sanarwa a hukumance, zai kuma ƙirƙiri sabbin larduna guda uku. Ƙasar Chile za ta sami yankinta na sha shida. Haka Majalisar Dattijai ta yanke shawara a wannan Laraba bayan amincewa da ƙuri'u 26 na goyon baya, biyu na adawa, kuma babu waɗanda suka ƙi jefa ƙuri'a a cikin matakinta na uku na aikin da zai ƙirƙiri sabon Yankin Ñuble. Wannan matakin, wanda yanzu yake shirye don sanarwa a hukumance, zai kuma ƙirƙiri sabbin larduna guda uku: Diguillín (Chillán, Chillán Viejo, Quillón, Bulnes, San Ignacio, El Carmen, Pinto, Pemuco, da Yungay), Punilla (San Carlos, Ñiquén, Coihueco, San Fabián, da San Nicolás), da kuma Itata (Quirihue, Cobquecura, Ninhue, Treguaco, Coelemu, Portezuelo, da Ránquil). Wane irin bayani game da tsarin siyasa-mulki na ƙasar Chile ɗalibin zai iya cirowa daga labarin da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Sharuɗɗan fasaha don ƙirƙirar yanki
answer_b: Tsarin sararin samaniyar yankin a matsayin wata yanki ta ƙasa
answer_c: Manufofin da ke goyon bayan yankin yanki na ƙasa
answer_d: Matakan mulki na yanki a matsayin raka'ar ƙasa

question: Don yin aiki a kan manufar bayyana manyan akidun sassaucin ra'ayi da yadda ake amfani da shi a wata kasa misali a cikin karni na 19, malami a makarantar sakandare zai nemi a matsayin aikin farawa, a samar da ma'anar sassaucin ra'ayi. Da zarar ɗalibai sun raba aikin nasu, malamin zai ba da shawarar wani aiki na biyu da nufin ƙarfafa ra'ayin. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ne zai ba malamin damar bunkasa wannan mataki na biyu na koyo?
answer_a: Rubuta tarihin rayuwa na wani wakili na ra'ayin 'yanci a ƙasar misali a lokacin ƙarni na 19
answer_b: Ka gwada ra'ayin da ɗaliban suka shimfiɗa da manyan farillan ra'ayin 'yanci na wancan lokacin
answer_c: Ku samar da wani tsari na lokaci wanda zai sanya 'yancin kai a matsayin mahallin tarihi a cikin matakai daban-daban na bunkasarsa
answer_d: Binciki wata majiya ta tarihi domin gano akidun sassauci da ke cikinta

question: Da nufin bayyana manyan sauye-sauyen tattalin arziki a Chile bayan Babban Raɗaɗin Tattalin Arziki na jari-hujja, wani malama ta fara darasi ta hanyar tambayar ɗalibanta: "Yaya aka fuskanci rikicin na 1929 a Chile?" Dangane da amsoshinsu, ta lura cewa yawanci ra'ayin shi ne cewa tsarin masana'antu na maye gurbin kayan shigowa (ISI) shi ne mafita ga rikicin. Don haka, don canza wannan tunani na farko, ta raba musu rubutu mai zuwa domin su yi nazari: Dangane da alkaluman da Gabriel Palma ya bayar, duk da cewa zuwa 1935 sassan ma'adinai - musamman nitrate - ba su farfaɗo ba zuwa matakan 1929, samar da nitrate ya karu daga tan 694,000 a 1932 zuwa tan 1,200,000 a 1935; a lokaci guda, samar da tagulla mai tsafta da ta fitar ya karu da kashi 270%. Sabanin haka, duk da cewa noma ya riga ya farfaɗo da matakan samar da shi na 1929 a 1933, amma daga baya ya tsaya cak [...]. Idan a ƙarshen 1932 akwai ma'aikata 129,000 marasa aiki, adadin ya faɗi zuwa 69,000 a ƙarshen 1933, zuwa 28,000 a ƙarshen 1934, zuwa 8,000 bayan shekara guda, kuma zuwa ƙasa da 5,000 a 1936. Tarihin Chile na Karni na 20, Correa, S. Wane tunani na farko na ɗaliban malamar ke ƙoƙarin canza shi da nazarin rubutun da ya gabata?
answer_a: Wai farfaɗowar tattalin arziki ta fara ne da kafa CORFO
answer_b: Zaton cewa CORFO ta haɓaka tsarin sabuntawar harkar tagulla a Chile
answer_c: Domin fahimtar cewa manufar CORFO ita ce kawar da illoli a masana'antar nitrate
answer_d: Don yin imani cewa saboda ƙirƙirar CORFO jihar Chile ta kawo ƙarshen dogaro da tattalin arziki

question: Wane muhimmin ra'ayi na siyasa na farko ya kamata ɗaliban aji na biyu na makarantar sakandare su fahimta domin tattauna batun tsarin mulkin mallaka (totalitarian regimes)?
answer_a: Ikon zamantakewa na jama'a
answer_b: Koyarwar akidar siyasa
answer_c: Raba ikonin jiha
answer_d: ɗaukakar shugaban mai ban sha'awa

question: Malami yana tsara kimanta darasin 'Fitowar samfuran siyasa da tattalin arziki daban-daban a cikin karni na 20,' kuma ɗaya daga cikin manufofin koyo da za a auna shine a bambanta halayen tsarin mulkin kama-karya na Nazi da na Soviet. Domin wannan manufa, an tsara alamomin kimantawa kamar haka: 1.- Yana gano yanayin tarihi da mulkin kama-karya ya fito. 2.- Yana bambanta darajar da aka ba wa yanki. 3.- Yana gane amfani da farfaganda ta siyasa mai rudani (demagogic). 4.- Yana gane rawar da aka danganta wa al'umma a matsayin mai taka rawa a zamantakewa. Da wane rukuni na alamomi biyu za a iya kimanta manufar koyo da aka gabatar?
answer_a: ɗaya da biyu
answer_b: daya da uku
answer_c: biyu da hudu
answer_d: uku da huɗu

question: Malami yana shirin gudanar da kimantawa na ginshiƙi (formative assessment) tare da ɗaliban shekarar farko ta sakandare don auna cimma burin kimanta tasirin al'adu na duniya (globalization) daga abubuwan da suka gani na yau da kullum. Wacece daga cikin ayyukan kimantawa masu biyowa ya kamata ɗaliban su yi?
answer_a: Tattaunawa game da illolin da zamanantar da duniya ke yi a kan birnin da suke zaune a ciki
answer_b: Taro na tasowa da tunani don tsare lokacin tsarin duniya baki ɗaya
answer_c: Wasan kwaikwayo kan muhimmancin sabbin fasahohi a fannin sadarwa
answer_d: Tasiri na ɗaukar al'adu na waje ga danginsu a shekarun baya-bayan nan a cikin wani rubutu makala

question:
A farkon darasin 'Kalubale na Duniya ga Yankuna', wata malama ta yanke shawarar gabatar da waɗannan kanun labarai ga ɗalibanta don gano ko sun san wasu daga cikin ra'ayoyin da ke tattare da batun:
- Tagulla ta haura zuwa $2.71 kan kowace laba saboda haɓakar da ba a zata ba a China.
- Tallace-tallace a fannin kamun kifi a Chile sun karu da kashi 12% a farkon kwata saboda buƙatar Asiya.
- Masana'antar giyar inabi ta Chile ta sami yabo a duk faɗin duniya: Shin tana kan ganiyarta ne?
- Sashin gandun daji da samar da ayyukan yi. Sama da ayyuka dubu ɗari uku saboda ƙaruwar fitarwa.
Waɗanne ra'ayoyi ne daga cikin waɗannan ɗalibai ke buƙatar sani don fahimtar ma'anar kanun labaran?
answer_a: Almajirantarwa ta duniya
answer_b: Tsarin tattalin arziki
answer_c: Dorewar muhalli
answer_d: shakar tattalin arziki tsakanin juna

question: A cikin mahallin darasin 'Yin amfani da 'yancin zama ɗan ƙasa da tsarukan wakilcin siyasa', malamin aji na huɗu ya raba wannan tushe mai zuwa ga ɗalibansa kuma ya ba su ƴan mintuna su karanta shi ɗaiɗai: A shekara ta 2011, an kafa doka mai lamba 20500, wadda ta ba da damar samar da Majalisun Al’umma na Ƙungiyoyin Farar Hula (COSOC), waɗanda suke da halin ba da shawara kuma za su iya tallafawa wajen cimma manufar yin tasiri a cikin tsarawa, aiwatarwa, da tantance manufofin jama'a na al'umma, na yanki, da kuma gudanarwar kananan hukumomi. Dole ne waɗannan su hadu a kalla sau huɗu a shekara. [Ma'ajin Ƙarƙashin Sakatariyar Ci Gaban Yanki da Gudanarwa (Gyara)]. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan sakamakon koyo za a iya cimmawa da wannan tushe da aka bayar?
answer_a: Gano lokutan shigar da 'yan ƙasa ciki
answer_b: Bayyana ƙa'idar wakilcin siyasa
answer_c: Gane ayyukan ƙananan hukumomi
answer_d: Kwantar da hanyar raba iko ta siyasa-mulki (decentralization)

question: Karanta yanayin aji na gaba: Miss Pérez, malamar Turanci, ta fara sabon kashi na darasi. Ta rubuta "Hutu" a kan allon rubutu kuma ta liƙa hoton tallar yawon shakatawa. Ta nemi ɗalibanta su kalli taken darasin da hoton, su raba ra'ayoyi kan abin da darasin zai kunsa. Sa'an nan, ta nemi su gano nau'o'in hutu daban-daban da aka ambata a cikin tallar, kuma ta tanadi ƙarin ayyuka ga kowane nau'i. Don cike gurbi, malamar ta ba su kayan karatu game da sansanonin hutu na matasa a Amurka, tana tambayar su ko suna da irin wannan a ƙasarsu ta gida. Da zarar sun gama, ta ce za su saurari wata tattaunawa ta wani iyali da ke zaɓen inda za su yi hutunsu na gaba. Bayan haka, ta nemi su yi hasashen waɗanne kalmomi da yanayi da aka ambata a baya suke tunanin za su ji a cikin tattaunawar. A ƙarshe, Miss Pérez da ɗalibanta sun saurari tattaunawar kuma suka duba tunaninsu. Me malamar take yi a wannan yanayin aji da ya gabata?
answer_a: Tana gabatar da sassan batun/jigon karatu
answer_b: Tana gudanar da ayyukan baki a cikin aji don sa ɗalibai su yi tunani a kan maudu'in darasin naúrar
answer_c: Tana amfani da dabarun saurare domin sanin mahallin maudu'in rubutun da kuma zaburar da ɗalibai
answer_d: Tana amfani da ayyukan zahiri domin dalibai su danganta batun da rayuwarsu kuma su bayyana ra'ayoyinsu

question: Me ya sa samfurin duniya yake da amfani a matsayin kayan koyarwa?
answer_a: Saboda yana ba da damar lura da siffar Duniya a zahiri
answer_b: Saboda yana taimaka wajen gane daukakin bangarorin kwakwalwa a lokaci guda
answer_c: Saboda yana taimakawa wajen nazarin latitudin Duniya dalla-dalla
answer_d: Saboda yana baiwa damar gano kowane wuri a duniya daidai

question: Karanta yanayin da ke biyo baya: Wani malamin firamare na aji na biyu ya nuna wa ɗalibansa taswirar yankunan Arewacin, Tsakiyar, da Kudancin ƙasar Chile. Sannan, ya nuna musu hotunan yanayin ƙasa na waɗannan yankuna kuma ya ce su zana da'ira da ja a kan hotunan yankin arewa; da kore, waɗanda ke tsakiya; da kuma baƙi, waɗanda ke kudu. Wanne ne daga cikin manufofin nan masu zuwa aikin da aka yi a baya ya fi dacewa da shi?
answer_a: Rarraba shimfidar wurare bisa ga yanki na labarin ƙasa
answer_b: Kwatanta yankuna na gografiya bisa ga siffofin ƙasarsu
answer_c: Gano halaye na yankunan kasa
answer_d: Gano wurare bisa ga yankin ƙasa

question: Karanta halin da ke gaba: Wata malama tana shirya ayyuka da aka yi niyya don bai wa ɗalibai damar bayyana dangantakar da ke tsakanin Mapuche da Mutanen Sifaniya a lokacin mulkin mallaka. Don cimma wannan, ta tsara wani aiki na farko bisa ga rubutu mai zuwa: A cikin majalisar da aka gudanar a Paicaví a 1605, an kafa cewa mutanen kan iyaka dole ne su biya matsakaicin haraji a cikin kayayyaki, yayin da aka hana hidimar kai. Idan sun ba da mutane don yin aiki a gonakin Mutanen Sifaniya, za a biya su da azurfa ko makamancinta. Bugu da ƙari, dole ne su tafi yaƙi da abokan gaban Sarki. Indiyawa sun amsa da gamsuwa cewa za su kasance cikin salama, saboda Mai Martaba Sarki ya magance cikakkiyar dalilin tawayensu da maganinsa, wanda shine hidimar kai wacce suka yi tawaye saboda ita. An lura, to, cewa a waɗannan shekarun Indiyawan abokai har yanzu suna fitowa daga yankin Indiyawan encomienda. Sun fara, duk da haka, bayyana matsayinsu na musamman -dangane da ƙarni na baya-, tunda ba sa ƙara zama Indiyawa masu zuwa yaƙi tare da encomenderos ɗinsu daga yankin tsakiya na ƙasar, amma Indiyawan encomienda ne daga yankin rikicin ɗaya. A wani ɓangaren, an yi ƙoƙarin rage musu wahala ta hanyar hana hidimar kai, wanda shine babban dalilin rashin gamsuwarsu. Indiyawan abokai a kan iyakar Araucanian, (Andrea Ruiz-Esquide). Dangane da rubutun da ke sama, wane aiki ne zai tantance idan ɗalibai sun gano dangantaka tsakanin Mapuche da Mutanen Sifaniya a lokacin mulkin mallaka?
answer_a: Suna yin fosta da ke taƙaita manufar yarjejeniyar Paicaví
answer_b: Suna taƙaitawa daga wani zane-zane muhimman yarjejeniyoyin da ke tsakanin Mapuche da Mutanen Spain
answer_c: Suna auna dukkan nau'o'in hulɗa tsakanin Mutanen Spain da Mapuche kuma suna ƙirƙira wata katin jigo don kowane ɗaya daga cikinsu
answer_d: Sun gano majalisar Paicaví kuma sun bayyana yadda iyakar da ke tsakanin ƙungiyoyin biyu ta canza a tsawon lokaci

question:
Karanta yanayi mai zuwa:
A ƙarshen sashin karatu na “Gadon Athens,” ɗaya daga cikin manufofin da malamin ya ke so ya tantance shine fahimtar manyan siffofin dimokuraɗiyyar Athens, kuma don duba matakin nasarar, ya nemi ɗalibansa su tsara ginshiƙi na kwatanci tsakanin dimokuraɗiyyar Athens da dimokuraɗiyyar ƙasar Chile ta yanzu. Don tantance amsoshin, ya shirya jagora bisa ga abubuwan da ke da ci gaba a tarihi da kuma waɗanda ba su da shi.
Wanne daga cikin alamomin tantancewa masu zuwa ne ke nuna amincewa da wani abu na canji tsakanin dimokuraɗiyyun nan biyu?
answer_a: Gano kasancewar tsarin iko na hukumomi
answer_b: Gane bambancin ayyukan gwamnati
answer_c: Gano matakin shiga cikin yanke shawarar gwamnati
answer_d: Yana amincewa da haƙƙin zama ɗan ƙasa bisa ga cika sharaɗi

question: Malamin Falsafa yana shirin gudanar da aji a kan ma'anar yanayin dabi'a daga ra'ayoyin J. Locke, T. Hobbes, da J.J. Rousseau, kuma manufar wannan shiri ita ce: "Don gwada waɗannan ka'idoji da halayen mutum na dabi'a (mai 'yanci, mai hankali, da mai son zama da jama'a)." Wace daga cikin ayyukan da malamin ya gabatar za ta ba wa ɗalibansa damar cimma manufar wannan aji?
answer_a: Ɗalibai suna binciken manufar yanayin halitta a kowane marubuci, sannan su kai wa malami rahoton abin da suka gano.
answer_b: Dalibai suna nazarin dangantakar Hauwa’i ta Ingila da Yanayin Halitta bisa ga fahimtar ɗan Adam
answer_c: Dalibai suna tattara bayanai a kan dabi'un halittar ɗan Adam, kuma suna rubuta su a littattafansu
answer_d: Daliban sun karanta wata takarda game da ra'ayoyin kowane marubuci a kan yanayin dabi'a, kuma suka gano bambance-bambancensu da kamance-kamancensu.

question: Malami yana aiki tare da ɗaliban shekarar ƙarshe na sakandire a kan tsarin siyasa na J. J. Rousseau, tare da mai da hankali musamman a kan ra'ayin nufin gaba ɗaya, wanda masanin falsafar Faransa ya yi amfani da shi a cikin littafinsa The Social Contract (Yarjejeniyar Jama'a) (1762). Wanne ne a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ke wakiltar misali mai dacewa don kwatanta ra'ayin nufin gaba ɗaya ga waɗannan ɗalibai?
answer_a: Zabɓin rinjaye mai sauƙi don yanke shawarar shugabancin ajin
answer_b: Halartar dukkanin ɗaliban makarantar da ma'aikatan koyarwa don cimma yarjejeniya
answer_c: Neman ƙarin taimakon karatu don ajin, duk da cewa akwai ɗaliban da ba sa bukatarsa
answer_d: Tattaunawa tsakanin ɗalibai masu ra'ayoyi daban-daban don cimma matsaya a cikin ajin makaranta

question: Karanta lamarin da ke gaba: A cikin aji game da Falsafar Ra'ayoyin Plato, Farfesa ya yi bayanin manyan halayen ra'ayoyin Platonic, daga cikinsu ya nuna cewa 'kowane ra'ayi guda ɗaya ne, kasancewar shi wakilcin abin da yake jigo ga rukuni na abubuwa'. Wani ɗalibi, da yake ruduwa da wannan magana, ya amsa cewa hakan ba zai yiwu ba kuma ya ba da misali cewa mutane biyu suna tunanin ra'ayi ɗaya, wani yanayi da ya saɓa wa zato na guda ɗaya na ra'ayin. Idan aka yi la'akari da Falsafar Ra'ayoyin Plato, wace zaɓi ce ta bayyana ma'anar da ke tattare da kuskuren ɗalibin?
answer_a: Ɗalibi yana tsammani cewa ra'ayoyi suke fitowa daga tattaunawa
answer_b: Dalibi ya gane cewa tunani haƙiƙa ne na basira
answer_c: Dalibi yana ganin cewa ra'ayoyi suna da dangantaka
answer_d: Dalibi yana tunani cewa ra'ayoyi wani ɓangare ne na Duniya mai hankali.

question: A cikin wani aji na babbar makarantar sakandare game da Tarihin Falsafa, wata malama da ɗalibanta suna nazarin muhimman ra'ayoyin falsafa na R. Descartes. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan maganganun ya yi daidai da wata wahala da ɗalibai za su iya fuskanta, dangane da fahimtar furucin cewa “Ina tunani, don haka ina wanzuwa”?
answer_a: Yanke wanzuwar tunanin Descartes
answer_b: Haɗa wanzuwa da yin amfani da shakka mai bin tsari
answer_c: Tilasta tunanin wanzuwa yana ƙarƙashin aikin tunani na cogito
answer_d: Danganta wanzuwar res cogitans da wanzuwar res extensa

question: Malami yana yi wa ɗalibansa na ajin uku na sakandare bayanin tsarin ilimin azanci. Wane daga cikin waɗannan manufofi ne ɗalibai suke buƙatar su riga sun yi maganarsu a baya don su fahimci ra'ayin fahimta?
answer_a: Kwarewa
answer_b: Jin
answer_c: Gaskiya
answer_d: Hankali

question: A sashin Makarantar Tsakiya: Halayyar Siyasa, Malamin zai yi aiki a kan kalaman da T. Hobbes ya yaɗa: "homo homini lupus". Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan ra’ayoyi ne ya kamata ɗalibai su riga sun sani don fahimtar maganar da aka yi?
answer_a: Doka ta yi rinjaye
answer_b: Kwantiragin zamantakewa
answer_c: Dukiya ta kashin kai (ko: Mulki na kashin kai)
answer_d: Yanayin halitta

question: Wani malamin makarantar sakandare yana shirya darasi kan ka’idar Kant game da yiwuwar ilimi; don yin haka, dole ne ya tantance ilimin gabanin da yake wajibi domin ɗalibansa su iya magance irin wannan ka’idar yadda ya kamata. Wane ilimin gabanin ne malamin ya kamata ya gane a cikin ɗalibansa domin su iya tunkarar wannan ka’idar?
answer_a: Ku gane ra'ayoyin D. Hume da J. Locke a matsayin tushen ka'idojin da suka gabaci shawarar I. Kant
answer_b: Fahimci ra'ayin Ingilishi na dogmatism da empiricism a matsayin rafi da suka gabaci shawarar Kant
answer_c: Bincika ra'ayoyin lokaci da sarari a matsayin tsare-tsaren tunani da suka zama dole don sani, a cewar I. Kant
answer_d: Fahimci ma'anonin abu mai bayyana (phenomenon) da kuma abu na asali (noumenon) a matsayin bayanai irin na Kant game da abin da za a iya sani

question: A karkashin tsarin kimantawa dangane da manyan ra'ayoyin Plato, malamin Falsafa yana nufin tantance wannan manufa: "Fahimtar ka'idar shigar kasancewa (na halitta) a falsafar Plato." Wane alamar kimantawa ce ta yi daidai da wannan manufa da aka ambata?
answer_a: Bambanta tsakanin manufofin episteme da doxa
answer_b: Shirya ra'ayoyin Plato bisa ga darajojin kamala
answer_c: Gano nau'ukan rai guda uku a tatsuniyar keken dawakai
answer_d: Bambance tsakanin ra'ayoyin duniya mai-ganuwa da kuma duniya mai-fahimtawa (ko mai-hankaltuwa)

question: Malami yana karantawa a aji tare da dalibansa tunanin falsafar zati guda biyu na farko na R. Descartes da nufin aiki kan manufar koyo mai zuwa: 'Sanin da nazarin ra'ayin hankali na zamani na R. Descartes.' Wanne ne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa da daliban suka yi zai samar da shaida na cimma manufar?
answer_a: Suna bayyana hujjojin hankali da aka gabatar a cikin zuzzurfan tunani na metafiziks guda biyu na farko na R. Descartes
answer_b: Suna tantance shawarar Cartesian game da ilmin lissafi da aka gabatar a cikin tunani na farko biyu na falsafar metaphysical na R. Descartes
answer_c: Sun gano gardamar Cartesian ta shakkar hyperbolic da aka gabatar a cikin tunani biyu na farko na metaphysical na R. Descartes
answer_d: Suna fahimtar matsayin Cartesian game da ƙwarewar azanci wanda aka gabatar a cikin Zuzzurfan Tunani na Metaphysics Biyu na Farko na R. Descartes

question: Malamin aji na goma sha biyu, a ƙarshen darasin Matasalolin Metaphysical da Epistemological, ya shirya tantance manufar koyo mai zuwa: 'Fahimtar bambance-bambancen epistemological tsakanin empiricism da rationalism.' Wace aiki ɗalibai za su iya yi domin malamin ya tantance manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Ƙirƙiri teburi tare da ra'ayoyin gama gari tsakanin matsayi biyun
answer_b: Shiri jerin manyan ra'ayoyin J. Locke da R. Descartes
answer_c: A bayyana a cikin zane tushen ilimi na gwajin-gani (empiricism) da tunani-tsantsa (rationalism)
answer_d: Shirya maganganu daban-daban gwargwadon nau'in ilimi a cewar D. Hume da J. Locke

question: Karanta yanayin da ke biye: A ƙarshen sashin "Hawawar Bourgeoisie", ɗaya daga cikin manufofin da malamin ya tantance shi ne fahimtar manyan halayen al'adun bourgeoisie a cikin ƙarni na 19. Saboda wannan, an umurci ɗalibai su shirya rahoto rubutacce. Waɗanne alamomi ne ya kamata a tantance don cimma manufar da aka ambata?
answer_a: Yana siffanta bourgeoisie a matsayin babban jigo na siyasa a cikin sauye-sauyen da aka gudanar a ƙarni na 19
answer_b: Yana bayyana salon rayuwar 'yan jari hujja, ra'ayinsu na daidaiku, da kuma manufar rayuwar sirri
answer_c: Yana nazarin tushe game da gudunmawar ajin 'yan jari-hujja da akidar sassauci ta su wajen bunƙasa da dimokuraɗiyyar tsarin gwamnati a lokacin ƙarni na 19
answer_d: Kwatanta manyan ayyukan tattalin arzikin da 'yan kasuwar karni na 19 suka samar, tare da nuna sauye-sauye da ci gaba idan aka kwatanta da na zamani na yanzu

question: Malamar na so ta tantancewa ta hanyar aikin rubutu ko ɗalibanta sun fahimci illolin ƙarshen Yaƙin Cacar Baki. Wace ce daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan da aka nema za ta tantance wannan manufa?
answer_a: Siffanta sauye-sauyen siyasa da Glasnost ta gabatar a Tarayyar Soviet a matsayin daya daga cikin abubuwan da suka haifar da ƙarshen Yaƙin Cacar Baki
answer_b: Bayyana rawar da Reagan da Gorbachev suka taka wajen kawo karshen Yakin Cacar Baki
answer_c: A ambata kamanni guda ɗaya da bambanci guda ɗaya tsakanin tsare-tsare biyu na nazarin tarihi dangane da ƙarshen Yaƙin Cacar Baki
answer_d: Bayyana yadda rarrabuwar ikon siyasar ƙasa da ƙasa ta kasance bayan ƙarshen Yaƙin Cacar Baki

question: Malamar za ta fara aiki a kan sashen 'Samfuran tattalin arziki da tasirinsu a kan yankin', da manufar sa ɗalibanta na makarantar sakandare su tantance canje-canjen da sararin ƙasa ya samu sakamakon dangantaka tsakanin matakai na tattalin arziki, yawan jama'a, da na sararin yanki. Saboda haka, ta yanke shawarar fara darasin ta hanyar tuna ma'anar kalmar sararin ƙasa, ta hanyar zaman tunani na rukuni. A cikin amsoshin da ɗaliban suka bayar, waɗanda suka sifanta sararin ƙasar keɓantacce daga ɓangaren ta na zahiri ko na halitta su suka fi rinjaye, suna danganta shi da siffar dawwama a matsakaici da dogon lokaci. Idan aka yi la'akari da ƙa'idodin koyarwa waɗanda ke jagorantar koyarwar ilimin ƙasa, wace ɗaya ce ke da matuƙar mahimmanci a yi aiki a kai don faɗaɗa tunanin sarari da wannan rukunin ɗaliban ke da shi?
answer_a: Haɗi
answer_b: Wuri
answer_c: Dogara ga juna
answer_d: Sillamanta

question: A cikin wani darasi na sashin 'Ginin Jihohin Ƙasashe a Turai da Amurka' an yi wannan tattaunawa kamar haka: Malam: Wa zai iya bayyana bambancin da ke tsakanin Jiha da Al'umma? Dalibai na 1: Al'umma ba ta ko da yaushe ta ƙunshi Jiha, kuma Al'umma na iya kasancewa a rabu a cikin Jihohi fiye da ɗaya. Dalibai na 2: Yaya? Ban fahimci abin da ta faɗa ba. Daga nan, Malamin ya yanke shawara cewa darasi na gaba zai fara ne da gabatar da wani kayan aiki na koyarwa wanda zai misalta amsar dalibai na ɗaya. A cikin wane zaɓi aka gabatar da aikin da ya fi bayyana kai tsaye alaƙar da ke tsakanin ma'anonin Jiha da Al'umma?
answer_a: Lura da taswirar da ke gaba kuma ka bayyana zahirin yanayin sararin samaniyar da ta wakilta
answer_b: Karanta taswirar ra'ayi mai biyo baya kuma kwatanta ta da ra'ayin ƙasa
answer_c: Ku lura da wannan fasto sannan ku bayyana da bakinku saƙon da yake ƙunshe da shi
answer_d: Karanta ma'anonin nan kuma kwatanta ra'ayoyin duka biyu

question: Wace daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ce za ta ba ɗaliban firamare na aji na biyu damar nuna fahimtar su game da ra'ayoyin kiwo-gama-kai (nomadism) da zama-daidai (sedentism) dangane da Chonos, wata ƙungiyar mutane a ƙasar Chile?
answer_a: Kwatanta kwale-kwalen da Chonos suka ƙirƙira don tafiyar ruwa
answer_b: Nemo Chonos a taswirar zahiri ta Chile
answer_c: Bayyana yadda Chonos suka sami abincinsu
answer_d:
